STR.name: Strength
STR.description: Measures physical power, athletic training, and raw might. Important for fighters, paladins, and barbarians. Used for athletics checks and melee weapon attacks.

DEX.name: Dexterity
DEX.description: Measures agility, reflexes, and balance. Important for rogues, monks, and rangers. Used for AC, ranged attacks, DEX saves, and initiative.

CON.name: Constitution
CON.description: Measures health, stamina, and vital force. Important for all classes. Used for HP and Constitution saves against poison, disease, and exhaustion.

INT.name: Intelligence
INT.description: Measures mental acuity, recall, and analytical skill. Important for wizards and artificers. Used for arcane knowledge, investigation, and spellcasting for wizards/artificers.

WIS.name: Wisdom
WIS.description: Measures perception, insight, and willpower. Important for clerics, druids, and rangers. Used for perception, insight, and spellcasting for divine classes.

CHA.name: Charisma
CHA.description: Measures confidence, eloquence, and leadership. Important for bards, sorcerers, paladins, and warlocks. Used for social interactions and spellcasting for those classes.

Acrobatics.description: Stay on your feet in tricky situations, perform acrobatic stunts, escape restraints.

Animal Handling.description: Calm, train, or influence animals. Understand their behavior and intent.

Arcana.description: Knowledge of spells, magic items, magical traditions, arcane symbols, and planar entities.

Athletics.description: Difficult physical tasks: climb, jump, swim, grapple, shove, and escape grapple.

Deception.description: Mislead others through lies, bluffing, disguise, or fast-talking.

History.description: Knowledge of historical events, legendary people, ancient kingdoms, and lost civilizations.

Insight.description: Read body language, detect lies, discern intent, and determine truthfulness.

Intimidation.description: Influence others through threats, hostile actions, or physical coercion.

Investigation.description: Find clues, deduce information, examine evidence, and analyze crime scenes.

Medicine.description: Stabilize dying companions, diagnose illness, and determine cause of death.

Nature.description: Knowledge of plants, animals, weather, natural cycles, and terrain features.

Perception.description: Spot, hear, or detect things. Notice hidden creatures, traps, and dangers.

Performance.description: Entertain audiences through music, dance, acting, storytelling, or other art forms.

Persuasion.description: Influence others through goodwill, etiquette, and reasonable argument.

Religion.description: Knowledge of deities, religious ceremonies, holy symbols, and sacred traditions.

Sleight of Hand.description: Palm objects, pick pockets, perform legerdemain, and conceal items.

Stealth.description: Hide, move silently, slip away without being noticed, and remain unseen.

Survival.description: Track, forage, navigate, avoid natural hazards, and predict weather patterns.

alignments.name: Lawful Good
alignments.description: Follows rules and helps others. Champions of justice and order.

alignments.name: Neutral Good
alignments.description: Helps others regardless of rules. Does what's right without bias.

alignments.name: Chaotic Good
alignments.description: Acts on conscience, defies unjust rules. Freedom and goodness.

alignments.name: Lawful Neutral
alignments.description: Follows rules regardless of morality. Order and tradition above all.

alignments.name: Neutral
alignments.description: Lacks commitment to good/evil or order/chaos. Pragmatic.

alignments.name: Chaotic Neutral
alignments.description: Follows whims. Individual freedom above all else. Unpredictable.

alignments.name: Lawful Evil
alignments.description: Uses rules and order to exploit others. Tyrants and corrupt officials.

alignments.name: Neutral Evil
alignments.description: Does whatever can get away with. Selfish and ruthless without loyalty.

alignments.name: Chaotic Evil
alignments.description: Arbitrary destruction. Serves own desires with no regard for others.

conditions.name: Blinded
conditions.description: Can't see. Auto-fail sight-based checks. Attacks have disadvantage; attacks against you have advantage.

conditions.name: Charmed
conditions.description: Can't attack the charmer. Charmer has advantage on social ability checks against you.

conditions.name: Exhaustion
conditions.description: Progressive penalties: Level 1: ability checks disadvantage. Level 2: speed halved. Level 3: attack/saves disadvantage. Level 4: HP max halved. Level 5: speed 0. Level 6: death.

conditions.name: Frightened
conditions.description: Disadvantage on ability checks and attacks while source of fear is within line of sight. Can't willingly move closer to source.

conditions.name: Grappled
conditions.description: Speed becomes 0. Ends if grappler is incapacitated, or if effect removes you beyond reach.

conditions.name: Invisible
conditions.description: Impossible to see without special sense. Attacks against you have disadvantage; your attacks have advantage.

conditions.name: Paralyzed
conditions.description: Incapacitated, can't move or speak. Auto-fail STR/DEX saves. Attacks against you have advantage. Melee hits are criticals.

conditions.name: Petrified
conditions.description: Transformed to inanimate substance. Weight x10. Incapacitated. Auto-fail STR/DEX saves. Attacks have advantage. Resistance to all damage.

conditions.name: Poisoned
conditions.description: Disadvantage on attack rolls and ability checks.

conditions.name: Prone
conditions.description: Disadvantage on attacks. Melee attacks against you have advantage; ranged attacks have disadvantage. Can crawl or stand (half movement).

conditions.name: Restrained
conditions.description: Speed becomes 0. Attacks have disadvantage. Attacks against you have advantage. Disadvantage on DEX saves.

conditions.name: Stunned
conditions.description: Incapacitated, can't move, speak falteringly. Auto-fail STR/DEX saves. Attacks against you have advantage.

conditions.name: Unconscious
conditions.description: Incapacitated, can't move/speak, unaware. Drop held items, fall prone. Auto-fail STR/DEX saves. Attacks have advantage. Melee hits are criticals.

Dwarf.age: Dwarves mature at the same rate as humans, but they're considered young until they reach the age of 50. On average, they live about 350 years.
Dwarf.alignment: Most dwarves are lawful, believing firmly in the benefits of a well-ordered society. They tend toward good as well, with a strong sense of fair play and a belief that everyone deserves to share in the benefits of a just order.

traits.name: Dwarven Resilience
traits.description: Advantage on saving throws against poison, and resistance against poison damage.

traits.name: Dwarven Combat Training
traits.description: Proficiency with battleaxes, hand crossbows, light hammers, and warhammers.

traits.name: Tool Proficiency
traits.description: Proficiency with one artisan's tool of your choice: smith's tools, brewer's supplies, or mason's tools.

traits.name: Stonecunning
traits.description: Whenever you make an Intelligence (History) check related to the origin of stonework, you are considered proficient in the History skill and add double your proficiency bonus to the check.

traits.name: Dwarven Toughness
traits.description: Hit point maximum increases by 1, and it increases by 1 every time you gain a level.

traits.name: Dwarven Armor Training
traits.description: Proficiency with light and medium armor.

traits.name: Superior Darkvision
traits.description: Darkvision radius is 120 feet.

traits.name: Duergar Resilience
traits.description: You have advantage on saving throws against illusions and against being charmed or paralyzed.

traits.name: Duergar Magic
traits.description: At 3rd level, you can cast enlarge/reduce on yourself once per day. At 5th level, you can cast invisibility on yourself once per day. You don't need material components for either spell, and you can't cast them while you're in direct sunlight. Intelligence is your spellcasting ability for these spells.

traits.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
traits.description: You have disadvantage on attack rolls and on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight when you, the target of your attack, or whatever you are trying to perceive is in direct sunlight.

Elf.age: Although elves reach physical maturity at about the same age as humans, the elven understanding of adulthood goes beyond physical growth to signify worldly experience. An elf typically claims adulthood and an adult name around the age of 100 and can live to be 750 years old.
Elf.alignment: Elves love freedom, variety, and self-expression, so they lean strongly toward the gentler aspects of chaos. They value and protect others' freedom as well as their own, and they are more often good than not.

traits.name: Keen Senses
traits.description: Proficiency in the Perception skill.

traits.name: Fey Ancestry
traits.description: Advantage on saving throws against being charmed, and magic cannot put you to sleep.

traits.name: Trance
traits.description: Elves don't need to sleep. Instead, they meditate deeply, remaining semiconscious, for 4 hours a day. After resting in this way, you gain the same benefit that a human does from 8 hours of sleep.

traits.name: Elf Weapon Training
traits.description: Proficiency with longswords, shortswords, shortbows, and longbows.

traits.name: Cantrip
traits.description: You know one cantrip of your choice from the wizard spell list. Intelligence is your spellcasting ability for it.

traits.name: Extra Language
traits.description: You can speak, read, and write one extra language of your choice.

traits.name: Mask of the Wild
traits.description: You can attempt to hide even when you are only lightly obscured by foliage, heavy rain, falling snow, mist, and other natural phenomena.

traits.name: Fleet of Foot
traits.description: Base walking speed increases to 35 feet.

traits.name: Superior Darkvision
traits.description: Darkvision radius is 120 feet.

traits.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
traits.description: You have disadvantage on attack rolls and on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight when you, the target of your attack, or whatever you are trying to perceive is in direct sunlight.

traits.name: Drow Magic
traits.description: You know the dancing lights cantrip. At 3rd level, you can cast faerie fire once per day. At 5th level, you can cast darkness once per day. Charisma is your spellcasting ability for these spells.

traits.name: Drow Weapon Training
traits.description: Proficiency with rapiers, shortswords, and hand crossbows.

traits.name: Elf Weapon Training
traits.description: Proficiency with longswords, shortswords, shortbows, and longbows.

traits.name: Fey Step
traits.description: As a bonus action, you can magically teleport up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space you can see. Once you use this trait, you can't use it again until you finish a short or long rest. When you reach 3rd level, your Fey Step gains an additional effect based on your season: Autumn (charmed for 1 minute on hit), Winter (frightened for 1 minute on hit), Spring (teleport one willing creature within 5 feet), Summer (2d6 fire damage on hit).

traits.name: Seasonal Form
traits.description: Choose a season: Autumn, Winter, Spring, or Summer. Your appearance and Fey Step effect are tied to this season. You can change seasons at the end of a short or long rest.

traits.name: Sea Elf Training
traits.description: Proficiency with spears, tridents, light crossbows, and nets.

traits.name: Amphibious
traits.description: You can breathe air and water.

traits.name: Swim
traits.description: You have a swimming speed of 30 feet.

traits.name: Friend of the Sea
traits.description: Using gestures and sounds, you can communicate simple ideas with any beast that has an innate swimming speed.

traits.name: Child of the Sea
traits.description: You have resistance to cold damage.

traits.name: Necrotic Resistance
traits.description: You have resistance to necrotic damage.

traits.name: Blessing of the Raven Queen
traits.description: As a bonus action, you can magically teleport up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space you can see. You also gain resistance to all damage until the start of your next turn. Once you use this trait, you can't use it again until you finish a short or long rest.

traits.name: Superior Darkvision
traits.description: You can see in dim light within 120ft of you as if it were bright light, and in darkness as if it were dim light. You can't discern color in darkness only shades of grey.

traits.name: Ashen Acclimation
traits.description: Your eyes are evolved for the volatile haze of the Wastes. The distance you can see through fog or heavy ash is doubled (typically up to 120ft) allowing you to spot threats before they emerge from the gloom.

traits.name: Fungal Adaptation
traits.description: You have advantage on saving throws against being poisoned and resistance against poison damage.

traits.name: Necrotic Resistance
traits.description: You have resistance to necrotic damage.

traits.name: The Weaver's Silence
traits.description: You have proficiency in the stealth skill. Starting at 3rd level you can cast the silence spell once per long rest. Intelligence is your spellcasting ability for this spell.

traits.name: Soul-Sickness
traits.description: Your spirit is brittle, tied to a fading world. You have disadvantage on saving throws against being charmed or frightened by non-undead creatures.

Halfling.age: A halfling reaches adulthood at the age of 20 and generally lives into the middle of his or her second century.
Halfling.alignment: Most halflings are lawful good. As a rule, they are good-hearted and kind, hate to see others in pain, and have no tolerance for oppression. They are also very orderly and traditional, leaning heavily on the support of their community and the comfort of their old ways.

traits.name: Lucky
traits.description: When you roll a 1 on the d20 for an attack roll, ability check, or saving throw, you can reroll the die and must use the new roll.

traits.name: Brave
traits.description: You have advantage on saving throws against being frightened.

traits.name: Halfling Nimbleness
traits.description: You can move through the space of any creature that is of a size larger than yours.

traits.name: Naturally Stealthy
traits.description: You can attempt to hide even when you are obscured only by a creature that is at least one size larger than you.

traits.name: Stout Resilience
traits.description: Advantage on saving throws against poison, and you have resistance against poison damage.

traits.name: Silent Speech
traits.description: You can speak telepathically to any creature within 30 feet of you. The creature understands you only if the two of you share a language. You can speak telepathically in this way to one creature at a time.

Human.age: Humans reach adulthood in their late teens and live less than a century.
Human.alignment: Humans tend toward no particular alignment. The best and the worst are found among them.

Dragonborn.age: Young dragonborn grow quickly. They walk hours after hatching, attain the size and development of a 10-year-old human child by the age of 3, and reach adulthood by 15. They live to be around 80.
Dragonborn.alignment: Dragonborn tend to extremes, making a conscious choice for one side or the other in the cosmic war between good and evil. Most dragonborn are good, but those who side with evil can be terrible villains.

traits.name: Draconic Ancestry
traits.description: You have draconic ancestry. Choose one type of dragon from the Draconic Ancestry table. Your breath weapon and damage resistance are determined by the dragon type.

traits.name: Breath Weapon
traits.description: You can use your action to exhale destructive energy. Your draconic ancestry determines the size, shape, and damage type of the exhalation. When you use your breath weapon, each creature in the area of the exhalation must make a saving throw, the type of which is determined by your draconic ancestry. The DC for this saving throw equals 8 + your Constitution modifier + your proficiency bonus. A creature takes 2d6 damage on a failed save, and half as much damage on a successful one. The damage increases to 3d6 at 6th level, 4d6 at 11th level, and 5d6 at 16th level. After you use your breath weapon, you can't use it again until you complete a short or long rest.

traits.name: Damage Resistance
traits.description: You have resistance to the damage type associated with your draconic ancestry.

traits.name: Draconic Heritage
traits.description: You can speak, read, and write Draconic.

Gnome.age: Gnomes mature at the same rate humans do, and most are expected to settle down into an adult life by around age 40. They can live 350 to almost 500 years.
Gnome.alignment: Gnomes are most often good. Those who tend toward law are sages, engineers, researchers, scholars, investigators, or inventors. Those who tend toward chaos are minstrels, tricksters, wanderers, or fanciful jewelers. Gnomes are good-hearted, and even the tricksters among them are more playful than vicious.

traits.name: Gnome Cunning
traits.description: You have advantage on all Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma saving throws against magic.

traits.name: Natural Illusionist
traits.description: You know the minor illusion cantrip. Intelligence is your spellcasting ability for it.

traits.name: Speak with Small Beasts
traits.description: Through sounds and gestures, you can communicate simple ideas with Small or smaller beasts.

traits.name: Artificer's Lore
traits.description: Whenever you make an Intelligence (History) check related to magic items, alchemical objects, or technological devices, you can add twice your proficiency bonus, instead of any proficiency bonus you normally apply.

traits.name: Tinker
traits.description: You have proficiency with artisan's tools (tinker's tools). Using those tools, you can spend 1 hour and 10 gp worth of materials to construct a Tiny clockwork device (AC 5, 1 HP). You can have up to three such devices active at a time. Options: Clockwork Toy, Fire Starter, Music Box.

Half-Elf.age: Half-elves mature at the same rate humans do and reach adulthood around the age of 20. They live much longer than humans, however, often exceeding 180 years.
Half-Elf.alignment: Half-elves share the chaotic bent of their elven heritage. They value both personal freedom and creative expression, demonstrating neither a love of leaders nor a desire for followers. They chafe at rules, resent others' demands, and sometimes prove unreliable, or at least unpredictable.

traits.description: You gain proficiency in two skills of your choice.

Half-Orc.age: Half-orcs mature a little faster than humans, reaching adulthood around age 14. They age noticeably faster and rarely live longer than 75 years.
Half-Orc.alignment: Half-orcs inherit a tendency toward chaos from their orc parents and are not strongly inclined toward good. Half-orcs raised among orcs and willing to live out their lives among them are usually evil.

traits.name: Menacing
traits.description: You gain proficiency in the Intimidation skill.

traits.name: Relentless Endurance
traits.description: When you are reduced to 0 hit points but not killed outright, you can drop to 1 hit point instead. You can't use this feature again until you finish a long rest.

traits.name: Savage Attacks
traits.description: When you score a critical hit with a melee weapon attack, you can roll one of the weapon's damage dice one additional time and add it to the extra damage of the critical hit.

Tiefling.age: Tieflings mature at the same rate as humans but live a few years longer.
Tiefling.alignment: Tieflings might not have an innate tendency toward evil, but many of them end up there. Evil or not, an independent nature inclines many tieflings toward a chaotic alignment.

traits.name: Hellish Resistance
traits.description: You have resistance to fire damage.

traits.name: Infernal Legacy
traits.description: You know the thaumaturgy cantrip. At 3rd level, you can cast hellish rebuke once per day as a 2nd-level spell. At 5th level, you can cast darkness once per day. Charisma is your spellcasting ability for these spells.

traits.description: Thaumaturgy cantrip. At 3rd level: disguise self once per day. At 5th level: invisibility once per day. Charisma is your spellcasting ability.

traits.description: Minor illusion cantrip. At 3rd level: disguise self once per day. At 5th level: invisibility once per day. Charisma is your spellcasting ability.

traits.name: Infernal Legacy (Mammon)
traits.description: Mage hand cantrip. At 3rd level: Tenser's floating disk once per day. At 5th level: arcane lock once per day. Charisma is your spellcasting ability.

traits.name: Infernal Legacy (Mephistopheles)

traits.name: Infernal Legacy (Zariel)
traits.description: Thaumaturgy cantrip. At 3rd level: searing smite once per day. At 5th level: branding smite once per day. Charisma is your spellcasting ability.

traits.name: Zariel's Legacy
traits.description: Your tiefling heritage is tied to Zariel, the Archdevil of Avernus. You may have distinctive features such as golden eyes or a faint smell of brimstone.

Aarakocra.age: Aarakocra reach maturity by age 3. Compared to humans, aarakocra don't usually live longer than 30 years.
Aarakocra.alignment: Most aarakocra are good and rarely choose sides when it comes to law and chaos. Tribal leaders and elders might be lawful, while explorers and adventurers might tend toward chaotic.

traits.name: Flight
traits.description: You have a flying speed of 50 feet. To use this speed, you can't be wearing medium or heavy armor.

traits.name: Talons
traits.description: You are proficient with your unarmed strikes, which deal 1d4 slashing damage on a hit.

Genasi.age: Genasi mature at about the same rate as humans and reach adulthood in their late teens. They live somewhat longer than humans do, up to 120 years.
Genasi.alignment: Independent and self-reliant, genasi tend toward a neutral alignment.

traits.name: Unending Breath
traits.description: You can hold your breath indefinitely while you're not incapacitated.

traits.name: Mingle with the Wind
traits.description: You can cast levitate once per day with this trait, requiring no material components. Constitution is your spellcasting ability for it.

traits.name: Earth Walk
traits.description: You can move across difficult terrain made of earth or stone without expending extra movement.

traits.name: Merge with Stone
traits.description: You can cast pass without trace once per day with this trait, requiring no material components. Constitution is your spellcasting ability for it.

traits.name: Darkvision
traits.description: You can see in dim light within 60 feet of you as if it were bright light, and in darkness as if it were dim light. Your ties to the Elemental Plane of Fire make your darkvision unusual: everything you see in darkness is in shades of red.

traits.name: Fire Resistance
traits.description: You have resistance to fire damage.

traits.name: Reach to the Blaze
traits.description: You know the produce flame cantrip. At 3rd level, you can cast burning hands once per day. Constitution is your spellcasting ability for these spells.

traits.name: Acid Resistance
traits.description: You have resistance to acid damage.

traits.name: Amphibious
traits.description: You can breathe air and water.

traits.name: Swim
traits.description: You have a swimming speed of 30 feet.

traits.name: Call to the Wave
traits.description: You know the shape water cantrip. At 3rd level, you can cast create or destroy water once per day. Constitution is your spellcasting ability for these spells.

Goliath.age: Goliaths have lifespans comparable to humans. They enter adulthood in their late teens and usually live less than a century.
Goliath.alignment: Goliath society, with its clear roles and tasks, has a strong lawful bent. The goliath sense of fairness, balanced with an emphasis on self-sufficiency and personal accountability, pushes them toward neutrality.

traits.name: Natural Athlete
traits.description: You have proficiency in the Athletics skill.

traits.name: Stone's Endurance
traits.description: You can focus yourself to occasionally shrug off injury. When you take damage, you can use your reaction to roll a d12. Add your Constitution modifier to the number rolled, and reduce the damage by that total. After you use this trait, you can't use it again until you finish a short or long rest.

traits.name: Powerful Build
traits.description: You count as one size larger when determining your carrying capacity and the weight you can push, drag, or lift.

traits.name: Mountain Born
traits.description: You're acclimated to high altitude, including elevations above 20,000 feet. You're also naturally adapted to cold climates, as described in chapter 5 of the Dungeon Master's Guide.

Deep Gnome.age: Deep gnomes are short-lived for gnomes. They mature at the same rate humans do and are considered full-grown adults by 25. They live 200 to 250 years, although hard toil and the dangers of the Underdark often claim them before their time.
Deep Gnome.alignment: Svirfneblin believe in survival as a shared goal. They are usually neutral, preferring to keep to themselves and avoid the conflicts of others.

traits.name: Superior Darkvision
traits.description: Darkvision radius is 120 feet.

traits.name: Gnome Cunning
traits.description: You have advantage on all Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma saving throws against magic.

traits.name: Svirfneblin Camouflage
traits.description: When you make a Dexterity (Stealth) check while in rocky terrain, you can add twice your proficiency bonus to the roll.

traits.name: Stone Camouflage
traits.description: You have advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks made to hide in rocky terrain.

traits.name: Svirfneblin Magic
traits.description: At 3rd level, you can cast blindness/deafness, blur, and disguise self once per day each with this trait, requiring no material components. When you cast blindness/deafness with this trait, you can't use it on yourself. Intelligence is your spellcasting ability for these spells.

Aasimar.age: Aasimar mature at the same rate as humans, but they can live up to 160 years.
Aasimar.alignment: Imbued with celestial power, most aasimar are good. Outcasts and fallen aasimar may lean toward evil.

traits.name: Celestial Resistance
traits.description: You have resistance to necrotic damage and radiant damage.

traits.name: Healing Hands
traits.description: As an action, you can touch a creature and cause it to regain a number of hit points equal to your level. Once you use this trait, you can't use it again until you finish a long rest.

traits.name: Light Bearer
traits.description: You know the light cantrip. Charisma is your spellcasting ability for it.

traits.name: Radiant Soul
traits.description: Starting at 3rd level, you can use your action to unleash the divine energy within yourself, causing your eyes to glimmer and two luminous, incorporeal wings to sprout from your back. For 1 minute, you have a flying speed of 30 feet, and once on each of your turns, you can deal extra radiant damage equal to your level to one target when you deal damage with an attack or spell. Once you use this trait, you can't use it again until you finish a long rest.

traits.name: Radiant Consumption
traits.description: Starting at 3rd level, you can use your action to unleash the divine energy within yourself, causing a searing light to radiate from you, pour out of your eyes and mouth, and threaten to char you. For 1 minute, you shed bright light in a 10-foot radius and dim light for an additional 10 feet, and at the start of each of your turns, each creature within 10 feet of you takes radiant damage equal to half your level (rounded up). In addition, once on each of your turns, you can deal extra radiant damage equal to your level to one target when you deal damage with an attack or spell. You take radiant damage equal to half your level (rounded up) at the start of each of your turns. Once you use this trait, you can't use it again until you finish a long rest.

traits.name: Necrotic Shroud
traits.description: Starting at 3rd level, you can use your action to unleash the divine energy within yourself, causing your eyes to turn into pools of darkness and two skeletal, ghostly, flightless wings to sprout from your back. For 1 minute, you cause each creature within 10 feet of you to make a Charisma saving throw (DC 8 + your proficiency bonus + your Charisma modifier). On a failed save, the creature is frightened of you until the end of your next turn. In addition, once on each of your turns, you can deal extra necrotic damage equal to your level to one target when you deal damage with an attack or spell. Once you use this trait, you can't use it again until you finish a long rest.

Bugbear.age: Bugbears reach adulthood at age 16 and live up to 80 years.
Bugbear.alignment: Bugbears endure a harsh existence that demands each of them to remain self-sufficient, even at the expense of their fellows. They tend toward chaotic evil.

traits.name: Long-Limbed
traits.description: When you make a melee attack on your turn, your reach for it is 5 feet greater than normal.

traits.name: Surprise Attack
traits.description: If you surprise a creature and hit it with an attack on your first turn in combat, the attack deals an extra 2d6 damage to it.

traits.name: Sneaky
traits.description: You are proficient in the Stealth skill.

traits.name: Powerful Build
traits.description: You count as one size larger when determining your carrying capacity and the weight you can push, drag, or lift.

Firbolg.age: As humanoids related to the fey, firbolg have long lifespans. A firbolg reaches adulthood around 30, and the oldest of them can live for 500 years.
Firbolg.alignment: As people who follow the rhythm of nature and see themselves as its caretakers, firbolg are typically neutral good. Evil firbolg are rare and are usually the sworn enemies of the rest of their kind.

traits.name: Firbolg Magic
traits.description: You can cast detect magic and disguise self with this trait, using Wisdom as your spellcasting ability. Once you cast either spell, you can't cast it again with this trait until you finish a short or long rest. When you use this version of disguise self, you can seem up to 3 feet shorter than normal, allowing you to more easily blend in with humans and elves.

traits.name: Hidden Step
traits.description: As a bonus action, you can magically turn invisible until the start of your next turn or until you attack, make a damage roll, or force someone to make a saving throw. Once you use this trait, you can't use it again until you finish a short or long rest.

traits.name: Powerful Build
traits.description: You count as one size larger when determining your carrying capacity and the weight you can push, drag, or lift.

traits.name: Speech of Beast and Leaf
traits.description: You have the ability to communicate in a limited manner with beasts and plants. They can understand the meaning of your words, though you have no special ability to understand them in return. You have advantage on all Charisma checks you make to influence them.

Goblin.age: Goblins reach adulthood at age 8 and live up to 60 years.
Goblin.alignment: Goblins are typically neutral evil, as they care only for their own needs. A few goblins might tend toward good or neutrality, but only rarely.

traits.name: Darkvision
traits.description: You can see in dim light within 60 feet as if it were bright light, and in darkness as if it were dim light.

traits.name: Fury of the Small
traits.description: When you damage a creature with an attack or a spell and the creature's size is larger than yours, you can cause the attack or spell to deal extra damage to the creature equal to your level. Once you use this trait, you can't use it again until you finish a short or long rest.

traits.name: Nimble Escape
traits.description: You can take the Disengage or Hide action as a bonus action on each of your turns.

Hobgoblin.age: Hobgoblins mature at the same rate as humans and have lifespans similar in length to theirs.
Hobgoblin.alignment: Hobgoblin society is built on discipline, ranking, and military organization, and thus most hobgoblins lean toward lawful alignments. Many hobgoblins are evil, using their martial culture and disciplined regiments to conquer and enslave.

traits.name: Saving Face
traits.description: Hobgoblins are careful not to show weakness in front of their allies, for fear of losing status. If you miss with an attack roll or fail an ability check or a saving throw, you can gain a bonus to the roll equal to the number of allies you can see within 30 feet of you (maximum bonus of +5). Once you use this trait, you can't use it again until you finish a short or long rest.

traits.name: Martial Training
traits.description: You are proficient with two martial weapons of your choice and with light armor.

Kenku.age: Kenku have shorter lifespans than humans. They reach maturity at about 12 years old and can live to 60.
Kenku.alignment: Kenku are chaotic neutral, tending toward selfishness. Rarely, a kenku may break from its flock and adopt a different alignment.

traits.name: Expert Forgery
traits.description: You can duplicate other creatures' handwriting and craftwork. You have advantage on all checks made to produce forgeries or duplicates of existing objects.

traits.name: Kenku Training
traits.description: You are proficient in your choice of two of the following skills: Acrobatics, Deception, Stealth, and Sleight of Hand.

traits.name: Mimicry
traits.description: You can mimic sounds you have heard, including voices. A creature that hears the sounds can tell they are imitations with a successful Wisdom (Insight) check opposed by your Charisma (Deception) check.

Kobold.age: Kobolds reach adulthood at age 6 and can live up to 120 years but rarely do so.
Kobold.alignment: Kobolds are fundamentally selfish, making them evil, but their reliance on the strength of their group makes them trend toward law.

traits.name: Darkvision
traits.description: You can see in dim light within 60 feet as if it were bright light, and in darkness as if it were dim light.

traits.name: Grovel, Cower, and Beg
traits.description: As an action on your turn, you can cower pathetically to distract nearby foes. Until the end of your next turn, your allies gain advantage on attack rolls against enemies within 10 feet of you that can see you. Once you use this trait, you can't use it again until you finish a short or long rest.

traits.name: Pack Tactics
traits.description: You have advantage on an attack roll against a creature if at least one of your allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally isn't incapacitated.

traits.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
traits.description: You have disadvantage on attack rolls and on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight when you, the target of your attack, or whatever you are trying to perceive is in direct sunlight.

Lizardfolk.age: Lizardfolk reach maturity around age 14 and rarely live longer than 60 years.
Lizardfolk.alignment: Most lizardfolk are neutral. They see the world as a place of predators and prey, where life and death are natural processes. They wish only to survive, and prefer to leave other creatures to their own devices.

traits.name: Bite
traits.description: You have a fanged maw that you can use to make unarmed strikes. When you hit with it, the strike deals 1d6 + your Strength modifier slashing damage, instead of the bludgeoning damage normal for an unarmed strike.

traits.name: Cunning Artisan
traits.description: As part of a short rest, you can harvest bone and hide from a slain beast, construct, dragon, monstrosity, or plant creature of size Small or larger to create one of the following items: a shield, a club, a javelin, or 1d4 darts or blowgun needles. To use this trait, you need a blade, such as a dagger, or appropriate artisan's tools, such as leatherworker's tools.

traits.name: Hold Breath
traits.description: You can hold your breath for up to 15 minutes at a time.

traits.name: Hunter's Lore
traits.description: You gain proficiency with two of the following skills of your choice: Animal Handling, Nature, Perception, Stealth, and Survival.

traits.name: Natural Armor
traits.description: You have tough, scaly skin. When you aren't wearing armor, your AC is 13 + your Dexterity modifier. You can use your natural armor to determine your AC if the armor you wear would leave you with a lower AC. A shield's benefits apply as normal while you use your natural armor.

traits.name: Hungry Jaws
traits.description: In battle, you can throw yourself into a vicious feeding frenzy. As a bonus action, you can make a special attack with your bite. If the attack hits, it deals its normal damage, and you gain temporary hit points equal to your Constitution modifier (minimum of 1), and you can't use this trait again until you finish a short or long rest.

Orc.age: Orcs reach adulthood at age 12 and live up to 50 years.
Orc.alignment: Orcs are violent by nature, burning with a restless energy that drives them to act. They tend toward chaotic evil.

traits.name: Aggressive
traits.description: As a bonus action, you can move up to your speed toward an enemy of your choice that you can see or hear. You must end this move closer to the enemy than you started.

traits.name: Menacing
traits.description: You are trained in the Intimidation skill.

traits.name: Powerful Build
traits.description: You count as one size larger when determining your carrying capacity and the weight you can push, drag, or lift.

Tabaxi.age: Tabaxi have lifespans comparable to humans.
Tabaxi.alignment: Tabaxi tend toward chaotic alignments, as they let impulse and fancy guide their decisions. They are rarely evil, with most of them driven by curiosity rather than greed or dark desires.

traits.name: Darkvision
traits.description: You have a cat's keen senses, especially in the dark. You can see in dim light within 60 feet as if it were bright light, and in darkness as if it were dim light.

traits.name: Feline Agility
traits.description: Your reflexes and agility allow you to move with a burst of speed. When you move on your turn in combat, you can double your speed until the end of the turn. Once you use this trait, you can't use it again until you move 0 feet on one of your turns.

traits.name: Cat's Claws
traits.description: Because of your claws, you have a climbing speed of 20 feet. In addition, your claws are natural weapons, which you can use to make unarmed strikes. If you hit with them, you deal slashing damage equal to 1d4 + your Strength modifier, instead of the bludgeoning damage normal for an unarmed strike.

traits.name: Cat's Talent
traits.description: You have proficiency in the Perception and Stealth skills.

Triton.age: Tritons reach maturity around age 15 and can live up to 200 years.
Triton.alignment: Tritons tend toward lawful good. As guardians of the deepest ocean reaches, they believe in the rule of law and the importance of community.

traits.name: Amphibious
traits.description: You can breathe air and water.

traits.name: Control Air and Water
traits.description: You can cast fog cloud with this trait. Starting at 3rd level, you can cast gust of wind with it, and starting at 5th level, you can also cast wall of water with it. Once you cast a spell with this trait, you can't cast that spell with it again until you finish a long rest. Charisma is your spellcasting ability for these spells.

traits.name: Emissary of the Sea
traits.description: You can communicate simple ideas with any beast that has an innate swimming speed. They can understand the meaning of your words, though you have no special ability to understand them in return.

traits.name: Guardians of the Depths
traits.description: Adapted to even the most extreme ocean depths, you have resistance to cold damage, and you ignore any of the drawbacks caused by a deep, underwater environment.

traits.name: Swim
traits.description: You have a swimming speed of 30 feet.

Yuan-ti Pureblood.age: Yuan-ti mature at the same rate as humans and have lifespans similar in length to theirs.
Yuan-ti Pureblood.alignment: Yuan-ti are almost always evil, as they follow the teachings of their dark gods. They tend toward neutral evil.

traits.name: Darkvision
traits.description: You can see in dim light within 60 feet as if it were bright light, and in darkness as if it were dim light.

traits.name: Innate Spellcasting
traits.description: You know the poison spray cantrip. At 3rd level, you can cast animal friendship (snakes only) once per day. At 5th level, you can cast suggestion once per day. Charisma is your spellcasting ability for these spells.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.description: You have advantage on all saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Poison Immunity
traits.description: You are immune to poison damage and the poisoned condition.

Custom Lineage.age: Varies by the form you choose.

traits.name: Ability Score Increase
traits.description: One ability score of your choice increases by 2.

traits.name: Feat
traits.description: You gain one feat of your choice.

traits.name: Variable Trait
traits.description: You are Medium or Small. You choose one skill in which you gain proficiency. You can choose one of the following: darkvision 60 ft., or proficiency in one skill of your choice.

Gem Dragonborn.age: Young dragonborn grow quickly. They walk hours after hatching, attain the size and development of a 10-year-old human child by the age of 3, and reach adulthood by 15. They live to be around 80.
Gem Dragonborn.alignment: Gem dragonborn tend toward neutrality, valuing self-sufficiency and independence. They may lean toward good or evil based on their heritage.

traits.name: Gem Ancestry
traits.description: You have a gem dragon ancestor, which determines the damage type of your breath weapon and your psionic ability.

traits.name: Breath Weapon
traits.description: You can use your action to exhale destructive energy. When you use your breath weapon, each creature in the area must make a saving throw. The DC equals 8 + your Constitution modifier + your proficiency bonus. A creature takes 2d6 damage on a failed save, and half as much on a successful one. The damage increases to 3d6 at 6th level, 4d6 at 11th level, and 5d6 at 16th level. After you use your breath weapon, you can't use it again until you complete a short or long rest.

traits.name: Psionic Mind
traits.description: You can send telepathic messages to any creature you can see within 30 feet of you. The creature can understand you only if it knows the language you're using.

traits.name: Gem Resistance
traits.description: You have resistance to the damage type associated with your gem ancestry.

traits.name: Breath Weapon
traits.description: 15 ft. cone; force damage; DEX save.

traits.name: Gem Resistance
traits.description: Force

traits.name: Psionic Rebuke
traits.description: When a creature hits you with a melee attack, you can use your reaction to deal 1d4 force damage to the creature. The damage increases to 1d6 at 6th level, 1d8 at 11th level, and 1d10 at 16th level.

traits.name: Breath Weapon
traits.description: 15 ft. cone; radiant damage; CON save.

traits.name: Gem Resistance
traits.description: Radiant

traits.name: Psionic Rebuke
traits.description: When a creature hits you with a melee attack, you can use your reaction to deal 1d4 radiant damage to the creature. The damage increases to 1d6 at 6th level, 1d8 at 11th level, and 1d10 at 16th level.

traits.name: Breath Weapon
traits.description: 15 ft. cone; psychic damage; WIS save.

traits.name: Gem Resistance
traits.description: Psychic

traits.name: Psionic Rebuke
traits.description: When a creature hits you with a melee attack, you can use your reaction to deal 1d4 psychic damage to the creature. The damage increases to 1d6 at 6th level, 1d8 at 11th level, and 1d10 at 16th level.

traits.name: Breath Weapon
traits.description: 15 ft. cone; thunder damage; CON save.

traits.name: Gem Resistance
traits.description: Thunder

traits.name: Psionic Rebuke
traits.description: When a creature hits you with a melee attack, you can use your reaction to deal 1d4 thunder damage to the creature. The damage increases to 1d6 at 6th level, 1d8 at 11th level, and 1d10 at 16th level.

traits.name: Breath Weapon
traits.description: 15 ft. cone; cold damage; CON save.

traits.name: Gem Resistance
traits.description: Cold

traits.name: Psionic Rebuke
traits.description: When a creature hits you with a melee attack, you can use your reaction to deal 1d4 cold damage to the creature. The damage increases to 1d6 at 6th level, 1d8 at 11th level, and 1d10 at 16th level.

Dhampir.age: Dhampir age at the same rate as humans but can live for centuries.
Dhampir.alignment: Dhampir can be of any alignment, often torn between their living and undead natures.

traits.name: Ability Score Increase
traits.description: Increase one ability score by 2, and increase a different one by 1, or increase three different scores by 1.

traits.name: Darkvision
traits.description: You can see in dim light within 60 feet as if it were bright light, and in darkness as if it were dim light.

traits.name: Deathless Nature
traits.description: You don't need to breathe. You are immune to disease. You have resistance to poison damage, and you have advantage on saving throws against being poisoned.

traits.name: Spider Climb
traits.description: You have a climbing speed equal to your walking speed. In addition, at 3rd level, you can move up, down, and across vertical surfaces and upside down on ceilings while leaving your hands free.

traits.name: Vampiric Bite
traits.description: Your fanged bite is a natural weapon, which counts as a simple melee weapon with which you are proficient. You add your Constitution modifier, instead of your Strength modifier, to attack and damage rolls. It deals 1d4 piercing damage plus your Constitution modifier. When you attack with this bite and hit a creature that isn't a Construct or an Undead, you can empower yourself in one of the following ways: regain hit points equal to the damage dealt, gain a bonus to the next attack roll or ability check you make within the next minute, or increase your speed by 5 feet until the end of your next turn. You can empower yourself with this bite a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a long rest.

Hexblood.age: Hexbloods age at the same rate as humans but can live for centuries.
Hexblood.alignment: Hexbloods can be of any alignment, their fey-touched nature giving them capricious tendencies.

traits.name: Ability Score Increase
traits.description: Increase one ability score by 2, and increase a different one by 1, or increase three different scores by 1.

traits.name: Darkvision
traits.description: You can see in dim light within 60 feet as if it were bright light, and in darkness as if it were dim light.

traits.name: Eerie Token
traits.description: As a bonus action, you can harmlessly detach a fingernail, a lock of hair, or one of your teeth. A creature carrying your token has advantage on ability checks made to track you, and you know the token's location and can use a bonus action to hear and see from the token for 1 minute. You can have only one token at a time.

traits.name: Hex Magic
traits.description: You can cast disguise self and hex with this trait, using Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma as your spellcasting ability (choose when you select this race). Once you cast either spell with this trait, you can't cast that spell with it again until you finish a long rest. You can also cast either spell using any spell slots you have of the appropriate level.

traits.name: Fey Type
traits.description: Your creature type is fey, rather than humanoid.

Reborn.age: Reborn are created, not born, and can be of any apparent age. They may be functionally immortal.
Reborn.alignment: Reborn can be of any alignment, shaped by their past life experiences and the nature of their rebirth.

traits.name: Ability Score Increase
traits.description: Increase one ability score by 2, and increase a different one by 1, or increase three different scores by 1.

traits.name: Darkvision
traits.description: You can see in dim light within 60 feet as if it were bright light, and in darkness as if it were dim light.

traits.name: Deathless Nature
traits.description: You don't need to sleep, and magic can't put you to sleep. You can finish a long rest in 4 hours if you spend those hours in an inactive, motionless state, during which you retain consciousness. You have advantage on saving throws against disease and being poisoned, and you have resistance to poison damage.

traits.name: Knowledge from a Past Life
traits.description: You temporarily remember glimpses of the past, perhaps memories of an ancient conflict, long-dead loved ones, or a distant homeland. Whenever you make an ability check that uses a skill, you can roll a d6 immediately after seeing the number on the d20 and add the d6 result to the check. You can use this feature a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a long rest.

Owlin.age: Owlins have lifespans comparable to humans.
Owlin.alignment: Owlins tend toward no particular alignment.

traits.name: Ability Score Increase
traits.description: Increase one ability score by 2, and increase a different one by 1, or increase three different scores by 1.

traits.name: Darkvision
traits.description: You can see in dim light within 120 feet as if it were bright light, and in darkness as if it were dim light.

traits.name: Flight
traits.description: You have a flying speed equal to your walking speed. To use this speed, you can't be wearing medium or heavy armor.

traits.name: Silent Feathers
traits.description: You have proficiency in the Stealth skill.

Verdan.age: Verdan reach adulthood at around the age of 20 and can live up to 200 years.
Verdan.alignment: Verdan are generally good, though their curiosity sometimes leads them into trouble. They lean toward chaos.

traits.name: Black Blood Healing
traits.description: The black blood of the verdan is thick and adhesive, aiding in the healing process. When you roll a 1 or 2 on any Hit Die you spend to regain hit points at the end of a short rest, you can reroll the die and must use the new roll.

traits.name: Fortune Favors the Verdant
traits.description: You can add 1d4 to any ability check you make that uses a skill in which you lack proficiency. You can use this trait a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus, regaining all expended uses when you finish a long rest.

traits.name: Limited Telepathy
traits.description: You can telepathically communicate with any creature you can see within 30 feet of you. You don't need to share a language with the creature for it to understand your telepathic utterances, but the creature must be able to understand at least one language.

traits.name: Telepathic Insight
traits.description: Your mind's awareness of others lends you a particular insight into their behavior. You have advantage on Wisdom (Insight) checks to determine whether a creature is lying or telling the truth.

Leonin.age: Leonin mature and age at about the same rate as humans.
Leonin.alignment: Leonin tend toward good alignment. They value community and the rule of law, leaning toward lawful good.

traits.name: Darkvision
traits.description: You can see in dim light within 60 feet as if it were bright light, and in darkness as if it were dim light.

traits.name: Daunting Roar
traits.description: As a bonus action, you can let out an intimidating roar. Each creature of your choice within 10 feet of you must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw (DC equals 8 + your proficiency bonus + your Constitution modifier) or become frightened of you until the end of your next turn. You can use this trait a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a long rest.

traits.name: Hunter's Instincts
traits.description: You have proficiency in one of the following skills of your choice: Athletics, Intimidation, Perception, or Survival.

traits.name: Pride's Claws
traits.description: Your claws are natural weapons, which you can use to make unarmed strikes. If you hit with them, you deal slashing damage equal to 1d4 + your Strength modifier, instead of the bludgeoning damage normal for an unarmed strike.

Satyr.age: Satyrs mature at the same rate as humans but can live for a few centuries.
Satyr.alignment: Satyrs delight in living free, abandoning themselves to the pleasures of life. They tend toward chaotic good.

traits.name: Fey
traits.description: Your creature type is fey, rather than humanoid.

traits.name: Ram
traits.description: You can use your head and horns to make unarmed strikes. If you hit with them, you deal bludgeoning damage equal to 1d4 + your Strength modifier.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.description: You have advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Mirthful Leaps
traits.description: Whenever you make a long or high jump, you can roll a d8 and add the number rolled to the number of feet you cover, even when making a standing jump. This extra distance costs movement as normal.

traits.name: Reveler
traits.description: You have proficiency in the Performance and Persuasion skills, and you have proficiency with one musical instrument of your choice.

Fairy.age: Fairies have lifespans comparable to humans, though some live for centuries.
Fairy.alignment: Fairies tend toward chaotic good, delighting in freedom and whimsy.

traits.name: Ability Score Increase
traits.description: Increase one ability score by 2, and increase a different one by 1, or increase three different scores by 1.

traits.name: Fey
traits.description: Your creature type is fey, rather than humanoid.

traits.name: Fairy Flight
traits.description: You have a flying speed equal to your walking speed. To use this speed, you can't be wearing medium or heavy armor.

traits.name: Fey Magic
traits.description: You know the druidcraft cantrip. At 3rd level, you can cast faerie fire once per day. At 5th level, you can cast enlarge/reduce once per day. You choose which version of enlarge/reduce to cast when you cast it. Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma is your spellcasting ability for these spells when you cast them with this trait (choose when you select this race).

Harengon.age: Harengon have lifespans comparable to humans.
Harengon.alignment: Harengon tend toward chaotic alignments, valuing freedom and quick wits.

traits.name: Ability Score Increase
traits.description: Increase one ability score by 2, and increase a different one by 1, or increase three different scores by 1.

traits.name: Hare-Trigger
traits.description: You can add your proficiency bonus to your initiative rolls.

traits.name: Lucky Footwork
traits.description: When you fail a Dexterity saving throw, you can use your reaction to roll a d4 and add it to the save, potentially turning a failure into a success. You can use this trait a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a long rest.

traits.name: Rabbit Hop
traits.description: As a bonus action, you can jump a number of feet equal to five times your proficiency bonus, without provoking opportunity attacks. You can use this trait only if your speed is greater than 0. You can use it a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a long rest.

traits.name: Perception Proficiency
traits.description: You have proficiency in the Perception skill.

Astral Elf.age: Astral elves can live to be over 750 years old. They reach adulthood around 100.
Astral Elf.alignment: Astral elves tend toward neutrality, having stepped back from the concerns of the Material Plane. Some maintain their fey whimsy while others become detached scholars.

traits.name: Celestial Resistance
traits.description: You have resistance to radiant damage.

traits.name: Starlight Step
traits.description: As a bonus action, you can magically teleport up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space you can see. You can use this trait a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a long rest.

traits.name: Astral Fire
traits.description: You know the light cantrip. Starting at 3rd level, you can cast the faerie fire spell with this trait. Starting at 5th level, you can also cast the daylight spell. Intelligence is your spellcasting ability for these spells. Once you cast faerie fire or daylight with this trait, you can't cast that spell with it again until you finish a long rest.

traits.name: Fey Ancestry
traits.description: You have advantage on saving throws against being charmed, and magic can't put you to sleep.

traits.name: Trance
traits.description: You don't need to sleep, and magic can't put you to sleep. You can finish a long rest in 4 hours if you spend those hours in a trancelike meditation, during which you remain conscious.

Autognome.age: Autognomes are built and don't age. They can function indefinitely if maintained and repaired.
Autognome.alignment: Autognomes tend toward lawful alignment, following the directives given by their creators, but many develop independent personalities that shift them toward neutral.

traits.name: Built for Purpose
traits.description: You were created to perform a specialized function. You gain proficiency in one of the following skill sets: arcana and investigation, athletics and survival, or perception and stealth.

traits.name: Armored Casing
traits.description: You are encased in a metal shell. While you aren't wearing armor, your base Armor Class is 13 + your Dexterity modifier. You can use a shield and still gain this benefit.

traits.name: Cure Mechanism
traits.description: The mending cantrip can be cast on you to restore hit points. When mending is cast on you in this way, you regain a number of hit points equal to 2d6 + your proficiency bonus.

traits.name: Mechanical Nature
traits.description: You are a construct. You are immune to disease and the poisoned condition. You are also immune to poison damage. You don't need to eat, drink, or breathe.

traits.name: Sentry's Rest
traits.description: When you take a long rest, you must spend at least six hours in an inactive, motionless state, rather than sleeping. In this state, you appear inert, but it doesn't render you unconscious, and you can see and hear as normal.

Giff.age: Giff mature at the same rate as humans and live to be about 80 years old.
Giff.alignment: Giff tend toward lawful alignment, valuing military hierarchy and discipline. Their mercenary nature sometimes pushes them toward neutrality.

traits.name: Astral Spark
traits.description: Your connection to the Astral Plane gives you the ability to deal radiant damage with your unarmed strikes. When you hit with an unarmed strike, you can deal radiant damage instead of bludgeoning damage, and you can roll a d4 in place of the normal damage of your unarmed strike. This damage increases to 1d6 at 5th level, 1d8 at 11th level, and 1d10 at 17th level.

traits.name: Firearms Mastery
traits.description: You have a special affinity for firearms. You are proficient with all firearms. If you have a firearm, you can reload it as a bonus action instead of an action. When you score a critical hit with a firearm, you can roll one of the weapon's damage dice one additional time and add it to the extra damage of the critical hit.

traits.name: Hippo Build
traits.description: You count as one size larger when determining your carrying capacity and the weight you can push, drag, or lift. You have advantage on Strength checks made to push or pull objects.

traits.name: Headfirst Charge
traits.description: If you move at least 20 feet in a straight line toward a creature and then hit it with a melee weapon attack on the same turn, the target takes an extra 1d6 bludgeoning damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a Strength saving throw (DC = 8 + your proficiency bonus + your Strength modifier) or be knocked prone. You can use this trait a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a long rest.

Hadozee.age: Hadozee mature at the same rate as humans and live to be about 90 years old.
Hadozee.alignment: Hadozee tend toward chaotic alignment, valuing freedom and exploration. Their adventurous spirit leads them to seek new experiences.

traits.name: Dexterous Feet
traits.description: You can use your feet as effectively as your hands. You can use your feet to manipulate objects, and you can use them to cast spells with somatic components if your hands are full.

traits.name: Glide
traits.description: You have a patagium — a membrane of skin between your limbs — that allows you to glide. When you fall at least 10 feet above the ground, you can use your reaction to spread your arms and legs to glide horizontally a number of feet equal to your walking speed, and you take no falling damage. While gliding, you can't use your Dexterous Feet trait or hold objects with your feet.

traits.name: Hadozee Resilience
traits.description: The magic of the Feywild has given you a measure of resilience. When you take damage, you can use your reaction to roll a d6. Add your proficiency bonus to the number rolled, and reduce the damage you take by that total. You can use this trait a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a long rest.

Plasmoid.age: Plasmoids don't age the way other creatures do. They can live indefinitely if they have access to food and water.
Plasmoid.alignment: Plasmoids tend toward neutrality, having no cultural history of their own. They often adopt the alignments of those around them.
languages: One other language of your choice

traits.name: Amorphous
traits.description: You can squeeze through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide, provided you are wearing and carrying nothing. You have advantage on ability checks you make to initiate or escape a grapple.

traits.name: Darkvision
traits.description: You can see in dim light within 60 feet as if it were bright light and in darkness as if it were dim light. You discern colors in that darkness only as shades of gray.

traits.name: Hold Breath
traits.description: You can hold your breath for 1 hour.

traits.name: Natural Resilience
traits.description: You have resistance to acid and poison damage, and you have advantage on saving throws against being poisoned.

traits.name: Shape Self
traits.description: As a bonus action, you can reshape your body to give yourself a head, one or two arms, one or two legs, or some other form. You can use this trait to appear as a member of another humanoid race, though you are still clearly a plasmoid. You can't use this trait to change your size. You can reshape your body to assume a humanoid form or revert to a shapeless form. While shapeless, you can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide without squeezing.

Thri-kreen.age: Thri-kreen mature quickly, reaching adulthood by age 7. They typically live to be about 30 years old.
Thri-kreen.alignment: Thri-kreen tend toward neutral alignment, focused on survival and the needs of their clutch. They have little concept of ownership and value the group over the individual.

traits.name: Chameleon Carapace
traits.description: While you aren't wearing armor, your carapace gives you a base AC of 13 + your Dexterity modifier. As an action, you can change the color of your carapace to match the color and texture of your surroundings, giving you advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks made to hide in those surroundings for 1 hour.

traits.name: Darkvision
traits.description: You can see in dim light within 60 feet as if it were bright light and in darkness as if it were dim light. You discern colors in that darkness only as shades of gray.

traits.name: Secondary Arms
traits.description: You have two slightly smaller arms below your primary pair of arms. The secondary arms can manipulate objects, open doors, and wield light weapons. They can't wield shields or weapons with the two-handed property.

traits.name: Sleepless
traits.description: You do not require sleep and can remain conscious during a long rest. You still need to refrain from strenuous activity to gain the benefit of a long rest.

traits.name: Thri-kreen Telepathy
traits.description: Without the aid of magic, you can't use telepathy to communicate with a creature unless the creature also has telepathy. You can communicate telepathically with any creature within 120 feet that also has telepathy.

starting_equipment: Greataxe or any martial melee weapon
Two handaxes or any simple weapon

features.name: Rage
features.description: Bonus action: enter rage for 1 minute. Advantage on STR checks and saves; +2 melee weapon damage (+3 at 9th, +4 at 16th); resistance to bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage. Cannot cast or concentrate on spells. Ends early if unconscious or no hostile creature within range for 1 turn. Uses per long rest: 2 (levels 1-2), 3 (3-5), 4 (6-11), 5 (12-16), 6 (17-19), unlimited (20).

features.name: Unarmored Defense
features.description: AC = 10 + DEX modifier + CON modifier while not wearing armor.

features.name: Reckless Attack
features.description: On first attack on your turn, declare reckless: gain advantage on all melee attacks using STR this turn; attacks against you have advantage until your next turn.

features.name: Danger Sense
features.description: Advantage on DEX saving throws against effects you can see. No benefit if blinded, deafened, or incapacitated.

features.name: Primal Path
features.description: Choose a Primal Path subclass that grants features at levels 3, 6, 10, and 14.

features.name: Ability Score Improvement
features.description: Increase one ability score by 2, or two ability scores by 1 each. Maximum 20.

features.name: Extra Attack
features.description: Attack twice instead of once when taking the Attack action.

features.name: Fast Movement
features.description: Speed increases by 10 ft while not wearing heavy armor.

features.name: Feral Instinct
features.description: Advantage on initiative rolls. If surprised at start of combat, can act normally on first turn if you enter rage before doing anything else.

features.name: Ability Score Improvement
features.description: Increase one ability score by 2, or two ability scores by 1 each. Maximum 20.

features.name: Brutal Critical
features.description: On a critical hit with a melee weapon, roll one additional weapon damage die. Additional dice: 2 at 13th level, 3 at 17th level.

features.name: Relentless Rage
features.description: If reduced to 0 HP while raging, make DC 10 CON save; on success, drop to 1 HP instead. DC increases by 5 after each successful use.

features.name: Ability Score Improvement
features.description: Increase one ability score by 2, or two ability scores by 1 each. Maximum 20.

features.name: Persistent Rage
features.description: Rage ends early only if you fall unconscious or choose to end it.

features.name: Ability Score Improvement
features.description: Increase one ability score by 2, or two ability scores by 1 each. Maximum 20.

features.name: Indomitable Might
features.description: If your total for a STR check is less than your STR score, use your STR score instead.

features.name: Ability Score Improvement
features.description: Increase one ability score by 2, or two ability scores by 1 each. Maximum 20.

features.name: Primal Champion
features.description: STR and CON scores increase by 4 each. Maximum becomes 24.

Berserker.description: A barbarian driven by fury, trading exhaustion for devastating power.

features.name: Frenzy
features.description: When you rage, you can go berserk: gain one extra melee attack as a bonus action each turn while raging. Suffer one level of exhaustion when rage ends.

features.name: Mindless Rage
features.description: Immune to the charmed and frightened conditions while raging.

features.name: Intimidating Presence
features.description: Action: one creature within 30 ft makes WIS save (DC 8 + PROF + CHA mod) or is frightened of you for 1 minute. Can repeat save each turn. Usable once per short rest.

features.name: Retaliation
features.description: Reaction: when a creature within 5 ft deals damage to you, make one melee weapon attack against that creature.

Totem Warrior.description: A barbarian who channels the power of animal spirits.

features.name: Totem Spirit
features.description: Choose a totem animal. Bear: resistance to all damage except psychic while raging. Eagle: creatures have disadvantage on attacks against you from more than 5 ft away while raging; +2 speed while raging. Wolf: allies have advantage on melee attacks against enemies within 5 ft of you while you rage.

features.name: Aspect of the Beast
features.description: Gain a feature based on your totem. Bear: double carrying capacity. Eagle: sight to 1 mile, no disadvantage on Perception in dim light. Wolf: track at fast pace, stealth at normal pace without penalty.

features.name: Spirit Walker
features.description: Cast commune with nature as a ritual.

features.name: Totemic Attunement
features.description: Bear: enemies within 5 ft have disadvantage on attacks not targeting you while you rage. Eagle: fly 30 ft for one turn when not wearing medium/heavy armor or encumbered. Wolf: knock a Large or smaller creature prone on melee hit while raging (no save).

Ancestral Guardian.description: Spirits of ancestors protect the barbarian and their allies.

features.name: Ancestral Protectors
features.description: When you hit a creature with a melee attack while raging, spectral guardians harass the target. The target has disadvantage on attacks against anyone but you, and allies have resistance to damage from the target's attacks. Lasts until start of your next turn.

features.name: Spirit Shield
features.description: Reaction: when a creature within 30 ft takes damage, reduce it by 2d6 (3d6 at 10th, 4d6 at 14th). Must be raging.

features.name: Consult the Spirits
features.description: Cast augury or clairvoyance as a ritual (WIS as spellcasting ability).

features.name: Vengeful Ancestors
features.description: When Spirit Shield reduces damage, the attacker takes force damage equal to the amount reduced.

Storm Herald.description: A barbarian wreathed in elemental storm energy.

features.name: Storm Aura
features.description: While raging, a 10-ft aura surrounds you. Desert: each creature of your choice in aura takes 2 fire damage (3 at 5th, 4 at 10th, 5 at 15th, 6 at 20th). Sea: each creature of your choice takes 2 lightning damage (scaling same). Tundra: each creature of your choice gains 2 temp HP (scaling same).

features.name: Storm Soul
features.description: Desert: resistance to fire, creatures that touch you or hit you with melee take fire damage equal to PROF bonus. Sea: resistance to lightning, swim speed 30 ft, melee hits deal extra lightning damage equal to PROF bonus while raging. Tundra: resistance to cold, creatures in aura have resistance to cold; you gain cold immunity at 10th.

features.name: Shielding Storm
features.description: Reaction: when you or a creature in your aura takes damage, grant resistance to that damage type until start of your next turn. Must be raging. Once per long rest (or 2 at 17th).

features.name: Raging Storm
features.description: Desert: creature in aura that takes fire damage from Storm Aura must make STR save or be knocked prone. Sea: when you hit a creature in aura with melee, reduce its speed by 10 ft. Tundra: when a creature in aura takes cold damage from your Storm Aura, it cannot take reactions until start of its next turn.

Zealot.description: A barbarian fueled by divine fury.

features.name: Divine Fury
features.description: While raging, the first creature you hit on each of your turns with a melee weapon takes extra damage equal to 1d6 + half your barbarian level. Damage type: radiant or necrotic (your choice when you gain this feature).

features.name: Warrior of the Gods
features.description: Spells that restore you to life (except wish) can be cast without material components.

features.name: Fanatical Focus
features.description: When you fail a saving throw while raging, you can reroll it and must use the new roll. Once per rage.

features.name: Zealous Presence
features.description: Bonus action while raging: up to 10 creatures of your choice within 60 ft gain advantage on attack rolls and saving throws until start of your next turn. Once per long rest.

Beast.description: A barbarian who transforms with bestial traits.

features.name: Form of the Beast
features.description: When you rage, choose a natural weapon: Bite (melee, 1d8 piercing, gain temp HP equal to CON mod + PROF on hit), Claws (melee, 1d6 slashing, extra attack as bonus action), or Tail (melee, 1d8 piercing, +1d12 to AC against one attack as reaction). All count as simple melee weapons you are proficient with.

features.name: Bestial Soul
features.description: Choose one: swim speed equal to walking speed, climb speed equal to walking speed, or jump distance is doubled. Can change choice each long rest.

features.name: Infectious Fury
features.description: When you hit a creature with your natural weapon while raging, you can use a bonus action to force a WIS save (DC 8 + PROF + CON mod). On fail: target uses reaction to make one melee attack against a creature you choose, or takes 2d12 psychic damage. Once per rage.

features.name: Call the Hunt
features.description: When you hit a creature with your natural weapon while raging, you can mark the target. Each ally within 30 ft gains advantage on the first attack against the marked target. You can mark one creature per turn, up to PROF bonus marks per rage.

Wild Magic.description: A barbarian whose rage unleashes unpredictable magical effects.

features.name: Magic Awareness
features.description: Action: sense the presence of magic within 30 ft. Learn the school of any magic detected.

features.name: Wild Surge
features.description: When you rage, roll on the Wild Surge table. Effects include: teleport 15 ft, force damage to nearby creatures, advantage on next attack, extra damage on next hit, etc.

features.name: Bolstering Magic
features.description: Bonus action: touch one creature. Roll 1d6 (or 2d6 at 14th): they regain that many spell slots of 3rd level or lower, or gain that many d6 bonus damage on next attack. Once per long rest (or 2 at 14th).

features.name: Unstable Backlash
features.description: When you take damage or fail a save while raging, roll on the Wild Surge table as a reaction.

features.name: Controlled Surge
features.description: When you roll on the Wild Surge table, you can roll twice and choose which effect occurs.

starting_equipment: Chain mail or leather armor and longbow with 20 arrows
Martial weapon and shield or two martial weapons
Light crossbow with 20 bolts or two handaxes

features.name: Fighting Style
features.description: Choose one: Archery (+2 ranged attack), Defense (+1 AC while wearing armor), Dueling (+2 damage with one-handed weapon in one hand, no other weapon), Great Weapon Fighting (reroll 1s and 2s on damage with two-handed or versatile weapons), Protection (impose disadvantage on attack vs ally within 5 ft as reaction with shield), Two-Weapon Fighting (add ability modifier to off-hand damage).

features.name: Second Wind
features.description: Bonus action: regain 1d10 + fighter level HP. Once per short rest.

features.name: Action Surge
features.description: On your turn, take one additional action. One use per short rest (2 uses at 17th level).
