Champion.description: A fighter who excels at raw physical prowess and critical strikes.

features.name: Improved Critical
features.description: Your weapon attacks score a critical hit on a roll of 19 or 20.

features.name: Remarkable Athlete
features.description: Add half your proficiency bonus (rounded up) to any STR, DEX, or CON check that doesn't already include proficiency. Running long jump distance increases by a number of feet equal to your STR modifier.

features.name: Additional Fighting Style
features.description: Choose a second Fighting Style from the fighter list.

features.name: Superior Critical
features.description: Your weapon attacks score a critical hit on a roll of 18-20.

features.name: Survivor
features.description: At the start of each of your turns, regain HP equal to 5 + CON modifier if you have less than half your HP maximum. No effect if unconscious.

Battle Master.description: A fighter who uses combat maneuvers and tactical superiority.

features.name: Combat Superiority
features.description: Gain 4 d8 superiority dice (5 at 7th, 6 at 10th, 7 at 13th, 8 at 15th, 9 at 18th). Dice become d10 at 10th and d12 at 18th. Learn 3 maneuvers from the Battle Master list.

features.name: Student of War
features.description: Gain proficiency with one artisan's tool of your choice and one maneuver.

features.name: Know Your Enemy
features.description: Spend 1 minute observing a creature outside combat: learn if its STR, DEX, and CON are superior, equal, or inferior to yours. Also learn one additional maneuver.

features.name: Improved Combat Superiority
features.description: Superiority dice become d10. Learn one additional maneuver.

features.name: Relentless
features.description: When you roll initiative and have no superiority dice remaining, regain 1 superiority die. Learn one additional maneuver.

features.name: Superior Combat Superiority
features.description: Superiority dice become d12. Learn one additional maneuver.

Eldritch Knight.description: A fighter who wields arcane magic alongside martial skill.

features.name: Spellcasting
features.description: Cast wizard spells. See spellcasting block for slots and spells known.

features.name: Weapon Bond
features.description: Spend 1 hour bonding with one weapon. You have advantage on attacks with it and can summon it to your hand as a bonus action. Cannot be disarmed. Can bond with 2 weapons at 7th level.

features.name: War Magic
features.description: When you use your action to cast a cantrip, you can make one weapon attack as a bonus action.

features.name: Eldritch Strike
features.description: When you hit a creature with a weapon attack, that creature has disadvantage on the next saving throw it makes against a spell you cast before the end of your next turn.

features.name: Arcane Charge
features.description: When you use Action Surge, you can teleport up to 30 ft to an unoccupied space you can see before or after the additional action.

features.name: Improved War Magic
features.description: When you use your action to cast a spell, you can make one weapon attack as a bonus action (replaces War Magic).

Cavalier.description: A fighter who excels at mounted combat and protecting allies.

features.name: Bonus Proficiency
features.description: Gain proficiency in one of: Animal Handling, History, Insight, Performance, or Persuasion. Also gain proficiency with leatherworker's tools.

features.name: Born to the Saddle
features.description: Advantage on saves to avoid falling off a mount. Mounting or dismounting costs 5 ft of movement instead of half your speed.

features.name: Unwavering Mark
features.description: When you hit a creature with a melee weapon, mark it for 1 minute. The marked creature has disadvantage on attacks against anyone but you. If it hits someone else, you can make a bonus action melee attack against it with advantage. Use equal to PROF bonus per long rest.

features.name: Warding Maneuver
features.description: Reaction: when a creature you can see attacks an ally within 5 ft, roll 1d8 + PROF bonus and add it to ally's AC or subtract from attack roll. If ally is not wearing armor or wearing light armor, roll 1d8 twice and use higher. PROF/long rest.

features.name: Hold the Line
features.description: Creatures provoke opportunity attacks from you when they move more than 5 ft while within your reach. On a hit with an opportunity attack, reduce the target's speed to 0 for the rest of the turn.

features.name: Ferocious Charger
features.description: If you move at least 10 ft toward a creature and hit with a melee weapon on the same turn, target must succeed on STR save (DC 8 + PROF + STR mod) or be knocked prone. Once per short rest (2 at 18th).

features.name: Vigilant Defender
features.description: Opportunity attacks made by you have advantage. You can make one additional opportunity attack per round without using your reaction.

Samurai.description: A fighter who channels fierce determination and fighting spirit.

features.name: Fighting Spirit
features.description: Bonus action: gain advantage on all weapon attack rolls until end of current turn, and gain 5 temp HP (10 at 10th, 15 at 15th). Three uses per long rest.

features.name: Bonus Proficiency
features.description: Gain proficiency in one of: History, Insight, Performance, or Persuasion. Also learn one language of your choice.

features.name: Elegant Courtier
features.description: Add WIS modifier to CHA (Persuasion) checks. If proficient in Persuasion, double proficiency bonus.

features.name: Tireless Spirit
features.description: When you roll initiative and have no Fighting Spirit uses remaining, regain 1 use.

features.name: Rapid Strike
features.description: When you have advantage on a weapon attack, you can forgo the advantage to make an additional attack with the same weapon against the same target. Once per turn.

features.name: Strength Before Death
features.description: When reduced to 0 HP by damage, can take a whole turn right after the current turn ends, then make a DC 10 CON save; on success, drop to 1 HP instead of 0. Once per long rest.

Arcane Archer.description: A fighter who imbues arrows with magical effects.

features.name: Arcane Arrow
features.description: Once per turn when you fire an arrow from a shortbow or longbow, you can apply an Arcane Shot. You know 2 Arcane Shot options. Arcane Shots deal an extra 2d6 force damage on hit (4d6 at 18th). Use twice per short rest.

features.name: Magical Guidance
features.description: Learn one wizard cantrip that requires an attack roll. INT is your spellcasting ability for it.

features.name: Arcane Shot Improvement
features.description: Learn one additional Arcane Shot option. Extra damage becomes 2d6 (unchanged).

features.name: Curving Shot
features.description: When you miss with an Arcane Arrow, you can use a bonus action to reroll the attack against a different target within 60 ft. Learn one additional Arcane Shot.

features.name: Arcane Shot Improvement
features.description: Learn one additional Arcane Shot option.

features.name: Ever-Ready Shot
features.description: When you roll initiative and have no Arcane Shot uses remaining, regain 1 use. Extra damage from Arcane Arrow becomes 4d6. Learn one additional Arcane Shot.

Psi Warrior.description: A fighter who channels psionic energy to enhance combat.

features.name: Psionic Power
features.description: Gain psionic energy dice: 4d8 + INT mod (6d8 at 5th, 8d8 at 11th, 10d8 at 17th). Dice become d10 at 11th and d12 at 17th. As a bonus action, choose: Protective Field (reduce damage to self or ally within 30 ft by 1d8 + INT mod), or Telekinetic Movement (move self or willing creature 5 ft per die expended).

features.name: Telekinetic Adept
features.description: When you hit with a weapon attack, expend one psionic die to deal extra force damage equal to the die roll + INT mod. Can also push the target 5 ft per die expended on a failed STR save.

features.name: Guarded Mind
features.description: Resistance to psychic damage. When you fail an INT, WIS, or CHA save, expend one psionic die to add the roll to the total, potentially turning a failure into a success.

features.name: Bulwark of Force
features.description: When you or an ally within 30 ft is hit by an attack, expend one psionic die to grant half cover (+2 AC and DEX saves) until start of your next turn.

features.name: Telekinetic Master
features.description: Expend 3 psionic dice to cast telekinesis (INT as spellcasting ability) without concentration. You can maintain it while raging.

features.name: Telekinetic Grandmaster
features.description: When you use Telekinetic Movement, you can move the target up to 30 ft. When you hit with a weapon attack, you can expend up to 3 psionic dice for extra force damage.

Rune Knight.description: A fighter who carves magical runes for giant-like power.

features.name: Rune Carver
features.description: Learn 2 runes from the list (3 at 7th, 4 at 10th, 5 at 15th). Each rune provides a passive benefit and an active invocation (bonus action, PROF/long rest). Runes: Cloud, Fire, Frost, Hill, Stone, Storm, Wind.

features.name: Giant's Might
features.description: Bonus action: gain the following for 1 minute: advantage on STR checks and saves, +1d6 bonus damage on weapon attacks (1d8 at 11th, 1d10 at 17th), and grow one size larger. PROF/long rest.

features.name: Defensive Rune
features.description: When you or an ally within 60 ft is hit by an attack, use your reaction to invoke a rune and add 1d6 + PROF bonus to the target's AC, potentially causing the attack to miss.

features.name: Great Stature
features.description: When you use Giant's Might, your reach increases by 5 ft. Learn one additional rune.

features.name: Runic Mastery
features.description: When you invoke a rune, you can choose to invoke it without expending a use. Once per long rest. Learn one additional rune.

features.name: Titan's Vigor
features.description: While Giant's Might is active, your HP maximum increases by an amount equal to your fighter level, and you gain that many temporary HP.

tools: One artisan's tool or one musical instrument

features.description: AC = 10 + DEX modifier + WIS modifier while not wearing armor or using a shield.

features.name: Martial Arts
features.description: While unarmed or using monk weapons (shortswords, simple melee weapons without two-handed/heavy), use DEX instead of STR for attacks, roll a martial arts die (1d4 at 1st, 1d6 at 5th, 1d8 at 11th, 1d10 at 17th) for damage, and make one unarmed strike as a bonus action after taking the Attack action.

features.name: Ki
features.description: Gain ki points equal to your monk level. Ki save DC = 8 + PROF bonus + WIS modifier. Spend ki to use: Flurry of Blows (1 ki, two unarmed strikes as bonus action after Attack), Patient Defense (1 ki, Dodge as bonus action), Step of the Wind (1 ki, Dash or Disengage as bonus action, jump distance doubled).

features.name: Unarmored Movement
features.description: Speed increases by 10 ft while not wearing armor or using a shield (+15 at 6th, +20 at 10th, +25 at 14th, +30 at 18th). At 9th level, can run on vertical surfaces and water without falling during your turn.

features.name: Monastic Tradition
features.description: Choose a Monastic Tradition subclass that grants features at levels 3, 6, 11, and 17.

features.name: Deflect Missiles
features.description: Reaction: when hit by a ranged weapon attack, reduce damage by 1d10 + DEX mod + monk level. If reduced to 0, can spend 1 ki to make a ranged attack with the missile (range 20/60, damage = martial arts die).

features.name: Slow Fall
features.description: Reaction: when falling, reduce falling damage by 5 × monk level.

features.name: Stunning Strike
features.description: When you hit a creature with a melee weapon attack, spend 1 ki to attempt to stun: target makes CON save or is stunned until end of your next turn.

features.name: Ki-Empowered Strikes
features.description: Your unarmed strikes count as magical for overcoming resistance and immunity to nonmagical attacks and damage.

features.name: Evasion
features.description: When subjected to an effect that allows a DEX save for half damage, take no damage on success and half damage on failure. No benefit if incapacitated.

features.name: Stillness of Mind
features.description: Action: end one effect on yourself causing you to be charmed or frightened.

features.name: Ability Score Improvement
features.description: Increase one ability score by 2, or two ability scores by 1 each. Maximum 20.

features.name: Purity of Body
features.description: Immune to disease and poison.

features.name: Ability Score Improvement
features.description: Increase one ability score by 2, or two ability scores by 1 each. Maximum 20.

features.name: Tongue of the Sun and Moon
features.description: Understand all spoken languages. Any creature that can understand a language can understand your speech.

features.name: Diamond Soul
features.description: Proficiency in all saving throws. When you fail a saving throw, spend 1 ki to reroll it and must use the new roll.

features.name: Timeless Body
features.description: You suffer none of the frailty of old age and cannot be aged magically. Still die of old age when time is up.

features.name: Ability Score Improvement
features.description: Increase one ability score by 2, or two ability scores by 1 each. Maximum 20.

features.name: Empty Body
features.description: Action: spend 4 ki to become invisible for 1 minute. During that time, you have resistance to all damage except force. Also, as a reaction when you take damage, spend 1 ki to cast astral projection (self only).

features.name: Ability Score Improvement
features.description: Increase one ability score by 2, or two ability scores by 1 each. Maximum 20.

features.name: Perfect Self
features.description: When you roll initiative and have no ki remaining, regain 4 ki points.

Open Hand.description: A monk who manipulates ki to control enemies in melee.

features.name: Open Hand Technique
features.description: When you hit with Flurry of Blows, choose one per target: push 15 ft away, knock prone, or target cannot take reactions until end of your next turn. No save for push/prone option on hit.

features.name: Wholeness of Body
features.description: Action: heal yourself for 3 × monk level HP. Once per long rest.

features.name: Tranquility
features.description: At the end of a long rest, gain the effect of a sanctuary spell (WIS save DC 8 + PROF + WIS mod) that lasts until you attack, cast a spell, or start a new long rest.

features.name: Quivering Palm
features.description: When you hit a creature with an unarmed strike, spend 3 ki: target must make CON save. On fail, drop to 0 HP. On success, take 10d10 necrotic damage. You can hold the effect for monk level days before using an action to trigger the save. Once per long rest.

Four Elements.description: A monk who commands the elements through ki.

features.name: Disciple of the Elements
features.description: Learn elemental disciplines that let you spend ki to create elemental effects. Choose 2 disciplines at 3rd (3 at 6th, 4 at 11th, 5 at 17th). Disciplines include: Fangs of the Fire Snake, Fist of Four Thunders, Fist of Unbroken Air, Rush of the Gale Spirits, Shape the Flowing River, Sweeping Cinder Strike, Water Whip, and more.

features.name: Additional Elemental Discipline
features.description: Learn one additional elemental discipline. Higher-level disciplines become available.

features.name: Additional Elemental Discipline
features.description: Learn one additional elemental discipline.

features.name: Additional Elemental Discipline
features.description: Learn one additional elemental discipline.

Shadow.description: A monk who manipulates darkness and shadow.

features.name: Shadow Arts
features.description: Can cast minor illusion (no components, WIS as spellcasting ability). Spend 2 ki to cast darkness, darkvision, pass without trace, or silence.

features.name: Shadow Step
features.description: Bonus action: teleport up to 60 ft from one dim light/darkness area to another you can see. On your next melee attack before end of turn, you have advantage.

features.name: Cloak of Shadows
features.description: Action: spend 2 ki to become invisible until end of your next turn or until you attack, cast a spell, or enter bright light. Requires dim light or darkness.

features.name: Opportunist
features.description: Reaction: when another creature hits a creature within 5 ft of you, make one melee attack against the hit creature.

Drunken Master.description: A monk whose erratic movements confound enemies.

features.name: Drunken Technique
features.description: When you use Flurry of Blows, gain +10 ft speed and you do not provoke opportunity attacks until end of your turn.

features.name: Tipsy Sway
features.description: Reaction: when a creature misses you with a melee attack, redirect the attack to another creature within range.

features.name: Drunkard's Luck
features.description: When you make an ability check, attack roll, or saving throw with disadvantage, spend 2 ki to ignore disadvantage on that roll.

features.name: Intoxicated Frenzy
features.description: When you use Flurry of Blows, you can make up to three additional unarmed strikes (five total), each against a different target.

Kensei.description: A monk who masters weapons as extensions of ki.

features.name: Kensei Weapons
features.description: Choose 2 melee and 1 ranged weapon that lack heavy or special properties; these are kensei weapons. Count as monk weapons for you. Can change one weapon choice when you gain a monk level.

features.name: Agile Parry
features.description: If you make an unarmed strike as part of your Attack action and are holding a kensei weapon, gain +2 AC until start of next turn.

features.name: Kensei's Shot
features.description: Bonus action: spend 1 ki to add 1d4 damage (1d6 at 11th, 1d8 at 17th) to your ranged kensei weapon attacks until end of turn.

features.name: One with the Blade
features.description: Kensei weapons count as magical for overcoming resistance. When you hit with a kensei weapon, spend 1 ki to deal extra martial arts die damage.

features.name: Sharpen the Blade
features.description: Bonus action: spend up to 3 ki to give a kensei weapon +1 to attack and damage per ki spent for 1 minute or until you use this feature again.

features.name: Unerring Accuracy
features.description: Once per turn when you miss with a kensei weapon attack, you can reroll the attack roll.

Sun Soul.description: A monk who channels radiant energy.

features.name: Radiant Sun Bolt
features.description: Ranged spell attack: 30 ft range, 1d4 radiant damage (1d6 at 11th, 1d8 at 17th). Can be used with Flurry of Blows (replace unarmed strikes with sun bolts). Counts as a monk weapon.

features.name: Searing Arc Strike
features.description: After using Flurry of Blows, spend 2 ki to cast burning hands (3d6 fire, DEX save) in a 30-ft line from you. INT is your spellcasting ability.

features.name: Searing Sunburst
features.description: Action: spend 3 ki to create a 30-ft radius sphere of light centered on a point within 60 ft. Creatures: CON save or take 6d6 radiant damage and are blinded for 1 minute (save to end blindness).

features.name: Sun Shield
features.description: Permanent 30-ft aura of bright light. When a creature hits you with a melee attack, it takes 2d6 + WIS mod radiant damage. You can suppress the aura as a bonus action.

Mercy.description: A monk who wields ki to heal or harm with a touch.

features.name: Implements of Mercy
features.description: Gain proficiency in Medicine and one of: Insight, Investigation, or Religion. Also gain proficiency with herbalism kit and poisoner's kit.

features.name: Hand of Mercy
features.description: When you hit with Flurry of Blows, choose one per target: deal extra 1d4 necrotic damage (1d6 at 11th, 1d8 at 17th), or restore 1d4 + WIS mod HP to the target (1d6 at 11th, 1d8 at 17th).

features.name: Physician's Touch
features.description: When you use Hand of Mercy to heal, can also end one disease or one of: blinded, deafened, paralyzed, poisoned, or stunned. When dealing necrotic damage, can impose the poisoned condition for 1 minute (CON save to end).

features.name: Flurry of Healing and Harm
features.description: When you use Flurry of Blows, can replace one unarmed strike with a use of Hand of Mercy without spending ki. Can also spend 1 ki to use Hand of Mercy as a bonus action without Flurry of Blows.

features.name: Hand of Ultimate Mercy
features.description: Action: touch a creature that died within the last hour and spend 5 ki to return it to life with 1 HP. Cannot revive creatures killed by old age or disintegration. Once per long rest.

Astral Self.description: A monk who manifests an astral form through ki.

features.name: Arms of the Astral Self
features.description: Bonus action: spend 1 ki to summon spectral arms for 10 minutes. Your unarmed strikes use WIS instead of STR/DEX for attack and damage, and have 10-ft reach. Arms make unarmed strikes as part of your Attack action.

features.name: Eyes of the Astral Self
features.description: When Arms of Astral Self is active, you can see normally in darkness (both magical and nonmagical) to 60 ft, and you have advantage on checks to detect illusions and invisible creatures.

features.name: Body of the Astral Self
features.description: When Arms of Astral Self is active, your AC increases by 2 and you gain resistance to force damage. Your unarmed strikes deal force damage instead of bludgeoning.

features.name: Awakened Astral Self
features.description: When Arms of Astral Self is active, you gain the following: additional 10-ft reach on unarmed strikes (20 ft total), when you hit a creature with an unarmed strike you can spend 1 ki to force a WIS save or the creature is frightened of you for 1 minute, and your unarmed strikes score a critical hit on 19-20.

starting_equipment: Martial weapon and shield or two martial weapons
Five javelins or any simple melee weapon
Chain mail and a holy symbol

features.name: Divine Sense
features.description: Action: detect celestials, fiends, and undead within 60 ft. Also detect consecrated/desecrated places/objects. Uses equal to 1 + CHA modifier per long rest.

features.name: Lay on Hands
features.description: Pool of HP equal to 5 × paladin level. Touch a creature as an action to restore HP from the pool. Alternatively, expend 5 HP to cure one disease or neutralize one poison.

features.name: Fighting Style
features.description: Choose one: Defense (+1 AC while wearing armor), Dueling (+2 damage with one-handed weapon, no other weapon), Great Weapon Fighting (reroll 1s and 2s on damage with two-handed/versatile weapons), Protection (impose disadvantage on attack vs ally as reaction with shield).

features.name: Spellcasting
features.description: Cast paladin spells. See spellcasting block for details.

features.name: Divine Smite
features.description: When you hit with a melee weapon attack, expend one spell slot to deal 2d8 radiant damage (+1d8 per slot level above 1st). Against undead/fiends, +1d8 extra damage. Max 5d8 base + 1d8 undead/fiend bonus.

features.name: Sacred Oath
features.description: Choose a Sacred Oath subclass. Gain Channel Divinity and oath spells at 3rd level. Features at 3rd, 7th, 15th, and 20th levels.

features.name: Channel Divinity
features.description: Gain Channel Divinity with two options determined by your Sacred Oath. Can use Channel Divinity once per short rest (2 at 5th, 3 at 11th, 4 at 17th). Also gain Turn the Unholy and Lay on Hands improvements.

features.name: Ability Score Improvement
features.description: Increase one ability score by 2, or two ability scores by 1 each. Maximum 20.

features.name: Extra Attack
features.description: Attack twice instead of once when taking the Attack action.

features.name: Aura of Protection
features.description: You and friendly creatures within 10 ft gain a bonus to all saving throws equal to your CHA modifier. You must be conscious.

features.name: Sacred Oath Feature
features.description: Gain a feature from your Sacred Oath.

features.name: Ability Score Improvement
features.description: Increase one ability score by 2, or two ability scores by 1 each. Maximum 20.

features.name: Aura of Courage
features.description: You and friendly creatures within 10 ft are immune to the frightened condition. You must be conscious.

features.name: Improved Divine Smite
features.description: Every melee weapon hit deals an extra 1d8 radiant damage. Stacks with Divine Smite.

features.name: Ability Score Improvement
features.description: Increase one ability score by 2, or two ability scores by 1 each. Maximum 20.

features.name: Cleansing Touch
features.description: Action: end one spell on yourself or one willing creature you touch. Uses equal to CHA modifier per long rest.

features.name: Sacred Oath Feature
features.description: Gain a feature from your Sacred Oath.

features.name: Ability Score Improvement
features.description: Increase one ability score by 2, or two ability scores by 1 each. Maximum 20.

features.name: Aura Improvement
features.description: Aura of Protection and Aura of Courage extend to 30 ft.

features.name: Ability Score Improvement
features.description: Increase one ability score by 2, or two ability scores by 1 each. Maximum 20.

features.name: Sacred Oath Feature
features.description: Gain a capstone feature from your Sacred Oath.

Devotion.description: A paladin sworn to the ideals of righteousness and justice.

features.name: Oath Spells
features.description: Oath spells are always prepared and don't count against your prepared spells. 3rd: sanctuary, shield of faith. 5th: lesser restoration, zone of truth. 9th: beacon of hope, dispel magic. 13th: freedom of movement, guardian of faith. 17th: commune, flame strike.

features.name: Channel Divinity: Sacred Weapon
features.description: Action: add CHA modifier (min +1) to your weapon attacks for 1 minute. The weapon emits bright light 20 ft.

features.name: Channel Divinity: Turn the Unholy
features.description: Action: each fiend/undead within 30 ft that can see/hear you makes WIS save or is turned for 1 minute.

features.name: Aura of Devotion
features.description: You and creatures within 10 ft are immune to the charmed condition while you are conscious.

features.name: Purity of Spirit
features.description: You are always under the effect of a protection from evil and good spell.

features.name: Holy Nimbus
features.description: Action: emanate sunlight 30 ft for 1 minute. Enemies in the light take 10d6 radiant damage when they start their turn or enter for the first time. You have advantage on saves. Once per long rest.

Ancients.description: A paladin sworn to preserve the light of life and joy.

features.name: Oath Spells
features.description: Oath spells always prepared. 3rd: ensnaring strike, speak with animals. 5th: moonbeam, misty step. 9th: plant growth, protection from energy. 13th: ice storm, stoneskin. 17th: commune with nature, tree stride.

features.name: Channel Divinity: Nature's Wrath
features.description: Action: spectral vines restrain one Large or smaller creature within 10 ft; STR save or restrained for 1 minute (save at end of each turn).

features.name: Channel Divinity: Turn the Faithless
features.description: Action: each fey or fiend within 30 ft makes WIS save or is turned for 1 minute.

features.name: Aura of Warding
features.description: You and creatures within 10 ft have resistance to damage from spells while you are conscious.

features.name: Undying Sentinel
features.description: When reduced to 0 HP but not killed outright, drop to 1 HP instead. Once per long rest (2 at 20th). You also age 10 years slower.

features.name: Elder Champion
features.description: Action: become an ancient force of nature for 1 minute. Regain 10 HP at start of each turn, spells you cast only cost 1 action (not bonus action), and enemies within 10 ft have disadvantage on saves against your spells/Channel Divinity. Once per long rest.

Vengeance.description: A paladin sworn to punish those who commit grievous sins.

features.name: Oath Spells
features.description: Oath spells always prepared. 3rd: bane, hunter's mark. 5th: hold person, misty step. 9th: haste, protection from energy. 13th: banishment, dimension door. 17th: hold monster, scrying.

features.name: Channel Divinity: Abjure Enemy
features.description: Action: one creature within 60 ft makes WIS save or is frightened for 1 minute. If it fails by 5+, it is paralyzed while frightened. Save at end of each turn.

features.name: Channel Divinity: Vow of Enmity
features.description: Bonus action: mark one creature within 10 ft. You have advantage on attack rolls against it for 1 minute or until it drops to 0 HP.

features.name: Relentless Avenger
features.description: When you hit with an opportunity attack, move up to half your speed immediately after the attack as part of the reaction. This movement does not provoke opportunity attacks.

features.name: Soul of Vengeance
features.description: When a creature under your Vow of Enmity attacks an ally, you can use your reaction to make one melee weapon attack against that creature.

features.name: Avenging Angel
features.description: Action: gain flying speed 60 ft for 1 hour. Enemies within 30 ft have disadvantage on attack rolls against creatures other than you. Once per long rest.

Crown.description: A paladin sworn to uphold law, civilization, and order.

features.name: Oath Spells
features.description: Oath spells always prepared. 3rd: command, compelled duel. 5th: warding bond, zone of truth. 9th: aura of vitality, spirit guardians. 13th: banishment, guardian of faith. 17th: circle of power, geas.

features.name: Channel Divinity: Champion Challenge
features.description: Action: each creature of your choice within 30 ft must make WIS save or be unable to move more than 30 ft away from you for 1 minute (save at end of each turn).

features.name: Channel Divinity: Turn the Tide
features.description: Action: each hostile creature within 30 ft that can hear you makes WIS save or is frightened of you for 1 minute.

features.name: Divine Allegiance
features.description: When a creature within 5 ft of you takes damage, you can use your reaction to magically substitute your own HP for theirs, taking the damage instead. You cannot reduce the damage in any way.

features.name: Unyielding Spirit
features.description: You have advantage on saves against being frightened or paralyzed.

features.name: Exalted Champion
features.description: Action: become an exalted champion for 1 minute. You have resistance to bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical weapons. You have advantage on saving throws. Other creatures have disadvantage on attack rolls against you. Once per long rest.

Conquest.description: A paladin who crushes opposition through fear and domination.

features.name: Oath Spells
features.description: Oath spells always prepared. 3rd: armor of Agathys, command. 5th: hold person, spiritual weapon. 9th: bestow curse, fear. 13th: dominate beast, stoneskin. 17th: cloudkill, dominate person.

features.name: Channel Divinity: Conquering Presence
features.description: Action: each creature of your choice within 30 ft makes WIS save or becomes frightened of you for 1 minute (save at end of each turn).

features.name: Channel Divinity: Guided Strike
features.description: When you make an attack roll, add 10 to the roll. You can use this after seeing the d20 but before the outcome is determined.

features.name: Aura of Conquest
features.description: Creatures frightened of you have their speed reduced to 0 while in your aura (10 ft). They also take psychic damage equal to half your paladin level at the start of each turn while in the aura and frightened.

features.name: Scornful Rebuke
features.description: Whenever a creature hits you with an attack, that creature takes psychic damage equal to your CHA modifier (minimum 1) if you are not incapacitated.

features.name: Invincible Conqueror
features.description: Action: become an invincible conqueror for 1 minute. You have advantage on attack rolls, score critical hits on 19-20, and have resistance to all damage. Once per long rest.

Redemption.description: A paladin who seeks to redeem wrongdoers through compassion.

features.name: Oath Spells
features.description: Oath spells always prepared. 3rd: sanctuary, sleep. 5th: calm emotions, hold person. 9th: counterspell, hypnotic pattern. 13th: Otiluke's resilient sphere, stun. 17th: hold monster, mass cure wounds.

features.name: Channel Divinity: Emissary of Peace
features.description: Action: gain +5 to your next CHA (Persuasion) check within the next 10 minutes.

features.name: Channel Divinity: Rebuke the Violent
features.description: Reaction: when a creature damages another creature within your aura, the attacker makes WIS save or takes radiant damage equal to the damage dealt, and the original target is unharmed.

features.name: Aura of the Guardian
features.description: When a creature within your aura takes damage, you can use your reaction to magically take that damage instead of the creature. You take any conditions from the damage as well.

features.name: Protective Spirit
features.description: At the start of your turn, if you have at least 1 HP but half your HP maximum or fewer, regain 1d6 + half your paladin level HP.

features.name: Aura of the Redeemer
features.description: Action: emanate an aura of redemption for 1 minute. When a hostile creature within your aura deals damage to anyone but you, it takes radiant damage equal to half the damage dealt. Once per long rest.

Glory.description: A paladin who strives to achieve immortal glory through deeds.

features.name: Oath Spells
features.description: Oath spells always prepared. 3rd: enhance ability, guiding bolt. 5th: misty step, spiritual weapon. 9th: haste, protection from energy. 13th: death ward, freedom of movement. 17th: commune, dispel evil and good.

features.name: Channel Divinity: Peerless Athlete
features.description: Action: for 10 minutes, add 10 ft to your speed, double your jump distance, and gain advantage on STR (Athletics) checks.

features.name: Channel Divinity: Inspiring Smite
features.description: When you deal Divine Smite damage, use Channel Divinity to grant temp HP equal to 2d8 + CHA modifier to you and up to 3 creatures within 30 ft.

features.name: Aura of Alacrity
features.description: You and creatures within 10 ft gain +5 ft speed while you are conscious.

features.name: Glorious Defense
features.description: Reaction: when attacked, add CHA mod to AC against that attack. If the attack misses, make one weapon attack against the attacker as part of the same reaction. Once per short rest.

features.name: Living Legend
features.description: Action: for 1 minute, you gain advantage on all ability checks and saving throws, and your weapon attacks score a critical hit on 19-20. Once per long rest.

Watchers.description: A paladin sworn to guard against extraplanar threats.

features.name: Oath Spells
features.description: Oath spells always prepared. 3rd: alarm, detect evil and good. 5th: moonbeam, see invisibility. 9th: countermagic (counterspell), nymph's lore (Nondetection). 13th: aura of life, banishment. 17th: banishing smite, scrying.

features.name: Channel Divinity: Watcher's Will
features.description: Action: you and creatures within 30 ft gain advantage on saves against spells and other magical effects for 1 minute.

features.name: Channel Divinity: Abjure the Extraplanar
features.description: Action: each aberration, celestial, elemental, fey, fiend, or undead within 30 ft makes WIS save or is turned for 1 minute.

features.name: Aura of the Sentinel
features.description: You and creatures within 10 ft gain a bonus to initiative equal to your PROF bonus while you are conscious.

features.name: Vigilant Rebuke
features.description: When a creature within your aura hits you or an ally with an attack, you can use your reaction to deal 1d8 + CHA mod radiant damage to the attacker.

features.name: Mortal Bulwark
features.description: Action: for 1 minute, gain truesight 120 ft, advantage on attacks against aberrations, celestials, elementals, fey, fiends, and undead, and when you hit one with a weapon attack it takes extra 2d10 radiant damage. Once per long rest.

Oathbreaker.description: A paladin who has broken their sacred oaths and embraces darkness.

features.name: Oath Spells
features.description: Oath spells always prepared. 3rd: hellish rebuke, inflict wounds. 5th: crown of madness, darkness. 9th: animate dead, dispel magic. 13th: aura of hate, blight. 17th: contagion, destructive wave.

features.name: Channel Divinity: Control Undead
features.description: Action: one undead creature within 30 ft makes WIS save or obeys your commands for 24 hours (save at start of each 24 hours). Undead with CR above your paladin level have advantage.

features.name: Channel Divinity: Dreadful Aspect
features.description: Action: each creature of your choice within 30 ft makes WIS save or is frightened of you for 1 minute (save at end of each turn).

features.name: Aura of Hate
features.description: You and fiends/undead allies within 10 ft add CHA modifier to melee weapon damage rolls. You must be conscious.

features.name: Supernatural Resistance
features.description: Gain resistance to bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical weapons.

features.name: Dread Lord
features.description: Action: for 1 minute, emanate a 30-ft aura of shadowy dread. Enemies within aura are frightened, have disadvantage on attack rolls, and you have advantage on saves. You can end the effect to deal 4d10 necrotic to all enemies within the aura. Once per long rest.

spellcasting.spells_prepared: CHA mod + half paladin level (rounded down, minimum 1)

starting_equipment: Two shortswords or two simple melee weapons

features.name: Favored Enemy
features.description: Choose a type of favored enemy: aberrations, beasts, celestials, constructs, dragons, elementals, fey, fiends, giants, monstrosities, oozes, plants, or undead. Gain advantage on Survival checks to track them and Intelligence checks to recall info about them. Choose additional favored enemies at 6th and 14th levels.

features.name: Natural Explorer
features.description: Choose a favored terrain: arctic, coast, desert, forest, grassland, mountain, swamp, or Underdark. While traveling there for 1 hour+: difficult terrain doesn't slow group, can't become lost, remain alert while tracking/foraging, travel alone at fast pace stealthily, find food for 6. Additional terrain at 6th and 10th.

features.name: Fighting Style

features.name: Spellcasting
features.description: Cast ranger spells. See spellcasting block for details.

features.name: Ranger Archetype
features.description: Choose a Ranger Archetype subclass that grants features at levels 3, 7, 11, and 15.

features.name: Primeval Awareness
features.description: Action: expend one spell slot to sense aberrations, celestials, dragons, elementals, fey, fiends, or undead within 6 miles (1st slot = 1 mile per slot level, max 6). Learn type and count, not identity.

features.name: Ability Score Improvement

features.name: Extra Attack

features.name: Additional Favored Enemy
features.description: Choose one additional favored enemy type. Also gain +4 to damage rolls against your favored enemies.

features.name: Additional Natural Explorer
features.description: Choose one additional favored terrain.

features.name: Ranger Archetype Feature
features.description: Gain a feature from your Ranger Archetype.

features.name: Land's Stride
features.description: Moving through nonmagical difficult terrain costs no extra movement. Cannot be slowed by nonmagical plant growth. Advantage on saves against plants that restrain. Moving through normal plants doesn't cost extra.

features.name: Ability Score Improvement
features.description: Increase one ability score by 2, or two ability scores by 1 each. Maximum 20.

features.name: Hide in Plain Sight
features.description: Spend 1 minute creating camouflage: add +10 to DEX (Stealth) checks as long as you remain motionless and in the same terrain. Can only hide from creatures more than 10 ft away.

features.name: Additional Natural Explorer
features.description: Choose one additional favored terrain.

features.name: Ranger Archetype Feature
features.description: Gain a feature from your Ranger Archetype.

features.name: Ability Score Improvement
features.description: Increase one ability score by 2, or two ability scores by 1 each. Maximum 20.

features.name: Vanish
features.description: Can use Hide action as a bonus action. Cannot be tracked by nonmagical means unless you choose to leave a trail.

features.name: Ranger Archetype Feature
features.description: Gain a feature from your Ranger Archetype.

features.name: Ability Score Improvement
features.description: Increase one ability score by 2, or two ability scores by 1 each. Maximum 20.

features.name: Feral Senses
features.description: When you attack a creature you cannot see, your inability to see doesn't impose disadvantage. You are also aware of the location of invisible creatures within 30 ft.

features.name: Ability Score Improvement
features.description: Increase one ability score by 2, or two ability scores by 1 each. Maximum 20.

features.name: Foe Slayer
features.description: Once per turn, when you hit your favored enemy with a weapon attack, add your WIS modifier (min +1) to the damage roll.

Hunter.description: A ranger who adapts tactics to any combat situation.

features.name: Hunter's Prey
features.description: Choose one: Colossus Slayer (target below HP max, deal 1d8 extra damage once per turn), Giant Killer (reaction: melee attack when Large+ creature misses you within 5 ft), or Horde Breaker (once per turn, attack a second creature within 5 ft of the first if within reach).

features.name: Defensive Tactics
features.description: Choose one: Escape the Horde (opportunity attacks against you have disadvantage), Multiattack Defense (+4 AC after hit by a creature for the rest of the turn), or Steel Will (advantage on saves against frightened).

features.name: Multiattack
features.description: Choose one: Volley (attack every creature within 10 ft of a point within range with a ranged weapon), or Whirlwind Attack (melee attack against every creature within reach).

features.name: Superior Hunter's Defense
features.description: Choose one: Evasion (half/no damage on DEX saves), Stand Against the Tide (reaction: when missed by melee, attacker rerolls against another creature), or Uncanny Dodge (reaction: half damage from one attack).

Beast Master.description: A ranger who bonds with a loyal animal companion.

features.name: Ranger's Companion
features.description: Bond with a beast of CR 1/4 or lower. Add PROF bonus to its AC, attacks, damage, and saves. It takes its turn on your initiative. Command it as bonus action: attack, dash, disengage, dodge, or help. If you are incapacitated, it can act independently. It gains extra HP at higher levels. If it dies, can bond with a new one after 8 hours.

features.name: Exceptional Training
features.description: Command beast as bonus action without requiring an action for Dash, Disengage, Dodge, or Help. Beast's attacks count as magical for overcoming resistance.

features.name: Bestial Fury
features.description: Your beast companion can make two attacks when you command it to attack, or make one attack as a reaction when you cast a ranger spell.

features.name: Share Spells
features.description: When you cast a spell targeting yourself, you can also affect your beast companion if within 30 ft.

Gloom Stalker.description: A ranger who hunts in the darkness of the Underdark.

features.name: Dread Ambusher
features.description: Gain +WIS mod to initiative. On the first turn of combat, gain +10 ft speed and can make one extra weapon attack with 1d8 extra damage if you take the Attack action.

features.name: Umbral Sight
features.description: Gain 60 ft darkvision (or +30 ft if you already have it). While in darkness, you are invisible to creatures relying on darkvision to see you.

features.name: Iron Mind
features.description: Gain proficiency in WIS saves. If already proficient, choose STR or CHA instead.

features.name: Stalker's Flurry
features.description: Once per turn when you miss with a weapon attack, you can make another attack immediately against the same target.

features.name: Shadowy Dodge
features.description: When an attack is made against you and you can see the attacker, you can use your reaction to impose disadvantage on the attack roll. Must be in dim light or darkness.

Horizon Walker.description: A ranger who traverses the boundaries between planes.

features.name: Planar Warrior
features.description: Bonus action: choose one creature you can see. Your next weapon attack against it this turn deals extra 1d8 force damage (2d8 at 11th). If you hit, the target cannot teleport until start of your next turn.

features.name: Detect Portal
features.description: Cast detect magic as a ritual. Also know distance and direction to the nearest portal within 1 mile. Once per short rest.

features.name: Ethereal Step
features.description: Bonus action: cast etherealness on yourself for the start of your next turn. Once per short rest (2 at 15th).

features.name: Distant Strike
features.description: When you take the Attack action, you can teleport up to 10 ft before each attack to an unoccupied space you can see. If you attack at least two different creatures, make one additional attack.

features.name: Spectral Defense
features.description: Reaction: when you take damage, halve that damage against you.

Monster Slayer.description: A ranger who specializes in hunting deadly threats.

features.name: Slayer's Prey
features.description: Bonus action: mark one creature you can see. Deal 1d6 extra damage the first time you hit it each turn. Mark lasts until you use this again or target dies.

features.name: Hunter's Sense
features.description: Action: learn one of the following about a creature you can see within 60 ft: damage vulnerabilities, damage resistances, damage immunities, or condition immunities. PROF/long rest.

features.name: Supernatural Defense
features.description: When the target of your Slayer's Prey forces you to make a save, add 1d6 to the roll.

features.name: Magic-User's Nemesis
features.description: Reaction: when a creature within 30 ft casts a spell, make a weapon attack against the caster. On hit, the spell fails and has no effect. If the attack misses, the spell continues. Once per short rest.

features.name: Slayer's Counter
features.description: When the target of your Slayer's Prey forces you to make a save, you can use your reaction to make one weapon attack against it. On hit, add the attack's damage to the save total. On miss, save is rolled normally.

Fey Wanderer.description: A ranger who walks between the mortal world and the Feywild.

features.name: Fey Wanderer Magic
features.description: Learn additional spells: charm person, misty step (5th), blink (9th), dominate beast (13th), seeming (17th). Always prepared, don't count against spells known.

features.name: Dreadful Strikes
features.description: When you hit a creature with a weapon, deal extra 1d4 psychic damage (1d6 at 11th). Once per turn. When you hit a creature affected by your Slayer's Prey or a condition, you can deal this damage on every hit.

features.name: Blessing of the Courts
features.description: Add 1d6 to CHA (Persuasion, Deception, Performance, and Intimidation) checks.

features.name: Fey Reinforcements
features.description: Spend 1 minute and 1 spell slot to summon a fey creature (CR equal to slot level or lower). It follows your commands for 1 hour or until it drops to 0 HP.

features.name: Misty Wanderer
features.description: Cast misty step without expending a spell slot. You can also bring one willing creature within 5 ft. PROF/long rest.

Swarmkeeper.description: A ranger surrounded by a swarm of nature spirits.

features.name: Swarmkeeper Magic
features.description: Learn additional spells: faerie fire, web (5th), gaseous form (9th), arcane eye (13th), insect plague (17th). Always prepared, don't count against spells known.

features.name: Gathered Swarm
features.description: Spirits surround you. Once per turn when you hit with a weapon attack, deal extra 1d6 piercing damage (2d6 at 11th). Alternatively, push/pull the target 5 ft or move yourself 5 ft without provoking opportunity attacks.

features.name: Writhing Tide
features.description: You gain half cover from the swarm. Creatures that start their turn within 5 ft take piercing damage equal to your PROF bonus.

features.name: Storm of Minions
features.description: Your swarm becomes a storm. When you use Gathered Swarm, each creature within 10 ft of you takes piercing damage equal to your PROF bonus.

features.name: Swarming Dispersal
features.description: When you take damage, use your reaction to teleport up to 30 ft to an unoccupied space and reduce the damage by your Gathered Swarm damage die. PROF/long rest.

Drakewarden.description: A ranger bonded with a drake companion.

features.name: Drake Companion
features.description: Bonus action: summon a drake. It has HP equal to 5 × your ranger level, AC = 16 + PROF bonus, and uses your spell attack modifier for attacks. It deals 1d6 + WIS mod piercing damage (1d8 at 11th). Acts on your initiative. Command it as bonus action. Disappears at 0 HP; can resummon with 1 hour or a spell slot.

features.name: Drake's Breath
features.description: Spend a bonus action and a spell slot to have your drake exhale a 30-ft cone of damage (type chosen when summoned). Creatures make DEX save or take 2d6 per slot level of the chosen type. You also gain resistance to that damage type.

features.name: Drake's Resistance
features.description: When you or an ally within 30 ft takes damage of the type your drake breathes, use your reaction to grant resistance to that damage for the triggering attack. You and your drake also gain resistance to the drake's damage type permanently.

features.name: Perfected Bond
features.description: Your drake grows to Large size and can be ridden as a mount. It gains a fly speed of 40 ft if you are 15th level or higher. Its damage increases to 1d10.

starting_equipment: Shortbow with quiver of 20 arrows or shortsword
Burglar's pack, dungeoneer's pack, or explorer's pack
Leather armor, two daggers, and thieves' tools

features.name: Sneak Attack
features.description: Once per turn, deal extra damage when you hit with a finesse or ranged weapon and have advantage, or another enemy of the target is within 5 ft. Extra damage: 1d6 at 1st, 2d6 at 3rd, 3d6 at 5th, 4d6 at 7th, 5d6 at 9th, 6d6 at 11th, 7d6 at 13th, 8d6 at 15th, 9d6 at 17th, 10d6 at 19th.

features.name: Thieves' Cant
features.description: Secret mix of dialect, jargon, and code allowing you to hide messages in conversation. Only creatures that know Thieves' Cant understand it. Also includes secret signs and symbols.

features.name: Cunning Action
features.description: Bonus action: Dash, Disengage, or Hide on each of your turns.

features.name: Roguish Archetype
features.description: Choose a Roguish Archetype subclass that grants features at levels 3, 9, 13, and 17.

features.name: Ability Score Improvement
features.description: Increase one ability score by 2, or two ability scores by 1 each. Maximum 20.

features.name: Uncanny Dodge
features.description: Reaction: when hit by an attack from a creature you can see, halve the attack's damage against you.

features.name: Expertise
features.description: Double your proficiency bonus for two skills you are proficient in (or one skill and thieves' tools).

features.name: Evasion
features.description: When subjected to an effect allowing a DEX save for half damage, take no damage on success and half on failure. No benefit if incapacitated.

features.name: Ability Score Improvement
features.description: Increase one ability score by 2, or two ability scores by 1 each. Maximum 20.

features.name: Ability Score Improvement
features.description: Increase one ability score by 2, or two ability scores by 1 each. Maximum 20.

features.name: Reliable Talent
features.description: On any ability check using a proficiency, treat a d20 roll of 9 or lower as a 10.

features.name: Ability Score Improvement
features.description: Increase one ability score by 2, or two ability scores by 1 each. Maximum 20.

features.name: Blindsense
features.description: If you can hear, you are aware of the location of hidden or invisible creatures within 10 ft.

features.name: Slippery Mind
features.description: Gain proficiency in WIS saving throws.

features.name: Ability Score Improvement
features.description: Increase one ability score by 2, or two ability scores by 1 each. Maximum 20.

features.name: Elusive
features.description: No attack roll has advantage against you while you aren't incapacitated.

features.name: Ability Score Improvement
features.description: Increase one ability score by 2, or two ability scores by 1 each. Maximum 20.

features.name: Stroke of Luck
features.description: When you miss with an attack, you can turn the miss into a hit. When you fail an ability check, treat the d20 roll as a 20. Once per short rest.

Thief.description: A rogue who excels at stealth, climbing, and using magical devices.

features.name: Fast Hands
features.description: Can use Sleight of Hand, use thieves' tools, or use an object as a bonus action with Cunning Action.

features.name: Second-Story Work
features.description: Gain climb speed equal to walking speed. Running long jump distance increases by a number of feet equal to DEX modifier.

features.name: Supreme Sneak
features.description: Advantage on DEX (Stealth) checks if you move no more than half your speed on the same turn.

features.name: Use Magic Device
features.description: Ignore all class, race, and level requirements on the use of magic items.

features.name: Thief's Reflexes
features.description: Take two turns during the first round of combat: your initiative and your initiative minus 10.

Assassin.description: A rogue who specializes in eliminating targets with lethal precision.

features.name: Bonus Proficiencies
features.description: Gain proficiency with disguise kit and poisoner's kit.

features.name: Assassinate
features.description: Advantage on attack rolls against creatures that haven't taken a turn in combat yet. Any hit against a surprised creature is a critical hit.

features.name: Infiltration Expertise
features.description: Spend 7 days and 25 gp to establish a false identity including documents, acquaintances, and disguises.

features.name: Impostor
features.description: Spend 3 hours studying a person's behavior, speech, and mannerisms to unerringly mimic them. Creatures can't tell the difference with Insight.

features.name: Death Strike
features.description: When you attack and hit a surprised creature, it must make CON save (DC 8 + DEX mod + PROF). On fail, double the damage of the attack against the creature. Once per long rest.

Arcane Trickster.description: A rogue who combines stealth with wizard magic.

features.name: Spellcasting
features.description: Cast wizard spells. See spellcasting block for slots and spells known. Enchantment and illusion spells count as rogue spells for you.

features.name: Mage Hand Legerdemain
features.description: Mage hand is invisible, and you can stow objects, pick locks, or pick pockets using thieves' tools or Sleight of Hand from 30 ft away as a bonus action.

features.name: Magical Ambush
features.description: If you are hidden from a creature when you cast a spell, the creature has disadvantage on any saving throw against it.

features.name: Versatile Trickster
features.description: Use mage hand to distract targets: gain advantage on one attack roll against a creature within 5 ft of the hand as a bonus action.

features.name: Spell Thief
features.description: Reaction: when a creature casts a spell targeting you or including you in its area, make an ARCANA check (DC 10 + spell level). On success, the spell has no effect on you and you can cast it on your next turn without expending a slot. Once per long rest.

Inquisitive.description: A rogue who uncovers secrets and exposes lies.

features.name: Ear for Deceit
features.description: When you make a WIS (Insight) check to determine if someone is lying, treat a d20 roll of 7 or lower as an 8.

features.name: Eye for Detail
features.description: Can take the Search action as a bonus action. Make a Perception or Investigation check as a bonus action to spot hidden creatures/objects or find clues.

features.name: Insightful Fighting
features.description: Bonus action: make Insight vs. Deception (or passive Deception) against one creature. On success, you can use Sneak Attack against that creature without advantage for 1 minute (no effect if you already have advantage).

features.name: Steady Eye
features.description: Advantage on Perception and Investigation checks if you move no more than half your speed on the same turn.

features.name: Unerring Eye
features.description: Spend 1 minute within 30 ft of an illusion or shapechanger to sense its presence (not what it's disguising). Use PROF/long rest.

features.name: Eye for Weakness
features.description: When you use Insightful Fighting, your Sneak Attack against that creature deals an extra 1d6 damage (total: 1d6 above normal SA for your level).

Scout.description: A rogue who excels at exploration and skirmishing.

features.name: Skirmisher
features.description: Reaction: when a creature ends its turn within 5 ft of you, move up to half your speed without provoking opportunity attacks.

features.name: Survivalist
features.description: Gain proficiency in Nature and Survival. If already proficient, gain expertise (double proficiency bonus).

features.name: Superior Mobility
features.description: Walking speed increases by 10 ft.

features.name: Ambush Master
features.description: Advantage on initiative rolls. On the first turn of combat, attacks against creatures that haven't acted yet have advantage. First ally to hit a creature that hasn't acted deals an extra 1d6 damage.

features.name: Sudden Strike
features.description: When you take the Attack action on your turn, make one additional attack as a bonus action. This attack can use Sneak Attack even if you already used it this turn, but only if you have advantage.

Mastermind.description: A rogue who manipulates others from the shadows.

features.name: Master of Intrigue
features.description: Gain proficiency with disguise kit, forgery kit, and one gaming set. Learn two languages. Gain proficiency in Deception, Persuasion, or one of: arcana, history, investigation, nature, religion.

features.name: Master of Tactics
features.description: Can use the Help action as a bonus action. You can Help allies within 30 ft of you instead of 5 ft.

features.name: Insightful Manipulator
features.description: Spend 1 minute talking to a creature: learn its class levels (if any), highest ability score, lowest ability score, and whether it has proficiency in Insight or Deception.

features.name: Misdirection
features.description: When a creature misses you with a melee attack, you can use your reaction to redirect the attack to another creature within range.

features.name: Soul of Deceit
features.description: Thoughts can't be read by telepathy or magic. You are immune to magic that determines if you're lying. You can fool divination spells with a CHA (Deception) check against the caster's spell save DC.

Swashbuckler.description: A rogue who fights with flair and daring mobility.

features.name: Fancy Footwork
features.description: When you make a melee attack against a creature, it cannot make opportunity attacks against you for the rest of your turn.

features.name: Rakish Audacity
features.description: Add CHA modifier to initiative rolls. You can use Sneak Attack against a creature within 5 ft if no other creatures are within 5 ft of you and you don't have disadvantage (no advantage needed).

features.name: Panache
features.description: Action: make CHA (Persuasion) check vs. creature's WIS (Insight). On success, it has disadvantage on attacks against anyone but you (1 minute) or is charmed by you for 1 minute (if hostile). Save at end of each turn.

features.name: Elegant Maneuver
features.description: Bonus action: gain advantage on the next DEX (Acrobatics) or STR (Athletics) check you make before end of turn.

features.name: Master Duelist
features.description: When you miss with a weapon attack, you can reroll the attack with advantage. Once per short rest.

Phantom.description: A rogue haunted by spirits of the dead.

features.name: Whispers of the Dead
features.description: Whenever you finish a short or long rest, gain proficiency in one skill or tool of your choice. Lasts until your next rest.

features.name: Wails from the Grave
features.description: When you deal Sneak Attack damage, choose one creature within 30 ft of the target. It takes psychic damage equal to half the Sneak Attack dice rolled (e.g., SA 2d6 = 1d6 psychic). Once per turn (2/turn at 17th).

features.name: Tokens of the Departed
features.description: When a creature dies within 30 ft, you can use your reaction to gain a soul token (max 1 at a time, 2 at 17th). Spend a token: gain advantage on one attack, check, or save; or gain resistance to one damage type for 1 hour.

features.name: Ghost Walk
features.description: Spend a soul token: cast etherealness on yourself for 1 minute (no concentration). You can move through creatures and objects. Once per long rest (or with a token each time at 17th).

features.name: Death Knell
features.description: When you use Wails from the Grave, you can target two creatures instead of one. When a creature dies within 30 ft, gain a soul token (max 2 at a time).

Soulknife.description: A rogue who manifests psychic blades from their mind.

features.name: Psionic Power
features.description: Gain psionic energy dice: 2d8 + INT mod (4d8 at 9th, 6d8 at 13th, 8d8 at 17th). Dice become d10 at 13th and d12 at 17th.

features.name: Psychic Blades
features.description: Bonus action: form a psychic blade and make a melee or thrown attack (60 ft). On hit, deal 1d6 psychic damage plus one psionic die. Can also use as reaction when missed to add 1d10 to attack roll.

features.name: Soul Blades
features.description: Psychic blades deal an extra 1d6 damage. When you hit, you can spend a psionic die to teleport up to 30 ft to an unoccupied space you can see.

features.name: Psychic Veil
features.description: Action: spend 2 psionic dice to become invisible for 1 minute or until you attack, cast a spell, or use a bonus action. Once per long rest.

features.name: Rend Mind
features.description: When you hit with Psychic Blades, target makes INT save or is stunned for 1 minute (save at end of each turn). Once per long rest.

tools: Three musical instruments of your choice

starting_equipment: (a) Rapier, (b) Longsword, or (c) any simple weapon

features.name: Spellcasting
features.description: You know spells from the bard spell list. Charisma is your spellcasting ability. You can use a musical instrument as a spellcasting focus.

features.name: Bardic Inspiration
features.description: As a bonus action, give one creature a Bardic Inspiration die (d6). The creature can roll the die and add the number to one ability check, attack roll, or saving throw. Die lasts 10 min or until used. Uses = CHA mod (min 1). Die improves: d8 at 5th, d10 at 10th, d12 at 15th level.

features.name: Jack of All Trades
features.description: Add half your proficiency bonus (rounded down) to any ability check that doesn't already include your proficiency bonus.

features.name: Song of Rest
features.description: During a short rest, you or any friendly creatures who hear your performance regain extra hit points equal to 1d6 + your bard level. Die improves: d8 at 9th, d10 at 13th, d12 at 17th level.

features.name: Bard College
features.description: Choose a Bard College subclass which grants features at 3rd level and again at 6th and 14th levels.

features.name: Expertise
features.description: Choose two of your skill proficiencies. Your proficiency bonus is doubled for any ability check using either of the chosen skills.

features.name: Font of Inspiration
features.description: Bardic Inspiration and Song of Rest recharge on a short or long rest (instead of long rest only). Bardic Inspiration die becomes d8.

features.name: Countercharm
features.description: As an action, start a performance lasting until end of your next turn. You and friendly creatures within 30 ft have advantage on saves against being frightened or charmed. Usable once per short or long rest.

features.name: Bard College Feature
features.description: Gain a feature from your Bard College.

features.name: Bardic Inspiration Improvement
features.description: Bardic Inspiration die becomes d10. You can use Bardic Inspiration to reduce attack roll damage.

features.name: Expertise (Additional)
features.description: Choose two more skill proficiencies. Your proficiency bonus is doubled for any ability check using them.

features.name: Bard College Feature
features.description: Gain a feature from your Bard College.

features.name: Bardic Inspiration Improvement
features.description: Bardic Inspiration die becomes d12.

features.name: Superior Inspiration
features.description: When you roll initiative and have no Bardic Inspiration uses remaining, you regain one use.

features.name: Words of Creation
features.description: As an action, speak words that are sourced from creation itself. Each creature of your choice within 30 ft that can hear you makes a CHA save or is charmed or frightened by you (your choice) for 1 minute. A creature can repeat the save at end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success. Once used, can't be used again until you finish a long rest.

College of Lore.description: Bards of the College of Lore gather knowledge from far and wide, using their talents to weave songs, stories, and magic.

features.name: Bonus Proficiencies
features.description: Gain proficiency with three skills of your choice.

features.name: Cutting Words
features.description: When a creature you can see within 60 ft makes an attack roll, ability check, or damage roll, you can use your reaction to expend one Bardic Inspiration die, rolling it and subtracting the number from the creature's roll. Usable after the roll but before the DM declares outcome.

features.name: Additional Magical Secrets
features.description: Learn two spells of your choice from any class. They count as bard spells and don't count against your spells known.

features.name: Peerless Skill
features.description: When you make an ability check, you can expend one use of Bardic Inspiration, rolling the die and adding it to the check. You can wait until after you roll the d20 before deciding to use this feature.

College of Valor.description: Bards of the College of Valor sing of great heroes and their daring deeds, often joining them on the front lines.

features.name: Bonus Proficiencies
features.description: Gain proficiency with medium armor, shields, and martial weapons.

features.name: Combat Inspiration
features.description: A creature with your Bardic Inspiration die can roll it and add the number to a weapon damage roll, or use it as a reaction to add to its AC against one attack.

features.name: Extra Attack
features.description: You can attack twice instead of once whenever you take the Attack action on your turn.

features.name: Battle Magic
features.description: When you cast a bard spell as a bonus action, you can make one weapon attack as a bonus action.

College of Glamour.description: Bards of the College of Glamour weave breathtaking magic with pure charisma and presence.

features.name: Mantle of Inspiration
features.description: As a bonus action, expend one Bardic Inspiration use to grant 5 temporary HP to up to 4 friendly creatures within 60 ft and allow each to use its reaction to move up to its speed without provoking opportunity attacks. Temp HP improves to 8 at 5th level and 11 at 10th level.

features.name: Enthralling Performance
features.description: After performing for at least 1 minute, you can attempt to charm up to 5 humanoids who watched the performance. Each makes a WIS save or is charmed by you for 1 hour. Usable once per short or long rest.

features.name: Mantle of Majesty
features.description: As a bonus action, assume a magically inspiring form for 1 minute. When a creature fails a save against your charm person or command spell, you can use your reaction to command it (no action required). Usable once per long rest.

features.name: Unbreakable Majesty
features.description: As an action, assume a magically majestic presence for 1 minute or until you're incapacitated. When a creature hits you with an attack, it must make a CHA save or be charmed by you until your next turn. Charmed creatures can't attack you. Usable once per long rest.

College of Swords.description: Bards of the College of Swords are daring blades who combine magical talent with martial skill.

features.name: Bonus Proficiencies
features.description: Gain proficiency with medium armor and scimitars. If proficient with a melee weapon that lacks the two-handed property, you can use it as a spellcasting focus.

features.name: Fighting Style
features.description: Choose Dueling or Two-Weapon Fighting as your fighting style.

features.name: Blade Flourish
features.description: When you take the Attack action, you can expend one Bardic Inspiration die to perform a flourish: the die is added to your weapon damage roll, you gain +10 ft movement until end of turn, and you apply one effect (Defensive Flourish: add die roll to AC; Slashing Flourish: deal die roll damage to one adjacent creature; Mobile Flourish: push target 5 ft and you can move half your speed without provoking).

features.name: Extra Attack
features.description: You can attack twice instead of once whenever you take the Attack action on your turn.

features.name: Master's Flourish
features.description: When you use Blade Flourish, you can roll a d6 instead of expending a Bardic Inspiration die.

College of Whispers.description: Bards of the College of Whispers are spies and manipulators who use secrets as weapons.

features.name: Psychic Blades
features.description: When you hit with a weapon attack, you can expend one Bardic Inspiration die to deal extra psychic damage equal to the die roll + your bard level. Target must also make a WIS save or be frightened of you until end of your next turn.

features.name: Words of Terror
features.description: When you interact with a humanoid alone for at least 1 minute, you can attempt to frighten it. It makes a WIS save or is frightened of you for 1 hour. Usable once per short or long rest.

features.name: Mantle of Whispers
features.description: When a humanoid dies within 10 ft of you, you can capture its shadow. As an action, you can don the shadow, taking the deceased's appearance and voice for 1 hour or until you end it. Usable once per short or long rest.

features.name: Shadow Lore
features.description: As an action, whisper a phrase to one creature within 30 ft. It must make a WIS save or be charmed by you for 8 hours. You can issue a command when the charm ends; the creature makes another WIS save or follows the command. Usable once per long rest.

College of Creation.description: Bards of the College of Creation tap into the song of creation itself to bring things into being.

features.name: Mote of Potential
features.description: When you give a creature a Bardic Inspiration die, you also create a Mote of Potential floating above its head. When the die is rolled, the mote detonates: creatures of your choice within 5 ft of the target must make a CON save or take thunder damage equal to the die roll + your bard level, and the target gains one additional effect based on the roll type (attack roll: +2d4 thunder damage; ability check: +2d4 to the check; saving throw: +2d4 to the save).

features.name: Performance of Creation
features.description: As an action, create one nonmagical item in your hand or on the ground within 10 ft. The item can be up to Large size and worth up to 20 gp × your bard level. It persists for a number of hours equal to your proficiency bonus. Usable once per long rest (or expend a 5+ spell slot to use again).

features.name: Animating Performance
features.description: As an action, target one Large or smaller nonmagical item within 60 ft. It becomes a dancing item under your command for 1 hour (uses stat block). Usable once per long rest (or expend a 5+ spell slot to use again).

College of Eloquence.description: Bards of the College of Eloquence are master orators whose words reshape reality.

features.name: Silver Tongue
features.description: When you make a Charisma (Persuasion) or Charisma (Deception) check, you can treat a d20 roll of 9 or lower as a 10.

features.name: Unsettling Words
features.description: When a creature you can see within 60 ft makes an attack roll, ability check, or damage roll, you can use your reaction to expend one Bardic Inspiration die, subtracting the roll from the creature's total.

features.name: Unfailing Inspiration
features.description: When a creature uses your Bardic Inspiration die and the roll fails, the creature retains the die and can use it again within 10 minutes.

features.name: Infectious Inspiration
features.description: When a creature uses your Bardic Inspiration die and succeeds, you can use your reaction to give a Bardic Inspiration die (without expending a use) to one other creature within 60 ft.

starting_equipment: (a) Scale mail, (b) Leather armor, or (c) Chain mail (if proficient)
(a) Light crossbow and 20 bolts or (b) any simple weapon

features.name: Spellcasting
features.description: You prepare cleric spells from the cleric spell list. Wisdom is your spellcasting ability. You can use a holy symbol as a spellcasting focus.

features.name: Divine Domain
features.description: Choose a Divine Domain subclass. You gain domain spells and features at 1st, 2nd, 6th, 8th, and 17th levels.

features.name: Channel Divinity: Turn Undead
features.description: As an action, present your holy symbol and speak a prayer. Each undead within 30 ft that can see/hear you must make a WIS save. On fail, the undead is turned for 1 minute (flees, can't willingly move within 30 ft of you, can't take reactions, can only Dash or try to escape, can make saves at end of turns). Destroyed if CR ≤ 1/4 at level 5, ≤ 1/2 at level 8, ≤ 1 at level 11, ≤ 2 at level 14, ≤ 3 at level 17.

features.name: Channel Divinity (Domain Feature)
features.description: You gain an additional Channel Divinity option from your Divine Domain. Channel Divinity refreshes on a short or long rest. Uses: 1/rest at levels 2-5, 2/rest at levels 6-17, 3/rest at level 18+.

features.name: Destroy Undead
features.description: When an undead fails its save against your Turn Undead, it is destroyed if its challenge rating is at or below the threshold (CR 1/2 at level 8, CR 1 at level 11, CR 2 at level 14, CR 3 at level 17).

features.name: Divine Intervention
features.description: Call on your deity for aid as an action. Roll percentile dice; if you roll equal to or lower than your cleric level, your deity intervenes. The DM determines the effect. Usable once per long rest (or 7 days for a failed attempt).

features.name: Divine Intervention Improvement
features.description: Your call to your deity succeeds automatically. No roll required.

Knowledge Domain.description: Clerics of the Knowledge Domain value learning and understanding above all.

features.name: Blessings of Knowledge
features.description: Gain proficiency in two of: Arcana, History, Nature, Religion. Gain proficiency with two languages. Double proficiency bonus for checks with chosen skills.

features.name: Channel Divinity: Knowledge of the Ages
features.description: As an action, choose one skill or tool. For 10 minutes, you have proficiency with it.

features.name: Channel Divinity: Read Thoughts
features.description: As an action, choose one creature you can see within 60 ft. It must make a WIS save or you read its surface thoughts and can use your action to cast suggestion on it (no components, save at disadvantage). Lasts 1 minute.

features.name: Potent Spellcasting
features.description: Add your WIS modifier to the damage of any cleric cantrip.

features.name: Visions of the Past
features.description: As an action, meditate to receive visions of the past related to an object or area. Usable once per short or long rest.

Life Domain.description: Clerics of the Life Domain are devoted to preserving life and healing the wounded.

features.name: Disciple of Life
features.description: Whenever you use a spell of 1st level or higher to restore hit points, the creature regains additional HP equal to 2 + the spell's level.

features.name: Bonus Proficiency
features.description: Gain proficiency with heavy armor.

features.name: Channel Divinity: Preserve Life
features.description: As an action, present your holy symbol and choose one creature within 30 ft. It regains hit points equal to 5 × your cleric level. Divides among multiple creatures if you choose. Can't raise HP above half its hit point maximum.

features.name: Blessed Healer
features.description: When you cast a spell of 1st level or higher that restores HP to a creature other than you, you regain HP equal to 2 + the spell's level.

features.name: Divine Strike
features.description: Once on each of your turns when you hit a creature with a weapon attack, deal an extra 1d8 radiant damage. Increases to 2d8 at 14th level.

features.name: Supreme Healing
features.description: When you would roll dice to determine HP restored by a spell, instead use the maximum number possible for each die.

Light Domain.description: Clerics of the Light Domain wield fire, radiance, and the power of dawn.

features.name: Bonus Cantrip
features.description: Learn the light cantrip if you don't already know it. It counts as a cleric cantrip for you.

features.name: Warding Flare
features.description: When attacked by a creature you can see within 30 ft, use your reaction to impose disadvantage on the attack. Usable WIS mod times per long rest.

features.name: Channel Divinity: Radiance of the Dawn
features.description: As an action, present your holy symbol. Each creature of your choice within 30 ft must make a CON save or take 2d10 + cleric level radiant damage and be blinded until end of your next turn. A creature that succeeds takes half damage and isn't blinded.

features.name: Improved Flare
features.description: You can use Warding Flare when a creature within 30 ft attacks a creature other than you.

features.name: Potent Spellcasting
features.description: Add your WIS modifier to the damage of any cleric cantrip.

features.name: Corona of Light
features.description: As an action, emanate sunlight in a 60 ft radius for 1 minute. Enemies have disadvantage on saves against your fire and radiant spells. Usable once per long rest.
