Nature Domain.description: Clerics of the Nature Domain protect the wild places and harness natural forces.

features.name: Acolyte of Nature
features.description: Learn one druid cantrip of your choice. Gain proficiency in one of: Animal Handling, Nature, or Survival.

features.name: Bonus Proficiency
features.description: Gain proficiency with heavy armor.

features.name: Channel Divinity: Charm Animals and Plants
features.description: As an action, present your holy symbol. Each beast or plant creature within 30 ft that can see you must make a WIS save or be charmed by you for 1 minute.

features.name: Dampen Elements
features.description: When a creature within 30 ft takes acid, cold, fire, lightning, or thunder damage, use your reaction to grant resistance to that damage.

features.name: Divine Strike
features.description: Once on each of your turns when you hit a creature with a weapon attack, deal an extra 1d8 cold, fire, or lightning damage (choose when you gain this). Increases to 2d8 at 14th level.

features.name: Master of Nature
features.description: Choose one creature you can see within 60 ft that is charmed by you. It must make a WIS save or obey your commands for 1 minute. Usable once per short or long rest.

Tempest Domain.description: Clerics of the Tempest Domain channel the wrath of storms and the fury of the sea.

features.name: Bonus Proficiencies
features.description: Gain proficiency with martial weapons and heavy armor.

features.name: Wrath of the Storm
features.description: When a creature hits you with a melee attack, use your reaction to deal 2d8 lightning or thunder damage to it. Usable WIS mod times per long rest. Damage increases to 4d8 at level 6 and 6d8 at level 18.

features.name: Channel Divinity: Destructive Wrath
features.description: When you roll lightning or thunder damage, use Channel Divinity to deal maximum damage instead of rolling.

features.name: Thunderous Strike
features.description: When you deal lightning damage to a Large or smaller creature, you can push it up to 10 ft away.

features.name: Divine Strike
features.description: Once on each of your turns when you hit a creature with a weapon attack, deal an extra 1d8 thunder damage. Increases to 2d8 at 14th level.

features.name: Stormborn
features.description: You gain a flying speed equal to your current walking speed whenever you're not underground or indoors.

Trickery Domain.description: Clerics of the Trickery Domain use deception and illusion to achieve their goals.

features.name: Blessing of the Trickster
features.description: As an action, touch one willing creature. It has advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks for 1 hour. Usable once per long rest (or expend a spell slot).

features.name: Channel Divinity: Invoke Duplicity
features.description: As an action, create an illusory duplicate of yourself within 30 ft for 1 minute (concentration). As a bonus action, you can move it up to 30 ft. You can cast spells as though you were in its space.

features.name: Channel Divinity: Cloak of Shadows
features.description: As an action, become invisible until the end of your next turn. You become visible if you attack or cast a spell.

features.name: Divine Strike
features.description: Once on each of your turns when you hit a creature with a weapon attack, deal an extra 1d8 poison damage. Increases to 2d8 at 14th level.

features.name: Improved Duplicity
features.description: You can create up to four duplicates of yourself instead of one as part of Invoke Duplicity.

War Domain.description: Clerics of the War Domain are battle-hardened warriors who fight for their deity's cause.

features.name: Bonus Proficiencies
features.description: Gain proficiency with martial weapons and heavy armor.

features.name: War Priest
features.description: On your turn, you can make one weapon attack as a bonus action. Usable WIS mod times per long rest.

features.name: Channel Divinity: Guided Strike
features.description: When you make an attack roll, use Channel Divinity to gain a +10 bonus to the roll.

features.name: Channel Divinity: War God's Blessing
features.description: When a creature within 30 ft makes an attack roll, use your reaction and Channel Divinity to grant it a +10 bonus to the roll.

features.name: Divine Strike
features.description: Once on each of your turns when you hit a creature with a weapon attack, deal an extra 1d8 weapon damage type. Increases to 2d8 at 14th level.

features.name: Avatar of Battle
features.description: You have resistance to bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical weapons.

Forge Domain.description: Clerics of the Forge Domain master the art of creation and imbuing metal with divine power.

features.name: Bonus Proficiencies
features.description: Gain proficiency with heavy armor and smith's tools.

features.name: Blessing of the Forge
features.description: At the end of a long rest, touch one nonmagical weapon or suit of armor. It becomes a +1 magic item until your next long rest.

features.name: Channel Divinity: Artisan's Blessing
features.description: As an action, conduct an hour-long ritual to create one nonmagical item worth up to 100 gp from metal. You must have smith's tools and raw materials equal to the item's value.

features.name: Soul of the Forge
features.description: Gain +1 AC while wearing heavy armor. Gain resistance to fire damage.

features.name: Divine Strike
features.description: Once on each of your turns when you hit a creature with a weapon attack, deal an extra 1d8 fire damage. Increases to 2d8 at 14th level.

features.name: Saint of Forge and Fire
features.description: You gain immunity to fire damage. While wearing heavy armor, you have resistance to bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical weapons.

Grave Domain.description: Clerics of the Grave Domain guard the boundary between life and death, opposing undeath.

features.name: Circle of Mortality
features.description: You learn the spare the dying cantrip with a range of 30 ft. When you cast a spell to heal a creature at 0 HP, treat any die rolled as its maximum. You have advantage on saves against diseases and being poisoned.

features.name: Eyes of the Grave
features.description: You know the location of any undead within 60 ft that isn't behind total cover. Usable WIS mod times per long rest.

features.name: Channel Divinity: Path to the Grave
features.description: As an action, touch one creature. The next attack or spell that hits it deals double damage. Effect ends when it takes damage or 1 minute passes.

features.name: Sentinel at Death's Door
features.description: When a creature within 30 ft is hit by a critical hit, use your reaction to turn it into a normal hit. Usable once per short or long rest.

features.name: Potent Spellcasting
features.description: Add your WIS modifier to the damage of any cleric cantrip.

features.name: Keeper of Souls
features.description: When an enemy dies within 60 ft, you or one creature you choose regains HP equal to the enemy's CR × 5 (or level × 5 for PCs). Usable once per short or long rest.

Order Domain.description: Clerics of the Order Domain uphold law, discipline, and societal structure.

features.name: Bonus Proficiency
features.description: Gain proficiency with heavy armor.

features.name: Voice of Authority
features.description: When you cast a spell with a spell slot that targets an ally, that ally can use its reaction to make one weapon attack against a target of your choice.

features.name: Channel Divinity: Ordained Champion
features.description: As an action, choose one creature within 60 ft. It must make a WIS save or be charmed by you for 1 minute. While charmed, it follows your commands that don't cause it harm.

features.name: Embodiment of the Law
features.description: When you cast a spell of the enchantment school using a spell slot, you can change the spell's casting time to 1 bonus action for that casting.

features.name: Divine Strike
features.description: Once on each of your turns when you hit a creature with a weapon attack, deal an extra 1d8 psychic damage. Increases to 2d8 at 14th level.

features.name: Order's Dominion
features.description: Enemies charmed by you take psychic damage equal to your WIS modifier whenever they damage you or an ally.

Peace Domain.description: Clerics of the Peace Domain foster harmony and unity among allies.

features.name: Implement of Peace
features.description: Gain proficiency in Insight, Performance, or Persuasion. When you cast a spell that restores HP, the target also gains temporary HP equal to your proficiency bonus.

features.name: Channel Divinity: Balm of Peace
features.description: As an action, move up to your speed without provoking opportunity attacks. Each creature you pass within 5 ft of regains 2d6 + WIS mod HP.

features.name: Emboldening Bond
features.description: As an action, bond up to 4 willing creatures within 30 ft for 10 minutes. Bonded creatures add 1d4 to an attack roll, ability check, or saving throw when they see another bonded creature do the same. Usable once per long rest (or expend a spell slot).

features.name: Potent Spellcasting
features.description: Add your WIS modifier to the damage of any cleric cantrip.

features.name: Protective Bond
features.description: When a bonded creature takes damage, another bonded creature can use its reaction to teleport to an unoccupied space next to it and take the damage instead.

Twilight Domain.description: Clerics of the Twilight Domain operate in the boundary between light and darkness.

features.name: Bonus Proficiencies
features.description: Gain proficiency with martial weapons and heavy armor.

features.name: Eyes of Night
features.description: You have darkvision out to 300 ft. If you naturally have darkvision, its range increases by 300 ft. As an action, share this darkvision with up to 4 willing creatures within 10 ft for 1 hour. Usable once per long rest (or expend a spell slot).

features.name: Vigilant Blessing
features.description: At the end of a long rest, choose one creature. It gains advantage on the next initiative roll it makes.

features.name: Channel Divinity: Twilight Sanctuary
features.description: As an action, emanate a 30 ft sphere of twilight for 1 minute (concentration). You and friendly creatures in the sphere have advantage on saves against being charmed or frightened. When a friendly creature ends its turn in the sphere, you can end one charm or frighten effect on it, or grant it temporary HP equal to 1d6 + cleric level.

features.name: Steps of Night
features.description: When in dim light or darkness, as a bonus action, teleport up to 60 ft to an unoccupied space in dim light or darkness. Usable WIS mod times per long rest.

features.name: Divine Strike
features.description: Once on each of your turns when you hit a creature with a weapon attack, deal an extra 1d8 radiant damage. Increases to 2d8 at 14th level.

features.name: Twilight Shroud
features.description: You and friendly creatures within 30 ft have half cover. Enemies have disadvantage on attack rolls against you in dim light or darkness.

Death Domain.description: Clerics of the Death Domain harness necromantic power and wield the energy of death.

features.name: Bonus Proficiency
features.description: Gain proficiency with martial weapons.

features.name: Reaper
features.description: Learn one necromancy cantrip of your choice from any spell list. When you cast a necromancy cantrip that targets one creature, it can target two creatures within range and within 5 ft of each other.

features.name: Channel Divinity: Touch of Death
features.description: When you hit a creature with a melee attack, use Channel Divinity to deal extra necrotic damage equal to 5 + 2 × your cleric level.

features.name: Inescapable Destruction
features.description: Necrotic damage dealt by your cleric spells and Channel Divinity ignores resistance to necrotic damage.

features.name: Divine Strike
features.description: Once on each of your turns when you hit a creature with a weapon attack, deal an extra 1d8 necrotic damage. Increases to 2d8 at 14th level.

features.name: Improved Reaper
features.description: When you cast a necromancy spell of 1st through 5th level that targets one creature, you can target a second creature within range.

starting_equipment: (a) Wooden shield or (b) any simple weapon
(a) Scimitar or (b) any simple melee weapon
Leather armor, explorer's pack, and druidic focus

features.name: Spellcasting
features.description: You prepare druid spells from the druid spell list. Wisdom is your spellcasting ability. You can use a druidic focus as a spellcasting focus.

features.name: Druidic
features.description: You know Druidic, a secret language. You can speak it and leave hidden messages. Others who know Druidic can spot and read such messages automatically.

features.name: Wild Shape
features.description: As an action, magically assume the shape of a beast you have seen before. You can stay in the form for a number of hours equal to half your druid level (rounded down). You revert if you drop to 0 HP, fall unconscious, or die. You can use this feature twice per short or long rest. At 2nd-3rd level: CR 1/4, no flying/swim. At 4th level+: CR 1/2, can have swim speed. At 8th level+: CR 1, can have fly speed.

features.name: Druid Circle
features.description: Choose a Druid Circle subclass which grants features at 2nd level and again at 6th, 10th, and 14th levels.

features.name: Wild Shape Improvement
features.description: You can Wild Shape into beasts with a challenge rating as high as 1/2. You can Wild Shape into beasts with a swim speed.

features.name: Ability Score Improvement
features.description: Increase one ability score by 2 or two by 1. Can't increase above 20. (Also at levels 8, 12, 16, 19.)

features.name: Wild Shape Improvement
features.description: You can Wild Shape into beasts with a challenge rating as high as 1. You can Wild Shape into beasts with a fly speed.

features.name: Timeless Body
features.description: The passage of time affects you less. For every 10 years, your body ages only 1 year. You are immune to being magically aged.

features.name: Beast Spells
features.description: You can cast many of your druid spells in any shape you assume using Wild Shape. You can perform the somatic and verbal components while in beast shape.

features.name: Archdruid
features.description: You can use Wild Shape an unlimited number of times. You can ignore the verbal and somatic components of druid spells and use them in Wild Shape.

Circle of the Land.description: Druids of the Land are mystics who guard the natural world and its secrets.

features.name: Bonus Cantrip
features.description: Learn one additional druid cantrip of your choice.

features.name: Natural Recovery
features.description: During a short rest, recover spell slots with a combined level equal to or less than half your druid level (rounded up). No slot can be 6th level or higher. Usable once per long rest.

features.name: Circle Spells
features.description: Choose a land type (Arctic, Coast, Desert, Forest, Grassland, Mountain, or Swamp). You gain additional spells at levels 3, 5, 7, and 9 based on your land type. These are always prepared and don't count against your prepared spells.

features.name: Land's Stride
features.description: Nonmagical difficult terrain doesn't cost you extra movement. You can pass through nonmagical plants without being slowed or taking damage. You have advantage on saves against plants magically created or manipulated to impede movement.

features.name: Nature's Ward
features.description: You can't be charmed or frightened by elementals or fey. You are immune to poison and disease.

features.name: Nature's Sanctuary
features.description: When a beast or plant creature attacks you, it must make a WIS save or choose a different target. On success, it is immune to this effect for 24 hours.

Circle of the Moon.description: Druids of the Moon are fearsome shapechangers who embrace their animal forms.

features.name: Combat Wild Shape
features.description: When you use Wild Shape, you can use a bonus action instead of an action. While transformed, you can use a bonus action to expend one spell slot and regain 1d8 HP per spell slot level.

features.name: Circle Forms
features.description: The CR limit for Wild Shape is 1 instead of 1/4 (or 1/2 at druid level 4+).

features.name: Primal Strike
features.description: Your attacks in beast form count as magical for overcoming resistance and immunity to nonmagical attacks and damage.

features.name: Elemental Wild Shape
features.description: You can expend two uses of Wild Shape to transform into an elemental with a CR of 5 or lower.

features.name: Moonfire
features.description: You can cast moonbeam at its lowest level without expending a spell slot. Wis mod times per long rest.

features.name: Thousand Forms
features.description: You can cast alter self at will without expending a spell slot.

Circle of Dreams.description: Druids of the Circle of Dreams are connected to the Feywild and its dreamlike magic.

features.name: Hearth of Moonlight and Shadow
features.description: During a short or long rest, you can invoke shadowy silence and light. Friendly creatures within 30 ft have advantage on Stealth checks. Any healing from resting is increased by 1d6. Lasts until the rest ends. Usable once per long rest.

features.name: Hidden Paths
features.description: As a bonus action, teleport up to 60 ft to an unoccupied space you can see. Or as an action, teleport one willing creature within 5 ft up to 30 ft to an unoccupied space. Usable WIS mod times per long rest.

features.name: Nature's Ward
features.description: You can't be charmed or frightened by fey or elementals. You are immune to poison and disease.

features.name: Walker in Dreams
features.description: During a short rest, choose one: cast augury, cast teleport to a location from your last long rest, or let allies recover half their max HP. Usable once per long rest.

Circle of the Shepherd.description: Druids of the Circle of the Shepherd commune with nature spirits and summon powerful allies.

features.name: Speech of the Woods
features.description: You learn Sylvan. You can speak with beasts. Beasts can understand your speech and you understand theirs. Limited by beast intelligence.

features.name: Spirit Totem
features.description: As a bonus action, summon a spirit that creates a 30 ft aura for 1 minute (concentration). Bear: you and allies gain 2 + druid level temporary HP when entering or starting turn in aura. Hawk: you and allies have advantage on attacks against creatures in the aura. Wolf: you and allies gain advantage on attacks against creatures within 5 ft of an ally. Usable once per short or long rest.

features.name: Mighty Summoner
features.description: Beasts you summon or create with spells gain +2 HP per HD and their natural weapons count as magical. Natural attacks deal extra damage equal to half your druid level.

features.name: Guardian Spirit
features.description: When a beast or fey you summoned or created ends its turn in your Spirit Totem aura, you and allies in the aura regain HP equal to half your druid level.

features.name: Faithful Summons
features.description: If you drop to 0 HP, you don't die or fall unconscious. Instead, you summon 4 beasts of CR 2 or lower. You gain temporary HP equal to twice your druid level. Lasts 1 minute. Usable once per long rest.

Circle of Spores.description: Druids of the Circle of Spores find beauty in decay and channel the cycle of life and death.

features.name: Circle Spells
features.description: Gain additional spells at levels 2, 3, 5, 7, and 9 that are always prepared.

features.name: Halo of Spores
features.description: As a reaction when a creature you can see within 10 ft moves or starts its turn, deal necrotic damage equal to your druid level. Usable WIS mod times per short or long rest. Damage increases: 1d6 at 6th level, 1d8 at 10th level, 1d10 at 14th level (adding druid level to the die roll).

features.name: Symbiotic Entity
features.description: As an action, spend a Wild Shape use to gain: 4 × druid level temporary HP, melee weapon attacks deal extra 1d6 necrotic damage, and Halo of Spores damage doubles. Lasts 10 minutes or until you lose all temp HP. Usable once per short or long rest.

features.name: Fungal Infestation
features.description: When a beast or humanoid within 10 ft dies, use your reaction to reanimate it with 1 HP. It takes its turn immediately and can make one melee attack as a reaction. It dies again at end of your next turn. Usable once per short or long rest.

features.name: Spreading Spores
features.description: As a bonus action, hurl spores up to 30 ft, creating a 10 ft cube. Any creature in the cube takes your Halo of Spores damage when it starts its turn or moves into it. You can't use Halo of Spores while Spreading Spores is active. Lasts 1 minute.

features.name: Fungal Body
features.description: You can't be blinded, deafened, frightened, or poisoned. If you die, you rise after 1 hour with all your HP if your body isn't destroyed.

Circle of Stars.description: Druids of the Circle of Stars look to the cosmos for guidance and power.

features.name: Star Map
features.description: You create a Star Map, a Tiny object that serves as a spellcasting focus. You know the guidance cantrip. While holding the map, you can cast guiding bolt without using a spell slot (WIS mod times per long rest). You can also use it to determine which constellation guides you (Archer, Chalice, or Dragon) when you use Starry Form.

features.name: Starry Form
features.description: As a bonus action, expend a Wild Shape use to assume a starry form for 10 minutes. Choose a constellation: Archer (when you cast a spell requiring an attack roll, deal extra radiant damage equal to 1d8 + WIS mod), Chalice (when you cast a spell using a spell slot that restores HP, you or an ally in 30 ft also regain 1d8 + WIS mod HP), Dragon (when you make an INT or WIS check or a CON save to maintain concentration, treat a roll of 9 or lower as 10).

features.name: Cosmic Omen
features.description: When you finish a long rest, roll a d6. Even = Weal (when a creature you can see makes an attack roll, save, or ability check, use reaction to add 1d6 to the roll). Odd = Woe (use reaction to subtract 1d6 from an enemy's roll). Usable WIS mod times per long rest.

features.name: Twinkling Constellations
features.description: While in Starry Form, constellations improve: Archer deals 2d8, Chalice heals 2d8, Dragon grants flight speed equal to walking speed. You can change constellation as a bonus action.

features.name: Full of Stars
features.description: While in Starry Form, you have resistance to bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage.

Circle of Wildfire.description: Druids of the Circle of Wildfire embrace destruction and rebirth through fire.

features.name: Circle Spells
features.description: Gain additional spells at levels 2, 3, 5, 7, and 9 that are always prepared.

features.name: Summon Wildfire Spirit
features.description: As an action, expend a Wild Shape use to summon a wildfire spirit within 30 ft. It acts on your turn. When summoned, each creature within 10 ft of it must make a DEX save or take 2d6 fire damage. It uses the Wildfire Spirit stat block.

features.name: Enhanced Bond
features.description: While your wildfire spirit is summoned, you gain: when you cast a spell with a range other than self, you can cast it from the spirit's space; when you cast a spell that deals fire or necrotic damage, you gain a bonus to one damage roll equal to your proficiency bonus; when a spell deals fire or necrotic damage to a creature, you can heal your spirit 1d6 + druid level.

features.name: Cauterizing Flames
features.description: When a creature dies within 30 ft of you or your spirit, you can use your reaction to create a flame in its space. A creature can use its action to extinguish the flames. If the flames remain, the creature rises at the start of its next turn with 1 HP. Usable WIS mod times per long rest.

features.name: Blazing Revival
features.description: When you drop to 0 HP, your spirit explodes in flames. Each creature within 30 ft of it makes a DEX save or takes 6d6 fire damage. You then regain HP equal to half the damage dealt. Usable once per long rest.

starting_equipment: (a) Light crossbow and 20 bolts or (b) any simple weapon

features.name: Spellcasting
features.description: You know spells from the sorcerer spell list. Charisma is your spellcasting ability. You can use an arcane focus as a spellcasting focus.

features.name: Sorcerous Origin
features.description: Choose a Sorcerous Origin subclass which grants features at 1st level and again at 6th, 14th, and 18th levels.

features.name: Font of Magic
features.description: You have sorcery points (equal to sorcerer level). As a bonus action, you can: convert sorcery points to spell slots (1 pt = 1st level, 2 = 2nd, 3 = 3rd, 4 = 4th, 5 = 5th level; can't create above 5th level), or convert a spell slot to sorcery points (points equal to slot level).

features.name: Flexible Casting
features.description: Part of Font of Magic. You can convert between sorcery points and spell slots as described above. Created spell slots vanish at end of a long rest.

features.name: Metamagic
features.description: Choose 2 Metamagic options. You can use only one Metamagic option on a spell. Also choose additional options at 10th and 17th levels.

features.name: Metamagic: Quickened Spell
features.description: Cost 2 sorcery points. Cast a spell with casting time of 1 action as a bonus action instead.

features.name: Metamagic: Twinned Spell
features.description: Cost 1 sorcery point per spell level. Target a second creature in range with a spell that targets only one creature.

features.name: Metamagic: Subtle Spell
features.description: Cost 1 sorcery point. Cast a spell without any somatic or verbal components.

features.name: Metamagic: Empowered Spell
features.description: Cost 1 sorcery point. Reroll up to CHA mod damage dice (must use new rolls). Can be used with other Metamagic.

features.name: Metamagic: Distant Spell
features.description: Cost 1 sorcery point. Double the range of a spell, or make a touch spell have a range of 30 ft.

features.name: Metamagic: Extended Spell
features.description: Cost 1 sorcery point. Double the duration of a spell (max 24 hours).

features.name: Metamagic: Heightened Spell
features.description: Cost 3 sorcery points. One target of a spell has disadvantage on its first saving throw.

features.name: Metamagic: Careful Spell
features.description: Cost 1 sorcery point. When you cast a spell that forces a save, chosen creatures automatically succeed.

features.name: Sorcery Point Recovery
features.description: Once per day when you finish a short rest, you can recover expended sorcery points up to half your sorcerer level (rounded up).

features.name: Sorcerous Restoration
features.description: At the end of a short rest, you recover 4 expended sorcery points. Once per long rest.

Draconic Bloodline.description: Sorcerers with draconic bloodline ancestry gain the power and resilience of dragons.

features.name: Dragon Ancestor
features.description: Choose one dragon type (Black/Copper: Acid, Blue/Bronze: Lightning, Brass/Gold/Red: Fire, Green: Poison, Silver/White: Cold). You gain a +1 bonus on CHA checks with dragons of that type, and speak Draconic.

features.name: Draconic Resilience
features.description: HP maximum increases by 1 per sorcerer level. When not wearing armor, AC = 13 + DEX modifier.

features.name: Elemental Affinity
features.description: When you cast a spell that deals damage of the type associated with your draconic ancestry, add CHA modifier to one damage roll. Also gain resistance to that damage type for 1 hour by spending 1 sorcery point.

features.name: Dragon Wings
features.description: As a bonus action, sprout dragon wings and gain flying speed equal to current speed for 1 hour. Usable once per long rest (or spend 5 sorcery points to use again).

features.name: Draconic Presence
features.description: As an action, channel the dread presence of dragons for 1 minute (concentration). Each creature of your choice within 60 ft makes a WIS save or become charmed (if you choose) or frightened for 1 minute. Usable once per long rest (or spend 5 sorcery points to use again).

Wild Magic.description: Sorcerers with wild magic have unpredictable, chaotic power that surges unpredictably.

features.name: Wild Magic Surge
features.description: Immediately after you cast a sorcerer spell of 1st level or higher, the DM can have you roll a d20. On a 1, roll on the Wild Magic Surge table to create a random effect.

features.name: Tides of Chaos
features.description: Gain advantage on one attack roll, ability check, or saving throw. Usable once per long rest. When you use this and then cast a sorcerer spell of 1st level or higher, you roll on the Wild Magic Surge table immediately. Afterward, regain Tides of Chaos.

features.name: Bend Luck
features.description: When a creature you can see makes an attack roll, ability check, or saving throw, you can use your reaction and spend 2 sorcery points to roll 1d4 and add/subtract it from the roll. You can do so after the roll but before the outcome.

features.name: Controlled Chaos
features.description: When you roll on the Wild Magic Surge table, you can roll twice and choose which effect applies.

features.name: Spell Bombardment
features.description: When you roll damage for a spell and roll the max on any die, roll one additional die of that type and add it to the damage. Can apply only once per spell.

Divine Soul.description: Sorcerers with a divine soul draw power from celestial or divine sources.

features.name: Divine Magic
features.description: Learn the thaumaturgy cantrip. When you select a spell during a level-up, you can choose from the cleric spell list in addition to the sorcerer spell list. It counts as a sorcerer spell for you.

features.name: Favored by the Gods
features.description: When you fail a saving throw or miss with an attack roll, roll 2d4 and add it to the total, potentially changing the outcome. Usable once per short or long rest.

features.name: Empowered Healing
features.description: When you or an ally rolls dice for healing with a spell, you can spend 1 sorcery point to reroll any number of those dice (must use new rolls).

features.name: Otherworldly Wings
features.description: As a bonus action, manifest spectral wings and gain flying speed equal to walking speed for 1 hour. Usable once per long rest (or spend 2 sorcery points to use again).

features.name: Unearthly Recovery
features.description: When you drop to 0 HP but don't die, you can regain HP equal to half your hit point maximum. Usable once per long rest.

features.name: Otherworldly Wings (At-Will)
features.description: You can use Otherworldly Wings at will without spending sorcery points.

Shadow Magic.description: Sorcerers with shadow magic draw power from the Shadowfell and darkness itself.

features.name: Eyes of the Dark
features.description: You have 120 ft darkvision. When you reach 3rd level, you can cast darkness once per long rest by spending 2 sorcery points. CHA is your spellcasting ability.

features.name: Strength of the Grave
features.description: When damage reduces you to 0 HP, make a CHA save (DC = 5 + damage taken). On success, drop to 1 HP instead. Can't be used against radiant damage or a critical hit.

features.name: Hound of Ill Omen
features.description: As a bonus action, spend 3 sorcery points to summon a hound of ill omen near a creature you can see within 120 ft. The hound uses the dire wolf stat block with shadowy appearance. It makes a melee attack against the target when it summons and moves to attack the target each turn. The target has disadvantage on saves against your spells while the hound is within 5 ft. Lasts 1 minute or until reduced to 0 HP. Usable once per long rest.

features.name: Shadow Walk
features.description: When in dim light or darkness, as a bonus action, teleport up to 120 ft to an unoccupied space in dim light or darkness.

features.name: Umbral Form
features.description: As a bonus action, spend 6 sorcery points to become shadowy for 1 minute. You gain resistance to all damage except force and radiant, and can move through creatures and objects as if difficult terrain (1d10 force damage if ending turn inside).

Storm Sorcery.description: Sorcerers with storm sorcery command the power of wind, thunder, and lightning.

features.name: Wind Speaker
features.description: You know the Primordial language.

features.name: Tempestuous Magic
features.description: As a bonus action before or after casting a sorcerer spell of 1st level or higher, fly up to 10 ft without provoking opportunity attacks.

features.name: Heart of the Storm
features.description: Gain resistance to lightning and thunder damage. When you cast a spell of 1st level or higher that deals lightning or thunder damage, deal lightning or thunder damage (your choice) equal to half your sorcerer level to one creature within 10 ft of you.

features.name: Storm Guide
features.description: As an action, control rain or wind in a 20 ft radius sphere centered on you for 1 minute.

features.name: Storm's Fury
features.description: When hit by a melee attack, use your reaction to deal lightning damage equal to your sorcerer level to the attacker and push it up to 20 ft away.

features.name: Wind Soul
features.description: Gain immunity to lightning and thunder damage. Gain flying speed of 60 ft. As an action, create a 20 ft radius storm centered on yourself for 1 minute. Enemies in the area make a DEX save or take 3d10 lightning damage. Usable once per long rest (or spend 6 sorcery points).

Aberrant Mind.description: Sorcerers with aberrant mind powers are touched by alien entities from the Far Realm.

features.name: Psionic Spells
features.description: Learn additional spells at levels 1, 3, 5, 7, and 9 that don't count against your spells known. You can cast these without verbal components by spending sorcery points equal to the spell's level.

features.name: Telepathic Speech
features.description: You can telepathically speak to any creature within 60 ft that you can see. The creature must understand at least one language. The link lasts for a number of minutes equal to your sorcerer level.

features.name: Psionic Sorcery
features.description: When you cast a Psionic Spell, you can spend sorcery points instead of a spell slot. Cost = spell's level. No verbal or somatic components. Can't use with Metamagic options that manipulate components.

features.name: Psychic Defenses
features.description: Gain resistance to psychic damage. You have advantage on saves against being charmed or frightened.

features.name: Revelation in Flesh
features.description: As a bonus action, spend 1 or more sorcery points to transform for 1 minute: 1 pt = darkvision 60 ft + swim speed; 2 pts = climb speed + +5 ft walking speed; 3 pts = fly speed equal to walking speed + can hover. Can use as bonus action on subsequent turns to change the effect.

features.name: Warping Implosion
features.description: As an action, teleport up to 120 ft to an unoccupied space. Each creature within 30 ft of where you left makes a CON save or takes 6d10 psychic damage and is pulled up to 30 ft toward your departure point. Usable once per long rest (or spend 6 sorcery points).

Clockwork Soul.description: Sorcerers with clockwork soul powers are connected to the plane of Mechanus and cosmic order.

features.name: Clockwork Magic
features.description: Learn additional spells at levels 1, 3, 5, 7, and 9 that don't count against your spells known. These are always prepared and can be replaced with other abjuration or transmutation spells.

features.name: Restore Balance
features.description: When a creature you can see within 60 ft is about to roll a d20 with advantage or disadvantage, you can use your reaction to prevent the advantage or disadvantage. Usable CHA mod times per long rest.

features.name: Bulwark of Law
features.description: As an action, spend 1-5 sorcery points to create a protective aura for 1 minute (concentration). You and allies within 30 ft gain a ward with 1d8 per sorcery point spent. When one takes damage, the ward absorbs it and reduces by the ward amount. Each ally gets its own ward.

features.name: Trance of Order
features.description: As an action, enter a trancelike state for 1 minute. Attack rolls against you can't benefit from advantage, and whenever you make an attack roll, ability check, or saving throw, treat a d20 roll of 9 or lower as 10. Usable once per long rest (or spend 5 sorcery points).

features.name: Clockwork Cavalcade
features.description: As an action, summon spirits of order for 1 moment in a 30 ft cube centered on yourself: each creature in the area regains 1d8 + CHA mod HP, each broken object is mended, and each creature can end one disease or condition (blinded, deafened, paralyzed, poisoned, or stunned). Usable once per long rest (or spend 7 sorcery points).

starting_equipment: (a) Light crossbow and 20 bolts or (b) any simple weapon
Simple weapon, leather armor, two daggers

features.name: Spellcasting (Pact Magic)
features.description: You know spells from the warlock spell list. Charisma is your spellcasting ability. You can use an arcane focus as a spellcasting focus. Your pact magic slots recharge on a short rest. You always cast warlock spells at the highest slot level available to you.

features.name: Otherworldly Patron
features.description: Choose an Otherworldly Patron subclass which grants features at 1st level and again at 6th, 10th, and 14th levels.

features.name: Eldritch Invocations
features.description: Choose 2 eldritch invocations from the available list (prerequisites may apply). You learn additional invocations at 5th, 7th, 9th, 12th, 15th, and 18th levels. You can replace an invocation when you gain a level.

features.name: Pact Boon
features.description: Choose a Pact Boon: Pact of the Blade (create a melee weapon, use CHA for attacks), Pact of the Chain (learn find familiar with special options), or Pact of the Tome (gain 3 cantrips from any class).

features.name: Mystic Arcanum
features.description: Choose one 6th-level spell from the warlock spell list. You can cast it once per long rest without using a spell slot. Gain additional mystic arcanum at levels 13 (7th level), 15 (8th level), and 17 (9th level).

features.name: Eldritch Master
features.description: When you finish a short rest, you can recover all expended spell slots from your pact magic. Usable once per long rest.

The Archfey.description: Warlocks who serve the capricious and powerful lords of the Feywild.

features.name: Fey Presence
features.description: As an action, each creature in a 10 ft cube originating from you makes a WIS save or is charmed or frightened (your choice) by you until end of your next turn. Usable once per short or long rest.

features.name: Misty Escape
features.description: When you take damage, you can use your reaction to turn invisible and teleport up to 60 ft to an unoccupied space. You remain invisible until the start of your next turn or until you attack, cast a spell, or use a feature. Usable once per short or long rest.

features.name: Beguiling Defenses
features.description: You can't be charmed. When a creature charms you, you can use your reaction to turn the charm back on it (it makes WIS save or is charmed for 1 minute).

features.name: Dark Delirium
features.description: As an action, choose one creature within 60 ft. It makes a WIS save or is charmed or frightened (your choice) for 1 minute. While affected, it loses sight of everything except you. Usable once per long rest.

The Fiend.description: Warlocks who serve the dark powers of the Lower Planes.

features.name: Dark One's Blessing
features.description: When you reduce a hostile creature to 0 HP, you gain temporary HP equal to your CHA mod + warlock level.

features.name: Dark One's Own Luck
features.description: When you make an ability check or saving throw, you can roll 1d10 and add it to the result. You can do so after seeing the initial roll but before the outcome. Usable once per short or long rest.

features.name: Fiendish Resilience
features.description: Choose one damage type. You gain resistance to that damage type until you finish a long rest. Can't choose the same type twice in a row.

features.name: Hurl Through Hell
features.description: When you hit a creature with an attack, you can use this feature to instantly disappear and be transported to the Lower Planes. At the start of your next turn, the target reappears and takes 10d10 psychic damage. Usable once per long rest.

The Great Old One.description: Warlocks who serve unfathomable entities from the Far Realm.

features.name: Awakened Mind
features.description: You can telepathically speak to any creature within 30 ft that you can see. The creature doesn't need to share a language, but must be able to understand at least one.

features.name: Entropic Ward
features.description: When a creature attacks you, you can use your reaction to impose disadvantage. If the attack misses, your next attack roll against that creature has advantage. Usable once per short or long rest.

features.name: Thought Shield
features.description: You have resistance to psychic damage. When a creature reads your thoughts or deals psychic damage to you, it takes psychic damage equal to your CHA mod + warlock level.

features.name: Create Thrall
features.description: When you touch an incapacitated humanoid, you can implant a telepathic link. The creature is charmed by you and you can communicate telepathically through the link from any distance on the same plane. Usable once per long rest.

The Celestial.description: Warlocks who serve the forces of the Upper Planes and radiant power.

features.name: Bonus Cantrips
features.description: Learn light and sacred flame. They count as warlock cantrips for you.

features.name: Healing Light
features.description: As a bonus action, spend 1-5d6 from a pool (equal to warlock level + CHA mod, recharges on long rest) to heal one creature you can see within 60 ft. Roll the spent dice and restore that many HP.

features.name: Radiant Soul
features.description: Gain resistance to radiant damage. When you cast a spell that deals radiant or fire damage, add CHA mod to one damage roll of that spell against one creature.

features.name: Celestial Resilience
features.description: Gain temporary HP equal to warlock level + CHA mod when you finish a short or long rest. Scales with warlock level.

features.name: Searing Vengeance
features.description: When you drop to 0 HP, you can instead drop to 1 HP. You and all creatures of your choice within 30 ft regain 2d8 + CHA mod HP and each enemy within 30 ft makes a CON save or is blinded until end of your next turn. Usable once per long rest.

The Hexblade.description: Warlocks who serve mysterious entities from the Shadowfell that forge weapons.

features.name: Hexblade's Curse
features.description: As a bonus action, choose one creature you can see within 30 ft. You gain: bonus damage equal to proficiency bonus on damage rolls against it; attacks crit on 19-20; if it dies, regain HP equal to warlock level + CHA mod. Usable once per short or long rest. Lasts until target dies or you use it again.

features.name: Hex Warrior
features.description: Gain proficiency with medium armor, shields, and martial weapons. When you attack with a one-handed melee weapon, you can use CHA instead of STR/DEX for attack and damage rolls. If you have Pact of the Blade, this benefit applies to any weapon you conjure.

features.name: Accursed Specter
features.description: When you slay a humanoid with your Hexblade's Curse active, it rises as a specter under your command for 24 hours or until it drops to 0 HP. It acts on your turn. Usable once per long rest.

features.name: Armor of Hexes
features.description: When a target of your Hexblade's Curse hits you with an attack, roll a d6. On 4+, the attack misses instead.

features.name: Master of Hexes
features.description: When a target of your Hexblade's Curse dies, you can apply the curse to another creature you can see within 30 ft without using an action.

The Fathomless.description: Warlocks who serve the deep and alien powers of the ocean depths.

features.name: Tentacle of the Deeps
features.description: As a bonus action, create a 10 ft spectral tentacle within 60 ft that lasts for 1 minute. When you cast a spell on your turn, you can direct the tentacle to make a melee spell attack against one creature within 10 ft of it (1d8 cold damage, CHA mod times per long rest). At 10th level, damage increases to 2d8.

features.name: Eldritch Invocations: Fathomless
features.description: You can select from additional invocations related to your patron.

features.name: Guardian Coil
features.description: When you or a creature you can see within 30 ft takes damage, you can use your reaction to reduce the damage by 1d8 + your warlock level. Usable once per short or long rest.

features.name: Fathomless Plunge
features.description: As an action, teleport up to 30 ft to an unoccupied space and drag one creature within 5 ft with you. The target makes a STR save or is pulled with you. Usable once per short or long rest.

features.name: Devouring Maw
features.description: As an action, summon a maw of eldritch energy within 60 ft. Each creature in a 20 ft sphere makes a DEX save or takes 8d8 cold or acid damage (your choice) and is pulled up to 30 ft toward the center. You regain HP equal to half the damage dealt. Usable once per long rest.

The Genie.description: Warlocks who serve the noble genies of the Elemental Planes.

features.name: Genie's Vessel
features.description: Choose a genie type (Dao: bludgeoning/earth, Djinni: thunder/wind, Efreeti: fire, Marid: cold/water). Gain a vessel (Tiny object). While inside, you're safe from harm and can rest. When you cast a spell through the vessel, add proficiency bonus to one damage roll of that spell of the chosen type.

features.name: Elemental Gift
features.description: Gain resistance to the damage type of your genie patron. As a bonus action, add 1d8 of that damage type to one attack. Usable once per long rest (or spend a spell slot).

features.name: Sanctuary Vessel
features.description: When you enter your vessel, you can choose up to 5 willing creatures within 30 ft to enter with you. While inside, creatures are protected and can take a short rest.

features.name: Limited Wish
features.description: As an action, invoke your patron's power to duplicate the effect of any spell of 6th level or lower that doesn't have a cost. The spell takes effect and then vanishes. Usable once per 1d4 long rests.

The Undying.description: Warlocks who serve undying beings that have conquered death itself.

features.name: Among the Dead
features.description: Learn the spare the dying cantrip. You have advantage on saves against diseases and being poisoned. Undead have disadvantage on attacks against you for their first attack each combat.

features.name: Defy Death
features.description: When you succeed on a death saving throw, you can choose to regain HP equal to half your hit point maximum. When you use spare the dying on a creature, it regains 1d4 + CHA mod HP. Usable once per long rest.

features.name: Undying Nature
features.description: You suffer none of the frailty of old age and can't be aged magically. You don't need to eat, drink, or breathe.

features.name: Indestructible Life
features.description: When you drop to 0 HP, you can choose to drop to 1 HP instead. You then regain HP equal to half your hit point maximum. Usable once per long rest.

features.name: Spellcasting
features.description: You prepare wizard spells from your spellbook. Intelligence is your spellcasting ability. You can use an arcane focus as a spellcasting focus. You start with a spellbook containing six 1st-level wizard spells of your choice.

features.name: Arcane Recovery
features.description: Once per day during a short rest, recover expended spell slots with a combined level equal to or less than half your wizard level (rounded up). No slot can be 6th level or higher.

features.name: Arcane Tradition
features.description: Choose an Arcane Tradition subclass which grants features at 2nd level and again at 6th, 10th, and 14th levels.

features.name: Cantrip Formulas
features.description: When you gain a wizard level, you can replace one cantrip from your spellbook with another wizard cantrip.

features.name: Spell Mastery
features.description: Choose one 1st-level and one 2nd-level wizard spell from your spellbook. You can cast them at their lowest level without expending spell slots. If you want to cast at a higher level, you must expend a spell slot. You can change your chosen spells when you finish a long rest.

features.name: Signature Spells
features.description: Choose two 3rd-level wizard spells from your spellbook as your signature spells. You can cast each once at 3rd level without expending a spell slot. When you do so, you can't do so again until you finish a short or long rest. If you want to cast either spell at a higher level, you must expend a spell slot.

School of Abjuration.description: Wizards who specialize in protective magic and wards.

features.name: Abjuration Savant
features.description: Gold and time to copy abjuration spells into your spellbook is halved.

features.name: Arcane Ward
features.description: When you cast an abjuration spell of 1st level or higher, create an arcane ward with HP equal to twice the spell level + INT mod. The ward takes damage you would take. When you cast an abjuration spell, the ward regains HP equal to the spell's level.

features.name: Projected Ward
features.description: As a reaction when a creature within 30 ft takes damage, your arcane ward can absorb the damage instead.

features.name: Improved Abjuration
features.description: When you cast an abjuration spell that requires an ability check as part of the casting, add your proficiency bonus to that check.

features.name: Spell Resistance
features.description: You have advantage on saves against spells and other magical effects. You have resistance to damage from spells.

School of Conjuration.description: Wizards who specialize in creating objects and summoning creatures.

features.name: Conjuration Savant
features.description: Gold and time to copy conjuration spells into your spellbook is halved.

features.name: Minor Conjuration
features.description: As an action, conjure an inanimate object in your hand or on the ground within 10 ft. The object can be no more than 3 ft on a side, weigh no more than 10 lbs, and must be of a form you have seen. It glows faintly and disappears after 1 hour or if you use this feature again.

features.name: Benign Transposition
features.description: As an action, teleport up to 30 ft to an unoccupied space you can see. Alternatively, swap positions with a willing Medium or smaller creature within 30 ft. Usable once per short or long rest (or expend a conjuration spell slot).

features.name: Focused Conjuration
features.description: You can't lose concentration on conjuration spells from taking damage.

features.name: Durable Summons
features.description: Any creature you summon or create with a conjuration spell has 30 temporary HP.

School of Divination.description: Wizards who specialize in foresight and revealing hidden knowledge.

features.name: Divination Savant
features.description: Gold and time to copy divination spells into your spellbook is halved.

features.name: Portent
features.description: When you finish a long rest, roll 2d20 and record the numbers. You can replace any attack roll, saving throw, or ability check made by you or a creature you can see with one of these foretellings. Must be used before the roll. You regain the use when you finish a long rest.

features.name: Expert Divination
features.description: When you cast a divination spell of 2nd level or higher using a spell slot, regain one expended spell slot. The slot must be of a level lower than the cast spell and can't be above 5th level.

features.name: The Third Eye
features.description: As an action, gain one benefit for 10 minutes: darkvision 60 ft, see invisible creatures within 10 ft, read any language, or see through illusions. Usable once per short or long rest.

features.name: Greater Portent
features.description: Roll 3d20 for your Portent feature instead of 2d20.

School of Enchantment.description: Wizards who specialize in charming and beguiling minds.

features.name: Enchantment Savant
features.description: Gold and time to copy enchantment spells into your spellbook is halved.

features.name: Hypnotic Gaze
features.description: As an action, choose one creature you can see within 5 ft. It must make a WIS save or be charmed for 1 minute. While charmed, its speed is 0 and it is incapacitated. Ends if it takes damage or you use this again. Usable once per short or long rest.

features.name: Instinctive Charm
features.description: When a creature you can see within 30 ft makes an attack against a target other than you, use your reaction to divert the attack. The attacker makes a WIS save; on fail, it must target you or another creature. Usable once per short or long rest.

features.name: Split Enchantment
features.description: When you cast an enchantment spell of 1st level or higher that targets one creature, it can target two creatures.

features.name: Alter Memories
features.description: When you charm a humanoid with an enchantment spell, you can alter its memories so it forgets being charmed. You can also make it forget up to 10 minutes of time while charmed.

School of Evocation.description: Wizards who specialize in elemental and offensive magic.

features.name: Evocation Savant
features.description: Gold and time to copy evocation spells into your spellbook is halved.

features.name: Sculpt Spells
features.description: When you cast an evocation spell that affects other creatures you can see, choose a number of them equal to 1 + the spell's level. Those creatures automatically succeed on their saves and take no damage.

features.name: Potent Cantrip
features.description: A creature that fails its save against one of your cantrips takes half damage rather than none.

features.name: Empowered Evocation
features.description: Add your INT modifier to the damage of any evocation spell you cast.

features.name: Overchannel
features.description: When you cast a wizard spell of 5th level or lower that deals damage, you can deal maximum damage. The first time you do so, no ill effect. Each subsequent time before a long rest, take 2d12 necrotic damage per spell level. This damage can't be reduced.

School of Illusion.description: Wizards who specialize in deception and false imagery.

features.name: Illusion Savant
features.description: Gold and time to copy illusion spells into your spellbook is halved.

features.name: Improved Minor Illusion
features.description: You learn the minor illusion cantrip. When you cast it, you can create both a sound and an image with a single casting.

features.name: Malleable Illusions
features.description: When you cast an illusion spell with a duration of 1 minute or longer, you can use your action to change the nature of that illusion (using the spell's normal parameters).

features.name: Illusory Self
features.description: When a creature makes an attack roll against you, use your reaction to create an illusory duplicate in your space. The attack automatically misses, and the illusion disappears. Usable once per short or long rest.

features.name: Illusory Reality
features.description: When you cast an illusion spell of 1st level or higher, you can choose one inanimate, nonliving object that is part of the illusion and make it real for 1 minute. It can't deal damage or cause conditions.

School of Necromancy.description: Wizards who specialize in death and undeath.

features.name: Necromancy Savant
features.description: Gold and time to copy necromancy spells into your spellbook is halved.

features.name: Grim Harvest
features.description: When you kill a creature with a spell of 1st level or higher, regain HP equal to twice the spell's level (three times if the spell is necromancy). Doesn't work on constructs or undead.

features.name: Undead Thralls
features.description: Learn animate dead if you don't know it. When you cast it, you can animate one additional skeleton or zombie. Undead you create with the spell gain: +1 HP per HD, and add your proficiency bonus to weapon damage rolls.

features.name: Inured to Undeath
features.description: You have resistance to necrotic damage. Your HP maximum can't be reduced.

features.name: Command Undead
features.description: As an action, target one undead creature you can see within 60 ft. It makes a CHA save against your spell save DC. On fail, it becomes friendly to you and obeys your commands. Usable once per long rest.

School of Transmutation.description: Wizards who specialize in transforming matter and energy.

features.name: Transmutation Savant
features.description: Gold and time to copy transmutation spells into your spellbook is halved.

features.name: Minor Alchemy
features.description: As an action, alter the physical composition of a nonmagical object you can see within 10 ft. Change wood to stone, stone to metal, iron to wood, or copper to silver for 1 hour. Object must fit within a 1 ft cube. Usable INT mod times per long rest.

features.name: Transmuter's Stone
features.description: Spend 8 hours creating a transmuter's stone. While carrying it, gain one benefit: darkvision 60 ft, +10 ft speed, proficiency in CON saves, or resistance to acid, cold, fire, lightning, or thunder. When you cast a transmutation spell of 1st level or higher, you can change the stone's effect. If the stone is destroyed, you can create a new one.

features.name: Shapechanger
features.description: You can cast polymorph on yourself once per short or long rest without expending a spell slot. Can only transform into a beast with CR equal to or less than your level.

features.name: Master Transmuter
features.description: As an action, consume your transmuter's stone to produce one effect: Major Transformation (nonmagical object up to 5 ft cube becomes another nonmagical substance), Panacea (cure all diseases, poisons, and conditions of one creature), Restore Life (resurrect one creature dead no more than 1 day, returns with 1 HP), or Restore Youth (creature ages backwards 3d10 years, minimum 13).

War Magic.description: Wizards who blend evocation and abjuration for battlefield supremacy.

features.name: Arcane Deflection
features.description: As a reaction when hit by an attack or fail a save, gain +2 AC against the attack or +4 to the save. If you use this, you can only cast cantrips on your next turn.

features.name: Tactical Wit
features.description: Gain advantage on initiative rolls.

features.name: Power Surge
features.description: Gain one power surge. When you start combat with no surges, gain one. When you successfully end a spell with dispel magic or when a spell you cast fails to affect a creature, gain one surge. When you deal damage with a wizard spell, expend one surge to deal extra force damage equal to half your wizard level. Max surges = INT mod.

features.name: Durable Magic
features.description: While concentrating on a spell, you gain +2 AC and +2 to all saves.

features.name: Deflecting Shroud
features.description: When you use Arcane Deflection, magical energy arcs from you. Up to 3 creatures of your choice within 60 ft take force damage equal to half your wizard level.

Order of Scribes.description: Wizards who unlock the magical potential of their spellbooks.

features.name: Wizardly Quill
features.description: As a bonus action, conjure a Tiny quill in your free hand. It writes without ink, can't be taken from you, and summarizing text takes 1/10th the time. When you copy a spell into your spellbook, the time and gold cost is halved.

features.name: Awakened Spellbook
features.description: While holding your spellbook, you can use it as a spellcasting focus. You can cast any wizard spell with a ritual tag from your spellbook as a ritual even if you don't have it prepared. When you cast a wizard spell with a spell slot, you can replace its damage type with the damage type of another spell in your spellbook of the same level.

features.name: Manifest Mind
features.description: As a bonus action, manifest a Tiny spectral mind from your spellbook. It has fly speed 30 ft, HP equal to your wizard level + INT mod, and your AC. You can cast spells as if you were in its space. It disappears if reduced to 0 HP or you dismiss it (no action). Usable once per long rest (or expend a spell slot).

features.name: Master Scrivener
features.description: Whenever you finish a long rest, you can create one spell scroll of a wizard spell from your spellbook of 1st or 2nd level. The scroll uses your spell save DC and spell attack bonus. It lasts until your next long rest.

features.name: One with the Word
features.description: As a reaction when you take damage, your spellbook can absorb it. You take half damage and your spellbook takes the rest. If your spellbook is destroyed, you lose all spells not currently prepared. Usable once per long rest (or expend a spell slot of 5th level or higher).

Bladesinging.description: Wizards who blend martial skill with arcane magic in a deadly dance.

features.name: Training in War and Song
features.description: Gain proficiency with one-handed melee weapons and light armor. Gain proficiency in Performance or one musical instrument.

features.name: Bladesong
features.description: As a bonus action, start a Bladesong for 1 minute (concentration). While active: +INT mod to AC, +10 ft walking speed, +INT mod to CON saves to maintain concentration, advantage on Performance checks. Ends if you wear medium/heavy armor, use two-handed weapon, or cast a spell with V component. Usable twice per short or long rest (proficiency bonus times at higher levels).

features.name: Extra Attack
features.description: You can attack twice instead of once when you take the Attack action on your turn.

features.name: Song of Defense
features.description: While your Bladesong is active, when you take damage, you can use your reaction to expend one spell slot and reduce the damage by 5 × the slot's level.

features.name: Song of Victory
features.description: While your Bladesong is active, you add your INT modifier to the damage of your melee weapon attacks.

Chronurgy Magic.description: Wizards who manipulate time and its flow across the multiverse.

features.name: Chronal Shift
features.description: As a reaction when a creature you can see makes an attack roll, ability check, or saving throw, you can force it to reroll. You can do so after the roll but before the outcome. The creature must use the new roll. Usable twice per long rest.

features.name: Temporal Awareness
features.description: Add your INT modifier to your initiative rolls.

features.name: Momentary Stasis
features.description: As an action, target one creature you can see within 60 ft. It makes a CON save or is incapacitated and suspended in time for 1 round. Usable INT mod times per long rest.

features.name: Arcane Abeyance
features.description: When you cast a spell using a spell slot of 4th level or lower, you can condense the magic into a Tiny bead. A creature holding the bead can cast the spell using your spell save DC and spell attack bonus. The bead lasts 1 minute before becoming inert. Usable once per long rest.

features.name: Convergent Future
features.description: As a reaction, glimpse into the future to ensure one outcome. You can force one attack roll, ability check, or saving throw to succeed or fail. Each time you use this after the first, you gain one level of exhaustion. Usable once per short or long rest.

Graviturgy Magic.description: Wizards who manipulate gravity and the forces that bind the cosmos.

features.name: Adjust Density
features.description: As an action, target one creature or object you can see within 60 ft. It becomes heavier or lighter for 1 minute. Heavier: -10 ft speed, when it hits with a melee attack it deals extra 1d4 bludgeoning damage. Lighter: +10 ft speed, when it takes bludgeoning damage it takes extra 1d4. Usable INT mod times per long rest.

features.name: Gravity Well
features.description: When you cast a spell on a creature, you can move it 5 ft toward or away from you. The creature can't be moved into hazardous terrain.

features.name: Violent Attraction
features.description: When a creature or object within 60 ft takes damage from a fall or a ranged weapon attack, you can use your reaction to increase the damage by 1d10. Usable once per short or long rest.

features.name: Event Horizon
features.description: As an action, create a 20 ft radius sphere of gravitational energy centered on yourself for 1 minute (concentration). Difficult terrain for other creatures. When a creature starts its turn in the area, it must make a STR save or be pulled up to 20 ft toward you and be restrained. It can repeat the save at end of its turn. Usable once per long rest.

tools: One artisan tool of your choice

starting_equipment: (a) Studded leather armor or (b) Scale mail
(a) Thieves' tools or (b) Any artisan tool
(a) Light crossbow and 20 bolts or (b) Two handaxes

features.name: Spellcasting
features.description: You prepare artificer spells from the artificer spell list. Intelligence is your spellcasting ability. You can use a spellcasting focus (any artisan tool or an infused item) for your spells. You can use any weapon or item with a spell infusion as a spellcasting focus.

features.name: Magical Tinkering
features.description: As an action, touch a Tiny nonmagical object and impart one property: shed bright light 5 ft (+ dim 5 ft), play a recorded message up to 6 seconds, emit an odor, or create a static visual effect. You can have a number of objects affected equal to INT mod (min 1).

features.name: Infuse Item
features.description: At the end of a long rest, you can touch a nonmagical object and infuse it with one of your artificer infusions. You know 4 infusions and learn more at higher levels. Maximum number of infused items = INT mod (min 1). Infusions last until your next long rest. You can replace one infusion when you gain a level.

features.name: Artificer Specialist
features.description: Choose an Artificer Specialist subclass which grants features at 3rd level and again at 5th, 9th, and 15th levels.

features.name: The Right Tool for the Job
features.description: As an action, create one set of artisan's tools in any container within 5 ft. You can use thieves' tools or artisan's tools to cast spells. The tools last until your next long rest.

features.name: Tool Expertise
features.description: Your proficiency bonus is doubled for any ability check using any tool you are proficient with.

features.name: Flash of Genius
features.description: When you or a creature you can see within 30 ft makes an ability check or saving throw, you can use your reaction to add your INT modifier to the roll. Usable INT mod times per long rest.

features.name: Artificer Infusion: Extra
features.description: Gain additional known infusions. You can have more infused items simultaneously.

features.name: Magic Item Adept
features.description: You can attune to up to four magic items instead of three. When you craft a common or uncommon magic item, it takes a quarter of the normal time and half the normal gold.

features.name: Spell-Storing Item
features.description: As an action, touch a simple or martial weapon or an item you can use as a spellcasting focus. One creature holding it can use an action to cast one of your 1st or 2nd level artificer spells (spell save DC and attack bonus use yours). The item has charges = 2 × INT mod. Recharges at end of long rest.

features.name: Magic Item Savant
features.description: You can attune to up to five magic items. You ignore all class, race, spell, and level requirements on attuning to or using a magic item.

features.name: Magic Item Master
features.description: You can attune to up to six magic items.

features.name: Soul of Artifice
features.description: You gain +1 to all saving throws per magic item you are attuned to. When you drop to 0 HP but don't die, you can end one of your artificer infusions and instead drop to 1 HP. Usable once per long rest.

Alchemist.description: Artificers who focus on alchemy, creating elixirs and chemical concoctions.

features.name: Alchemist Spells
features.description: Always have certain spells prepared after you reach the specified levels (3rd, 5th, 9th, 13th, 17th). These don't count against your prepared spells.

features.name: Experimental Elixir
features.description: When you finish a long rest, create one experimental elixir in an empty flask. Roll on the elixir table: 1d6 (1: Healing, 2: Swiftness, 3: Resilience, 4: Boldness, 5: Flight, 6: Transformation). At higher levels, you create more elixirs (2 at 6th, 3 at 15th). You can create additional elixirs by expending a spell slot of 1st level or higher.

features.name: Alchemical Savant
features.description: When you cast a spell using a spell slot that restores HP or deals acid, fire, necrotic, or poison damage, add your INT modifier to one damage or healing roll. No bonus to a creature already benefiting from this feature.

features.name: Enduring Elixir
features.description: Elixir effects that normally last 10 minutes now last 1 hour.

features.name: Chemical Mastery
features.description: Gain resistance to acid and poison damage. You are immune to the poisoned condition. When you create an experimental elixir, you can choose the effect instead of rolling.

Artillerist.description: Artificers who create magical cannons and explosive devices.

features.name: Artillerist Spells
features.description: Always have certain spells prepared after you reach the specified levels (3rd, 5th, 9th, 13th, 17th). These don't count against your prepared spells.

features.name: Eldritch Cannon
features.description: As an action, create a Small or Tiny eldritch cannon on the ground within 5 ft or in your hand. Choose type: Flamethrower (15 ft cone, 2d8 fire damage, DEX save), Force Ballista (120 ft line, 2d8 force damage, pushed 5 ft), or Protector (10 ft radius, 2d8 healing to allies). You can activate it as a bonus action. HP = 5 × artificer level. AC = 18. Lasts 1 hour. Usable once per short or long rest (or expend a spell slot). At 15th level, damage becomes 3d8.

features.name: Arcane Firearm
features.description: You can use an arcane firearm as a spellcasting focus. When you cast an artificer spell through it, deal extra 1d8 fire damage to one target.

features.name: Explosive Cannon
features.description: Your eldritch cannon damage increases to 3d8. As an action, you can command the cannon to detonate in a 15 ft sphere (3d8 force damage, DEX save).

features.name: Fortified Position
features.description: You and allies within 10 ft of your eldritch cannon gain half cover. Your cannon damage increases to 4d8.

Battle Smith.description: Artificers who combine martial prowess with mechanical companions.

features.name: Battle Smith Spells
features.description: Always have certain spells prepared after you reach the specified levels (3rd, 5th, 9th, 13th, 17th). These don't count against your prepared spells.

features.name: Steel Defender
features.description: You create a Medium steel defender. It is friendly to you and companions. It takes its turn immediately after yours. It can move and use its reaction on its own but only takes the Dodge action unless you use a bonus action to command it. It has HP = 2 + INT mod + 5 × artificer level. AC = 15 + proficiency bonus. If it dies, you can create a new one with 1 hour of work and 10 gp of materials.

features.name: Battle Ready
features.description: Gain proficiency with martial weapons. When you attack with a magic weapon, use INT instead of STR or DEX for attack and damage rolls.

features.name: Extra Attack
features.description: You can attack twice instead of once whenever you take the Attack action on your turn.

features.name: Arcane Jolt
features.description: When your steel defender hits or you hit with a magic weapon, deal extra 2d6 force damage. Usable INT mod times per long rest. At 15th level, damage increases to 4d6.

features.name: Improved Defender
features.description: Your steel defender gains a +2 bonus to AC. Its Deflect Attack reaction gives you half cover instead of +2 AC. Arcane Jolt damage increases to 4d6.

Armorer.description: Artificers who create and wield magical power armor.

features.name: Armorer Spells
features.description: Always have certain spells prepared after you reach the specified levels (3rd, 5th, 9th, 13th, 17th). These don't count against your prepared spells.

features.name: Arcane Armor
features.description: You can turn any scale mail, breastplate, or half plate into arcane armor. It doesn't impose STR requirements or impose disadvantage on Stealth. You can don or doff it in 1 action. You can use it as a spellcasting focus. You can infuse it with any infusion that requires a suit of armor.

features.name: Armor Model
features.description: Choose Guardian or Infiltrator model. Guardian: gain Heavy armor proficiency, armor gauntlets are melee weapons (1d8 thunder, INT for attack/damage), when you hit a creature you can impose disadvantage on its attacks against anyone but you until your next turn. Infiltrator: armor adds +5 ft speed, you can use a bonus action to activate a lightning launcher (range 90 ft, 1d6 lightning, INT for attack/damage), when you hit a creature with it, you gain advantage on the next attack against it. Change model during a long rest.

features.name: Extra Attack
features.description: You can attack twice instead of once whenever you take the Attack action on your turn.

features.name: Armor Modifications
features.description: You can add additional infusions to your armor. Your armor can have up to 2 infusions instead of 1.

features.name: Perfected Armor
features.description: Guardian: When a creature within 5 ft hits you, you can use your reaction to deal 1d8 + INT mod force damage. Infiltrator: Your lightning launcher damage becomes 1d8 + INT mod and you gain advantage on Stealth checks.

spellcasting.spells_prepared: INT mod + half artificer level (rounded up, min 1)

feature.name: Shelter of the Faithful
feature.description: As an acolyte, you command the respect of those who share your faith, and you can perform the religious ceremonies of your deity. You and your adventuring companions can expect to receive free healing, care, and food at a temple, shrine, or other established presence of your faith, though you must provide any material components needed for spells. Those who share your religion will support you at a modest lifestyle. You may also have ties to a specific temple dedicated to your chosen deity or pantheon, and you have a residence there.

feature.name: False Identity
feature.description: You have created a second identity that includes documentation, established acquaintances, and disguises allowing you to assume that persona. You can forge documents including official papers and personal letters, as long as you have seen an example of the kind of document or the handwriting you are trying to copy.

equipment: a set of dark common clothes including a hood

feature.name: Criminal Contact
feature.description: You have a reliable and trustworthy contact who acts as your liaison to a network of other criminals. You know how to get messages to and from your contact, even over great distances; specifically, you know the local messengers, corrupt caravan masters, and seedy sailors who can deliver messages for you.

Spy.description: You are a spy rather than a common criminal.

equipment: A musical instrument (one of your choice)

feature.name: By Popular Demand
feature.description: You can always find a place to perform, usually in an inn or tavern but possibly with a circus, at a theater, or even in a noble's court. At such a place, you receive free lodging and food of a modest or comfortable standard, as long as you perform each night. Your performance makes you something of a local figure; when strangers recognize you in a town where you have performed, they typically take a liking to you.

Gladiator.description: You are a gladiator rather than a stage entertainer.

equipment: A set of artisan's tools (one of your choice)

feature.name: Rustic Hospitality
feature.description: Since you come from the ranks of the common folk, you fit in among them with ease. You can find a place to hide, rest, or recuperate among other commoners, unless you have shown yourself to be a danger to them. They will shield you from the law or anyone else searching for you, though they will not risk their lives for you.

equipment: A set of artisan's tools (one of your choice)

feature.name: Guild Membership
feature.description: As an established and respected member of a guild, you can rely on certain benefits that membership provides. Your fellow guild members will provide you with lodging and food if necessary, and pay for your funeral if needed. In some cities and towns, a guildhall offers a central place to meet other members of your profession, which can be a good place to meet potential patrons, allies, or hirelings.

Merchant.description: You are a merchant rather than an artisan.

equipment: A scroll case stuffed full of notes from your studies

feature.name: Discovery
feature.description: The quiet seclusion of your extended hermitage gave you access to a unique and powerful discovery. The exact nature of this revelation depends on the nature of your seclusion. Work with your DM to determine the details of your discovery and its impact on the campaign.

feature.name: Position of Privilege
feature.description: Thanks to your noble birth, people are inclined to think the best of you. You are welcome in high society, and people assume you have the right to be wherever you are. You can secure an audience with a local noble if you need to.

Knight.description: You are a knight rather than a standard noble.

equipment: a trophy from an animal you killed

feature.name: Wanderer
feature.description: You have an excellent memory for maps and geography, and you can always recall the general layout of terrain, settlements, and other features around you. In addition, you can find food and fresh water for yourself and up to five other people each day, provided that the land offers berries, small game, water, and so forth.

equipment: a letter from a dead colleague posing a question you have not yet been able to answer

feature.name: Researcher
feature.description: When you attempt to learn or recall a piece of lore, if you do not have that information in your records, you often know where and from whom you can obtain it. Usually, this information comes from a library, scriptorium, university, or a sage or other learned person or creature. Your DM might rule that the knowledge you seek is secreted away in an almost inaccessible place, or that it simply cannot be found.

feature.name: Ship's Passage
