feature.description: When you need to, you can secure free passage on a sailing ship for yourself and your adventuring companions. You might sail on the ship you served on, or another ship you have good relations with. Because you're calling in a favor, you can't be certain of the schedule or route. Your DM will determine how long it takes to get where you need to go. In return for your free passage, you and your companions are expected to assist the crew during the voyage.

Pirate.description: You are a pirate rather than a regular sailor.

equipment: a trophy taken from a fallen enemy

feature.name: Military Rank
feature.description: You have a military rank from your career as a soldier. Soldiers loyal to your former military organization still recognize your authority and influence, and they defer to you if they are of a lower rank. You can invoke your rank to exert influence over other soldiers and requisition simple equipment or horses for temporary use. You can also usually gain access to friendly military encampments and fortresses where your rank is recognized.

equipment: a map of the city you grew up in
a token to remember your parents by

feature.name: City Secrets
feature.description: You know the secret patterns and flow to cities and can find passages through the urban sprawl that others would miss. When you are not in combat, you (and companions you lead) can travel between any two locations in the city twice as fast as your speed would normally allow.

equipment: A uniform in the style of your unit
a horn with which to summon help

feature.name: Watcher's Eye
feature.description: Your experience in enforcing the law, and dealing with lawbreakers, gives you a feel for local laws and criminals. You can easily find the local outpost of the watch or a similar organization, and fellow members of the watch are inclined to treat you as a colleague. You also have a limited ability to identify criminals and criminal organizations in the area.

equipment: A set of artisan's tools (one of your choice)

feature.name: Respect of the Stout Folk
feature.description: As well respected as clan crafters are among outsiders, no one esteems them quite so highly as dwarves do. You always have free room and board in any place where dwarves dwell, and the individuals in such a settlement might volunteer information or assistance to you.

skill_proficiencies: one of Arcana, Nature, or Religion
equipment: a letter from a dead colleague posing a question

feature.name: Library Access
feature.description: Though others must often endure extensive interviews and significant fees to gain access to a library or private collection, you have free and ready access to the majority of libraries and collections in your region. You can also gain access to private collections that are otherwise sealed, though this may require a small bribe or favor.

equipment: a token from a noble patron

feature.name: Court Functionary
feature.description: Your knowledge of how bureaucracies function lets you gain access to the records and inner workings of any noble court or government you encounter. You know who to talk to and where to go to obtain information or navigate red tape.

skill_proficiencies: one of Intimidation, Deception, or Persuasion
equipment: A badge or emblem of your faction

feature.name: Safe Haven
feature.description: As a faction agent, you have access to a secret network of supporters and operatives who can provide assistance on your adventures. You know a contact in each settlement who can provide a safe house, information, or other help as needed.

tool_proficiencies: One type of gaming set or musical instrument
equipment: any one musical instrument or gaming set
a small piece of jewelry worth 10 gp

feature.name: All Eyes on You
feature.description: Your accent, mannerisms, figures of speech, and perhaps even your appearance all mark you as foreign. Curious glances are directed your way wherever you go, which can be a nuisance, but you also gain the friendly interest of scholars and others intrigued by far-off lands. You can parley this attention into access to people and places you might not otherwise have, for you and your traveling companions.

skill_proficiencies: one of Arcana, History, or Religion
equipment: Your inheritance (a signet ring or similar token)

feature.name: Inheritance
feature.description: You have inherited something of great value, whether a physical item, a title, or perhaps a secret. This inheritance is tied to a larger story — perhaps others seek it, or it carries a burden. Work with your DM to determine the nature of the inheritance and its implications.

skill_proficiencies: one of Arcana, History, Nature, or Religion
equipment: A tabard or crest of your order

feature.name: Knightly Regard
feature.description: You receive shelter and succor from members of your knightly order and those who are sympathetic to its aims. If your order is a military one, you can gain access to fortresses and other strongholds controlled by the order. You also have a limited ability to call upon the resources of the order.

equipment: a trophy from a past battle

feature.name: Mercenary Life
feature.description: You know the mercenary life as only someone who has experienced it can. You are able to identify mercenary companies and their distinguishing insignia, and you can find work as a mercenary without difficulty. You also have a limited ability to identify military organizations and their capabilities.

skill_proficiencies: two of Deception, Insight, Persuasion, or Stealth
equipment: a small weapon of your choice

feature.name: Ear to the Ground
feature.description: You are in frequent contact with people in the segment of society that your chosen quarries move through. These people might be associated with the criminal underworld, the rougher side of the trade world, or even among the poor. You can easily get word to such people about people or activities you are tracking.

equipment: a totemic token or set of tattoos marking your tribe

feature.name: Uthgardt Heritage
feature.description: You have an excellent knowledge of the Uthgardt tribes and their territories. You can find your way through the wilderness with ease, and you know the locations of ancestral mounds and other sacred sites. Other Uthgardt tribesfolk are likely to offer you shelter and aid.

feature.name: Kept in Style
feature.description: While you are in Waterdeep or elsewhere in the North, your house sees to your everyday needs. Your name and signet are sufficient to cover most of your expenses; the inns and other establishments will send the bill to your family's estate in Waterdeep.

equipment: a costume or set of fine clothes

feature.name: Faceless Persona
feature.description: You have a second identity that you use as a faceless — a persona that operates in the shadows, separate from your public face. This persona has its own name, mannerisms, and reputation. You can switch between identities, and others who know one identity are unlikely to connect it with the other. You have advantage on Charisma (Deception) checks to maintain your secret identity.

skill_proficiencies: one of Intimidation, Deception, or Persuasion
equipment: a badge or emblem of your faction

feature.name: Faction Agent (Avernus Variant)
feature.description: You have connections with a faction operating in or around Baldur's Gate and the surrounding region. You can call upon your faction for aid, including shelter, information, and minor resources. Your faction may also give you missions or tasks to complete.

feature.name: Cultural Chameleon
feature.description: Before becoming an adventurer, you spent much of your adult life away from your homeland, living among people different from your kin. You came to understand these foreign cultures and the manner in which they operate, enabling you to blend in among them. You can use your action to feign a culture you have studied for 1 hour, gaining advantage on Charisma checks to interact with members of that culture.

feature.name: Historical Knowledge
feature.description: When you study a ruin or ancient site, you can ascertain its original purpose and determine what kind of creatures lived or operated there. You can also determine the approximate age of ruins and any significant events that may have occurred there.

skill_proficiencies: two of Arcana, Investigation, Religion, or Survival

feature.name: Heart of Darkness
feature.description: Those who look into your eyes can see that you have faced unimaginable horror and that you are no stranger to darkness. Though they might fear you, commoners will extend you every courtesy and do their utmost to help you. Unless you have shown yourself to be a danger to them, they will even take up arms to fight alongside you, should you find yourself facing an enemy alone.

feature.name: Boros Authority
feature.description: You can invoke the authority of the Boros Legion to gain access to areas and information related to crime and justice. Law-abiding citizens and Boros soldiers are inclined to cooperate with you, and you can request access to crime scenes and evidence.

equipment: a signet ring of the Knights of Solamnia

feature.name: Squire of Solamnia
feature.description: You are a squire or knight of the Knights of Solamnia. You can find shelter and aid at any Solamnic outpost or fortress. Fellow knights and their allies will provide you with food, lodging, and basic assistance. You also gain the ability to invoke your rank to requisition simple equipment.

feature.name: Initiate of High Sorcery
feature.description: You have been initiated into the Mages of High Sorcery. You can access the libraries and resources of the Towers of High Sorcery. Other members of the order will provide you with shelter and aid, and you can identify fellow members by secret signs.

feature.name: Keen Eye
feature.description: You are skilled at noticing details others miss. When you enter a new location, you can make an Investigation check to notice hidden details such as secret doors, concealed compartments, or clues about recent events that transpired there.

tool_proficiencies: One type of musical instrument or gaming set
equipment: a personal memento from your famous parent

feature.name: Name Dropping
feature.description: You can leverage your famous parent's reputation for your own benefit. You can get an audience with local nobles or officials by mentioning your parent's name, and people who recognize the name are inclined to treat you favorably — or at least pay attention to you.

feature.name: Street Urchin
feature.description: You grew up on the streets, alone and poor. You know the alleys, sewers, and secret passages of any city. You can find food and shelter among the poor and desperate, and you can move through urban areas without drawing attention.

feature.name: Competitive Edge
feature.description: You are driven to prove yourself better than your rivals. When working alongside others, you push yourself to excel, gaining advantage on ability checks when you are in direct competition with another individual.

equipment: a small token of plasmoid heritage

feature.name: Amorphous Heritage
feature.description: Your plasmoid ancestry grants you a connection to your shape-shifting heritage. You can squeeze through spaces as narrow as 1 inch wide, provided you are not wearing rigid armor. You also have advantage on ability checks to escape from being grappled or restrained.

equipment: A prayer book or prayer wheel

feature.name: Divine Contact
feature.description: You have a connection with a deity or other cosmic force. Work with your DM to determine the nature of this contact. You can cast the augury spell, using Wisdom as your spellcasting ability. You can cast it a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a long rest. At 5th level, you can also cast the clairvoyance spell. Once you cast it with this feature, you can't do so again until you finish a long rest.

equipment: a trinket from your home world

feature.name: Ship's Passage
feature.description: You can secure free passage on a spelljamming ship for yourself and your adventuring companions. In exchange for the free passage, you are expected to assist the crew with ship operations during the voyage. This might include standing watch, helping with repairs, or defending the ship against threats.

Actor.description: Skilled at mimicry and dramatics, you gain the following benefits: Increase your Charisma score by 1, to a maximum of 20. You have advantage on Charisma (Deception) and Charisma (Performance) checks when trying to pass yourself off as a different person. You can mimic the speech of another person or the sounds made by other creatures. You must have heard the person speaking or heard the creature make the sound for at least 1 minute. A successful Insight check contested by your Deception check allows a listener to determine that the effect is faked.

effects.other_mechanical: Advantage on Deception/Performance checks to impersonate; mimic speech/sounds after 1 min listening (contested Insight vs Deception to detect)

Alert.description: Always on the lookout for danger, you gain the following benefits: You gain a +5 bonus to initiative. You can't be surprised while you are conscious. Other creatures don't gain advantage on attack rolls against you as a result of being hidden from you.

effects.other_mechanical: No advantage for hidden attackers against you

Athlete.description: You have undergone extensive physical training to gain the following benefits: Increase your Strength or Dexterity score by 1, to a maximum of 20. When you are prone, standing up uses only 5 feet of your movement. Climbing doesn't cost you extra movement. You can make a running long jump or a running high jump after moving only 5 feet on foot, rather than 10 feet.

effects.other_mechanical: Standing from prone costs 5ft movement; climbing costs no extra movement; running jump needs only 5ft of movement

Charger.description: When you use your action to Dash, you can use a bonus action to make one melee weapon attack or to shove a creature. If you move at least 10 feet in a straight line immediately before taking this bonus action, you either gain a +5 bonus to the attack's damage roll (if you chose to make a melee attack and hit) or push the target up to 10 feet away from you (if you chose to shove and you succeed).

effects.other_mechanical: Dash action allows bonus action melee attack or shove; +5 damage if 10ft straight-line movement before melee attack; push 10ft on shove after 10ft straight-line movement

Crossbow Expert.description: Thanks to extensive practice with the crossbow, you gain the following benefits: You ignore the loading quality of crossbows with which you are proficient. Being within 5 feet of a hostile creature doesn't impose disadvantage on your ranged attack rolls. When you use the Attack action and attack with a one-handed weapon, you can use a bonus action to attack with a hand crossbow you are holding.

effects.other_mechanical: Ignore loading property on proficient crossbows; no disadvantage on ranged attacks within 5ft of hostile creature; bonus action hand crossbow attack when attacking with one-handed weapon

Defensive Duelist.description: When you are wielding a finesse weapon with which you are proficient and another creature hits you with a melee attack, you can use your reaction to add your proficiency bonus to your AC for that attack, potentially causing the attack to miss you.

effects.other_mechanical: Reaction: add proficiency bonus to AC against melee hit when wielding proficient finesse weapon

Dual Wielder.description: You master fighting with two weapons, gaining the following benefits: You gain a +1 bonus to AC while you are wielding a separate melee weapon in each hand. You can use two-weapon fighting even when the one-handed melee weapons you are wielding aren't light. You can draw or stow two one-handed weapons when you would normally be able to draw or stow only one.

effects.other_mechanical: +1 AC when wielding melee weapon in each hand; two-weapon fighting without light property; draw/stow two one-handed weapons

Dungeon Delver.description: Alert to the hidden traps and secret doors found in many dungeons, you gain the following benefits: When you roll a Hit Die to regain hit points, the minimum number of hit points you regain from the roll equals twice your Constitution modifier (minimum of 2). You have advantage on Wisdom (Perception) and Intelligence (Investigation) checks made to detect the presence of secret doors. You have advantage on saving throws made to avoid or resist traps. You have resistance to the damage dealt by traps. You can search for traps while traveling at a normal pace, instead of only at a slow pace.

effects.other_mechanical: Search for traps at normal pace; hit die minimum = 2x CON mod (min 2)

Durable.description: Hardy and resilient, you gain the following benefits: Increase your Constitution score by 1, to a maximum of 20. When you roll a Hit Die to regain hit points, the minimum number of hit points you regain from the roll equals twice your Constitution modifier (minimum of 2).

effects.other_mechanical: Hit die minimum equals 2x CON modifier (minimum 2)

Elemental Adept.prerequisite: The ability to cast at least one spell
Elemental Adept.description: When you gain this feat, choose one of the following damage types: acid, cold, fire, lightning, or thunder. Spells you cast ignore resistance to damage of the chosen type. In addition, when you roll damage for a spell you cast that deals damage of that type, you can treat any 1 on a damage die as a 2. You can select this feat multiple times. Each time you do so, you must choose a different damage type.

effects.other_mechanical: Ignore resistance to chosen damage type (acid/cold/fire/lightning/thunder); treat 1s as 2s on spell damage dice of chosen type

Great Weapon Master.description: You've learned to put the weight of a weapon to your advantage, letting its momentum empower your strikes. You gain the following benefits: On your turn, when you score a critical hit with a melee weapon or reduce a creature to 0 hit points with one, you can make one melee weapon attack as a bonus action. Before you make a melee attack with a heavy weapon that you are proficient with, you can choose to take a -5 penalty to the attack roll. If the attack hits, you add +10 to the attack's damage.

effects.other_mechanical: Bonus action melee attack on crit or reducing creature to 0 HP with melee weapon; -5 attack/+10 damage with proficient heavy melee weapon (optional)

Heavily Armored.description: You have trained to master the use of heavy armor, gaining the following benefits: Increase your Strength score by 1, to a maximum of 20. You gain proficiency with heavy armor.

Heavy Armor Master.description: You can use your armor to deflect strikes that would kill others. You gain the following benefits: Increase your Strength score by 1, to a maximum of 20. When you are wearing heavy armor, bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage that you take from nonmagical weapons is reduced by 3.

effects.other_mechanical: Reduce nonmagical bludgeoning/piercing/slashing damage by 3 while wearing heavy armor

Inspiring Leader.description: You can spend 10 minutes inspiring your companions, shoring up their resolve to fight. When you do so, choose up to six friendly creatures (which can include yourself) within 30 feet of you who can see or hear you and who can understand you. Each creature can gain temporary hit points equal to your level + your Charisma modifier. A creature can't gain temporary hit points from this feat again until it has finished a short or long rest.

effects.other_mechanical: 10 min: grant up to 6 creatures temp HP = level + CHA mod; once per short/long rest per creature

Keen Mind.description: You have a mind that can track time, direction, and detail with uncanny precision. You gain the following benefits: Increase your Intelligence score by 1, to a maximum of 20. You always know which way is north. You always know the number of hours left before the next sunrise or sunset. You can accurately recall anything you have seen or heard within the past month.

effects.other_mechanical: Always know direction (north); always know hours until next sunrise/sunset; recall anything seen/heard in past month

Lightly Armored.description: You have trained to learn the armors and techniques most effective in combat. Increase your Strength or Dexterity score by 1, to a maximum of 20. You gain proficiency with light armor.

Linguist.description: You have studied languages and codes, gaining the following benefits: Increase your Intelligence score by 1, to a maximum of 20. You learn three languages of your choice. You can ably create written ciphers. Others can't decipher a code you create unless you teach them, they succeed on an Intelligence check (DC equal to your Intelligence score + your proficiency bonus), or they use magic to decipher it.

effects.other_mechanical: Can create ciphers; DC to decode = INT score + proficiency bonus

Lucky.description: You have inexplicable luck that seems to kick in at just the right moment. You have 3 luck points. Whenever you make an attack roll, an ability check, or a saving throw, you can spend one luck point to roll an additional d20. You can choose to spend one of your luck points after you roll the die, but before the outcome is determined. You choose which of the d20s is used for the attack roll, ability check, or saving throw. You can also spend one luck point when an attack roll is made against you. Roll a d20, and then choose whether the attack uses the attacker's roll or yours. If more than one creature spends a luck point to influence the outcome of a roll, the points cancel each other out; no additional dice are rolled. You regain your expended luck points when you finish a long rest.

effects.other_mechanical: 3 luck points per long rest; spend 1 to roll extra d20 on attack/ability check/save and choose result; spend 1 to roll d20 against incoming attack and choose attacker's roll or yours; multiple luck points cancel

Mage Slayer.description: You have practiced techniques useful in melee combat against spellcasters, gaining the following benefits: When a creature within 5 feet of you casts a spell, you can use your reaction to make a melee weapon attack against that creature. When you damage a creature that is concentrating on a spell, that creature has disadvantage on the saving throw it makes to maintain its concentration. You have advantage on saving throws against spells cast by creatures within 5 feet of you.

effects.other_mechanical: Reaction: melee attack against creature casting spell within 5ft; disadvantage on concentration save for creature you damage

Magic Initiate.description: Choose a class: bard, cleric, druid, sorcerer, warlock, or wizard. You learn two cantrips of your choice from that class's spell list. In addition, choose one 1st-level spell from that same list. You learn that spell and can cast it at its lowest level. Once you cast it, you must finish a long rest before you can cast it again using this feat. Your spellcasting ability for these spells depends on the class you chose: Charisma for bard, sorcerer, or warlock; Wisdom for cleric or druid; Intelligence for wizard.

effects.other_mechanical: Learn 2 cantrips and 1 1st-level spell from chosen class list; cast 1st-level spell once per long rest

Martial Adept.description: You have martial training that allows you to perform special combat maneuvers. You gain the following benefits: You learn two maneuvers of your choice from among those available to the Battle Master archetype in the Fighter class. If a maneuver you use requires your target to make a saving throw to resist the maneuver's effects, the saving throw DC equals 8 + your proficiency bonus + your Strength or Dexterity modifier (your choice). If you already have superiority dice, you add one to your existing pool. If you do not have superiority dice, you have one superiority die, which is a d6. This die is used to fuel your maneuvers. A superiority die is expended when you use it. You regain your expended superiority dice when you finish a short or long rest.

effects.other_mechanical: Learn 2 Battle Master maneuvers; 1 superiority die (d6) if none, or +1 to existing pool; maneuver save DC = 8 + prof + STR or DEX; regain dice on short/long rest

Medium Armor Master.description: You have practiced moving in medium armor to gain the following benefits: Wearing medium armor doesn't impose disadvantage on your Dexterity (Stealth) checks. When you wear medium armor, you can add 3, rather than 2, to your AC if you have a Dexterity of 16 or higher.

effects.other_mechanical: No disadvantage on Stealth in medium armor; +3 DEX bonus to AC in medium armor if DEX 16+ (instead of +2 cap)

Mobile.description: You are exceptionally speedy and agile. You gain the following benefits: Your speed increases by 10 feet. When you use the Dash action, difficult terrain doesn't cost you extra movement on that turn. When you make a melee attack against a creature, you don't provoke opportunity attacks from that creature for the rest of the turn, whether you hit or not.

effects.other_mechanical: No extra movement cost from difficult terrain when dashing; no opportunity attacks from creatures you make melee attacks against for the rest of the turn

Moderately Armored.description: You have trained to gain the following benefits: Increase your Strength or Dexterity score by 1, to a maximum of 20. You gain proficiency with medium armor and shields.

Mounted Combatant.description: You are a dangerous foe to face while mounted. While you are mounted and aren't incapacitated, you gain the following benefits: You have advantage on melee attack rolls against any unmounted creature that is smaller than your mount. You can force an attack targeted at your mount to target you instead. If your mount is subjected to an effect that allows it to make a Dexterity saving throw to take only half damage, it instead takes no damage if it succeeds on the saving throw, and only half damage if it fails.

effects.other_mechanical: Advantage on melee attacks vs unmounted creatures smaller than mount; redirect attacks from mount to self; mount takes no damage on successful DEX save (Evasion for mount)

Observant.description: Quick to notice details of your environment, you gain the following benefits: Increase your Intelligence or Wisdom score by 1, to a maximum of 20. If you can see a creature's mouth while it is speaking a language you understand, you can interpret what it's saying by reading its lips. You have a +5 bonus to your passive Wisdom (Perception) and passive Intelligence (Investigation) scores.

effects.other_mechanical: Read lips if you can see mouth and understand language; +5 passive Perception and passive Investigation

Polearm Master.description: You can keep your enemies at bay with reach weapons. You gain the following benefits: When you take the Attack action and attack with only a glaive, halberd, or quarterstaff, you can use a bonus action to make a melee attack with the opposite end of the weapon; this attack uses the same ability modifier as the primary attack. The weapon's damage die for this attack is a d4, and it deals bludgeoning damage. While you are wielding a glaive, halberd, pike, or quarterstaff, other creatures provoke an opportunity attack from you when they enter the reach you have with that weapon.

effects.other_mechanical: Bonus action: d4 bludgeoning attack with butt end of glaive/halberd/quarterstaff; opportunity attack when creature enters reach with glaive/halberd/pike/quarterstaff

Resilient.description: Choose one ability score. You gain the following benefits: Increase the chosen ability score by 1, to a maximum of 20. You gain proficiency in saving throws using the chosen ability.

effects.other_mechanical: Choose one ability score; +1 to that score and proficiency in its saving throws

Ritual Caster.description: You have learned a number of spells that you can cast as rituals. Choose a class: bard, cleric, druid, sorcerer, warlock, or wizard. You acquire a ritual book holding two 1st-level spells of your choice from that class's spell list. The spells must have the ritual tag. Your spellcasting ability for these spells is the one associated with the chosen class. If you come across a spell in written form, including a spell scroll or another wizard's spellbook, and that spell is on the chosen class's spell list and of a level for which you have spell slots, you can copy it into your ritual book.

effects.other_mechanical: Ritual book with two 1st-level ritual spells from chosen class; can copy ritual spells from written form if on class list and level available

Savage Attacker.description: Once per turn when you roll damage for a melee weapon attack, you can reroll the weapon's damage dice and use either total.

effects.other_mechanical: Once per turn, reroll melee weapon damage dice and use either total

Sentinel.description: You have mastered techniques to take advantage of every drop in any enemy's guard: When you hit a creature with an opportunity attack, the creature's speed becomes 0 for the rest of the turn. Creatures provoke opportunity attacks from you even if they take the Disengage action before leaving your reach. When a creature within 5 feet of you makes an attack against a target other than you (and that target doesn't have this feat), you can use your reaction to make a melee weapon attack against the attacking creature.

effects.other_mechanical: Opportunity attack reduces speed to 0; Disengage doesn't prevent opportunity attacks from you; reaction attack when adjacent creature attacks ally

Sharpshooter.description: You have mastered ranged weapons and can make shots that others find impossible. You gain the following benefits: Attacking at long range doesn't impose disadvantage on your ranged weapon attack rolls. Your ranged weapon attacks ignore half cover and three-quarters cover. Before you make an attack with a ranged weapon that you are proficient with, you can choose to take a -5 penalty to the attack roll. If the attack hits, you add +10 to the attack's damage.

effects.other_mechanical: No disadvantage at long range; ignore half and three-quarters cover; -5 attack/+10 damage with proficient ranged weapon (optional)

Shield Master.description: You use shields not just for protection but also for offense. You gain the following benefits while you are wielding a shield: If you take the Attack action on your turn, you can use a bonus action to try to shove a creature within 5 feet of you with your shield. If you aren't incapacitated, you can add your shield's AC bonus to any Dexterity saving throw you make against a spell or other harmful effect that targets only you. If you are subjected to an effect that allows you to make a Dexterity saving throw to take only half damage, you can use your reaction to take no damage if you succeed on the saving throw, interposing your shield between yourself and the source of the effect.

effects.other_mechanical: Bonus action shove with shield on Attack action; add shield AC to DEX saves targeting only you; reaction to take no damage on successful DEX save (shield interposition)

Skilled.description: You gain proficiency in any combination of three skills or tools of your choice.

effects.other_mechanical: Choose any combination of 3 skill or tool proficiencies

Skulker.description: You are expert at slinking through shadows. You gain the following benefits: You can try to hide when you are lightly obscured from the creature from which you are hiding. When you are hidden from a creature and miss it with a ranged weapon attack, making the attack doesn't reveal your position. Dim light doesn't impose disadvantage on your Wisdom (Perception) checks relying on sight.

effects.other_mechanical: Can hide when lightly obscured; missing ranged attack while hidden doesn't reveal position; no disadvantage on Perception in dim light

Spell Sniper.prerequisite: The ability to cast at least one spell
Spell Sniper.description: You have learned techniques to enhance your attacks with certain kinds of spells, gaining the following benefits: When you cast a spell that requires you to make an attack roll, the spell's range is doubled. Your ranged spell attacks ignore half cover and three-quarters cover. You learn one cantrip that requires an attack roll. Choose the cantrip from the bard, cleric, druid, sorcerer, warlock, or wizard spell list. Your spellcasting ability for this cantrip depends on the spell list you chose from.

effects.other_mechanical: Double range on spell attack rolls; ranged spell attacks ignore half and three-quarters cover; learn 1 cantrip requiring attack roll from any spell list

Tavern Brawler.description: Accustomed to rough-and-tumble fighting using whatever weapons happen to be at hand, you gain the following benefits: Increase your Strength or Constitution score by 1, to a maximum of 20. You are proficient with improvised weapons and unarmed strikes. Your unarmed strike damage increases to 1d4. When you hit a creature with an unarmed strike or an improvised weapon on your turn, you can use a bonus action to attempt to grapple the target.

effects.other_mechanical: Proficient with improvised weapons and unarmed strikes; unarmed strike damage 1d4; bonus action grapple after hitting with unarmed strike/improvised weapon

Tough.description: Your hit point maximum increases by an amount equal to twice your level when you gain this feat. Whenever you gain a level thereafter, your hit point maximum increases by an additional 2 hit points.

effects.other_mechanical: Increase HP maximum by 2x current level; +2 HP per level gained thereafter

War Caster.prerequisite: The ability to cast at least one spell
War Caster.description: You have practiced casting spells in the midst of combat, learning techniques that grant you the following benefits: You have advantage on Constitution saving throws that you make to maintain your concentration on a spell when you take damage. You can perform the somatic components of spells even when you have weapons or a shield in one or both hands. When a hostile creature's movement provokes an opportunity attack from you, you can use your reaction to cast a spell at the creature, rather than making an opportunity attack. The spell must have a casting time of 1 action and must target only that creature.

effects.other_mechanical: Advantage on CON saves to maintain concentration; perform somatic components with weapons/shield in hands; cast spell (1 action, single target) as opportunity attack

Weapon Master.description: You have practiced extensively with a variety of weapons, gaining the following benefits: Increase your Strength or Dexterity score by 1, to a maximum of 20. You gain proficiency with four weapons of your choice.

effects.other_mechanical: Gain proficiency with 4 weapons of your choice

Barbed Hide.description: One of your parents was a barbed devil or another variety of devil that contributed barbed characteristics. You gain the following benefits: Increase your Constitution or Charisma score by 1, to a maximum of 20. You gain a spiked armor AC calculation of 13 + your Dexterity modifier while you aren't wearing armor. If your AC without this feat is already 13 + Dexterity modifier or higher, this feature has no effect. When a creature within 5 feet of you hits you with a melee attack, you can use your reaction to deal 1d6 piercing damage to the attacker.

effects.other_mechanical: AC 13 + DEX mod while unarmored (if not already equal or higher); reaction: 1d6 piercing damage to melee attacker within 5ft

Bountiful Luck.description: Your people have extraordinary luck, which you can share with those around you. When an ally you can see within 30 feet of you rolls a 1 on the d20 for an attack roll, an ability check, or a saving throw, you can use your reaction to let the ally reroll the die. The ally must use the new roll.

effects.other_mechanical: Reaction: when ally within 30ft rolls a natural 1 on attack/ability check/save, let them reroll and use new result

Dragon Fear.description: When angered, you radiate menace. You gain the following benefits: Increase your Strength, Constitution, or Charisma score by 1, to a maximum of 20. Instead of exhaling destructive energy, you can expend a use of your Breath Weapon trait to roar, forcing each creature of your choice within 30 feet of you to make a Wisdom saving throw (DC 8 + your proficiency bonus + your Charisma modifier). A target automatically succeeds if it can't see or hear you. On a failed save, a target becomes frightened of you for 1 minute. If the frightened target takes any damage, it can repeat the saving throw, ending the effect on itself on a success.

effects.other_mechanical: Expend breath weapon use to force creatures within 30ft to WIS save or be frightened for 1 minute; repeat save on damage

Dragon Hide.description: You manifest scales and claws reminiscent of your draconic ancestors. You gain the following benefits: Increase your Strength, Constitution, or Charisma score by 1, to a maximum of 20. Your scales harden; you gain a +1 bonus to AC while you aren't wearing armor. You grow retractable claws from your fingers. While you aren't wearing armor, you can use the claws to make unarmed strikes. If you hit with them, you deal slashing damage equal to 1d4 + your Strength modifier, instead of the bludgeoning damage normal for an unarmed strike.

effects.other_mechanical: +1 AC while unarmored; claws deal 1d4 + STR slashing damage as unarmed strikes while unarmored

Drow High Magic.description: You learn more of the magic typical of dark elves. You learn the detect magic spell and can cast it at will, without expending a spell slot. You also learn levitate and dispel magic, each of which you can cast once without expending a spell slot. You regain the ability to cast those two spells in this way when you finish a long rest. Charisma is your spellcasting ability for all three spells.

effects.other_mechanical: Detect Magic at will; Levitate and Dispel Magic 1/long rest each; CHA spellcasting

Dwarven Fortitude.description: You have the blood of dwarf heroes flowing through your veins. You gain the following benefits: Increase your Constitution score by 1, to a maximum of 20. Whenever you take the Dodge action in combat, you can spend one Hit Die to heal yourself. Roll the die, add your Constitution modifier, and regain a number of hit points equal to the total (minimum of 1).

effects.other_mechanical: When taking Dodge action, spend 1 Hit Die to heal (roll + CON mod, min 1)

Elven Accuracy.description: The accuracy of elves is legendary, especially that of elf archers and spellcasters. You gain the following benefits: Increase your Dexterity, Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma score by 1, to a maximum of 20. Whenever you have advantage on an attack roll using Dexterity, Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma, you can reroll one of the dice once.

effects.other_mechanical: When you have advantage on attack roll using DEX/INT/WIS/CHA, reroll one of the dice once (super-advantage)

Everybody's Friend.description: You develop your magnetic personality to ease your way through the world. You gain the following benefits: Increase your Charisma score by 1, to a maximum of 20. You gain proficiency in the Deception and Persuasion skills. If you're already proficient in either skill, your proficiency bonus is doubled for any check you make with it.

effects.other_mechanical: Proficiency in Deception and Persuasion; double proficiency bonus if already proficient (expertise)

Fade Away.description: Your people are clever, with a knack for illusion magic. You gain the following benefits: Increase your Dexterity or Intelligence score by 1, to a maximum of 20. Immediately after you take damage, you can use a reaction to magically become invisible until the end of your next turn or until you attack, deal damage, or force someone to make a saving throw. Once you use this ability, you can't do so again until you finish a short or long rest.

effects.other_mechanical: Reaction after taking damage: become invisible until end of next turn or until you attack/deal damage/force save; 1/short or long rest

Fey Teleportation.description: Your study of high elven lore has revealed fey power that enhances your fey step. You gain the following benefits: Increase your Intelligence or Charisma score by 1, to a maximum of 20. You learn to speak, read, and write Sylvan. You learn the misty step spell and can cast it once without expending a spell slot. You regain the ability to cast it in this way when you finish a short or long rest. Intelligence is your spellcasting ability for this spell.

effects.other_mechanical: Learn Sylvan; Misty Step 1/short or long rest; INT spellcasting

Flaming Tusks.description: You develop the ability to channel draconic fire through your tusks. You gain the following benefits: Increase your Strength or Constitution score by 1, to a maximum of 20. You can use a bonus action to ignite your tusks with flame. For 1 minute, your unarmed strikes deal fire damage instead of bludgeoning damage, and they deal an extra 1d4 fire damage. Once you use this feature, you can't use it again until you finish a short or long rest.

effects.other_mechanical: Bonus action: tusks ignite for 1 minute; unarmed strikes deal fire damage + 1d4 fire; 1/short or long rest

Grudge-Bearer.description: You have a deep hatred for a particular kind of creature. Choose your foes, a type of creature: aberrations, beasts, celestials, constructs, dragons, elementals, fey, fiends, giants, monstrosities, oozes, plants, or undead. Alternatively, you can choose two races of humanoid (such as gnolls and orcs). You gain the following benefits: Increase your Constitution or Wisdom score by 1, to a maximum of 20. When you make a melee attack against the chosen foe, you deal an extra 1d4 damage on a hit. You have advantage on saving throws against effects that would charm you or frighten you.

effects.other_mechanical: +1d4 damage on melee attacks vs chosen foe type; advantage vs charm/frighten effects

Human Determination.description: You are filled with a determination that can draw the unreachable within your reach. You gain the following benefits: Increase one ability score of your choice by 1, to a maximum of 20. When you make an attack roll, an ability check, or a saving throw, you can do so with advantage. Once you use this ability, you can't use it again until you finish a short or long rest.

effects.other_mechanical: Advantage on one attack roll, ability check, or saving throw; 1/short or long rest

Infernal Constitution.description: Fiendish blood runs strong in you. You gain the following benefits: Increase your Constitution score by 1, to a maximum of 20. You have resistance to cold damage and poison damage. You have advantage on saving throws against being poisoned.

effects.other_mechanical: Resistance to cold and poison damage; advantage vs poisoned condition

Orcish Fury.description: Your fury burns tirelessly. You gain the following benefits: Increase your Strength or Constitution score by 1, to a maximum of 20. When you hit with a melee attack using a simple or martial weapon, you can roll one of the weapon's damage dice an additional time and add it as extra damage of the weapon's type. Once you use this ability, you can't use it again until you finish a short or long rest. Immediately after you use your Relentless Endurance trait, you can use your reaction to make one melee weapon attack.

effects.other_mechanical: Extra weapon die damage on melee hit; 1/short or long rest; reaction melee attack after using Relentless Endurance

Prodigy.description: You have a versatility that rivals your adaptability. You gain the following benefits: Increase one ability score of your choice by 1, to a maximum of 20. You gain one skill proficiency of your choice, one tool proficiency of your choice, and one additional language of your choice. Choose one skill in which you have proficiency. You gain expertise with that skill, which means your proficiency bonus is doubled for any ability check you make with it.

effects.other_mechanical: +1 any ability; 1 skill proficiency; 1 tool proficiency; 1 language; expertise in 1 proficient skill

Revenant Blade.description: You are devoted to the arts of the double-bladed scimitar. You gain the following benefits: Increase your Dexterity or Strength score by 1, to a maximum of 20. You gain proficiency with the double-bladed scimitar. When you attack with a double-bladed scimitar, you can use your Dexterity modifier instead of your Strength modifier for the attack and damage rolls. When you take the Attack action and attack with a double-bladed scimitar, you can use a bonus action to make one melee attack with the weapon. This attack deals 1d4 slashing damage.

effects.other_mechanical: DEX instead of STR for double-bladed scimitar; bonus action 1d4 slashing attack with double-bladed scimitar

Second Chance.description: Fortune favors you when someone tries to strike you. You gain the following benefits: Increase your Dexterity, Constitution, or Charisma score by 1, to a maximum of 20. When a creature hits you with an attack roll, you can use your reaction to force that creature to reroll. Once you use this ability, you can't use it again until you roll initiative at the start of combat.

effects.other_mechanical: Reaction: force creature that hit you with attack to reroll; 1/combat (regain on initiative roll)

Squat Nimbleness.description: You are uncommonly nimble for your race. You gain the following benefits: Increase your Strength or Dexterity score by 1, to a maximum of 20. Increase your walking speed by 5 feet. You gain proficiency in the Acrobatics or Athletics skill (your choice). You have advantage on any Strength (Athletics) or Dexterity (Acrobatics) check you make to escape from being grappled.

advantage_on_checks: Athletics or Acrobatics to escape grapple
effects.other_mechanical: +5ft walking speed; proficiency in Acrobatics or Athletics; advantage on Athletics/Acrobatics to escape grapple

Wood Elf Magic.description: You learn the magical ways of the forest. You learn one cantrip of your choice from the druid spell list. You also learn the longstrider and pass without trace spells, each of which you can cast once without expending a spell slot. You regain the ability to cast those two spells in this way when you finish a long rest. Wisdom is your spellcasting ability for all three spells.

effects.other_mechanical: 1 druid cantrip; Longstrider and Pass without Trace 1/long rest; WIS spellcasting

Artificer Initiate.description: You've learned some of an artificer's inventiveness. You gain the following benefits: You learn one cantrip of your choice from the artificer spell list, and you learn one 1st-level spell of your choice from that list. Intelligence is your spellcasting ability for these spells. You can cast this spell once without a spell slot, and you must finish a long rest before you can cast it this way again. You also gain proficiency with one type of artisan's tools of your choice.

effects.other_mechanical: 1 artificer cantrip + 1 1st-level artificer spell (1/long rest); INT spellcasting; proficiency in 1 artisan's tools

Chef.description: Time spent mastering the culinary arts has paid off. You gain the following benefits: Increase your Constitution or Wisdom score by 1, to a maximum of 20. You gain proficiency with cook's utensils. As part of a short rest, you can cook special food if you have ingredients and cook's utensils. You and up to five creatures who eat the food regain 2d8 + your proficiency bonus hit points. If you have cook's utensiles, you can use them to prepare a meal during a long rest that provides temporary hit points equal to your proficiency bonus to those who eat it.

effects.other_mechanical: Short rest: cook food, 5 creatures regain 2d8 + prof bonus HP; Long rest: prepare food granting temp HP = prof bonus

Crusher.description: You are practiced in the art of crushing your enemies, granting you the following benefits: Increase your Strength or Constitution by 1, to a maximum of 20. Once per turn, when you hit a creature with an attack that deals bludgeoning damage, you can move it 5 feet to an unoccupied space, provided the target is no more than one size larger than you. When you score a critical hit that deals bludgeoning damage to a creature, attack rolls against that creature have advantage until the start of your next turn.

effects.other_mechanical: Once per turn on bludgeoning hit: move target 5ft to unoccupied space (if no more than 1 size larger); crit with bludgeoning: advantage on attacks vs target until start of your next turn

Eldritch Adept.description: You study the arcane arts and learn one warlock invocation of your choice. If an invocation has a prerequisite of a certain warlock level, you must choose from the list of invocations available to warlocks of that level or lower. You can't choose an invocation that modifies the Eldritch Blast cantrip unless you have that cantrip. Whenever you gain a level, you can replace the invocation with another one from the warlock class.

effects.other_mechanical: Learn 1 warlock invocation; can swap on level up; must meet prerequisites

Fighting Initiate.description: Your martial training has helped you develop a particular fighting style. You gain the benefit of one Fighting Style option of your choice from the Fighter class. You can choose a Fighting Style you don't already have. Whenever you gain a level, you can replace the Fighting Style with another one from the Fighter class.

effects.other_mechanical: Gain 1 Fighter Fighting Style; can swap on level up

Gunner.description: You have a quick hand and keen eye when employing firearms, granting you the following benefits: Increase your Dexterity score by 1, to a maximum of 20. You gain proficiency with firearms. You ignore the loading property of firearms with which you are proficient. Being within 5 feet of a hostile creature doesn't impose disadvantage on your ranged attack rolls.

effects.other_mechanical: Ignore loading property on proficient firearms; no disadvantage on ranged attacks within 5ft of hostile creature

Metamagic Adept.description: You've learned how to exert your will on your spells to alter how they function. You gain the following benefits: You learn two Metamagic options of your choice from the sorcerer class. You can use only one Metamagic option on a spell when you cast it, unless the option says otherwise. You gain 2 sorcery points to spend on these options (no other use); you regain all spent sorcery points when you finish a long rest. Whenever you gain a level, you can replace one of your Metamagic options with another one from the sorcerer class.

effects.other_mechanical: Learn 2 sorcerer Metamagic options; gain 2 sorcery points (long rest recharge); can swap 1 option on level up

Piercer.description: You have achieved a penetrating strike, granting you the following benefits: Increase your Strength or Dexterity by 1, to a maximum of 20. Once per turn, when you hit a creature with an attack that deals piercing damage, you can reroll one of the attack's damage dice, and you must use the new roll. When you score a critical hit that deals piercing damage, you can roll one additional damage die when determining the extra piercing damage the target takes.

Poisoner.description: You can craft and use toxins to deadly effect. You can apply poison in this way a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus, and you regain all uses when you finish a long rest. You gain proficiency with the poisoner's kit. You can craft a poison with a potency appropriate for your level for 50 gp and 15 minutes of work.

effects.other_mechanical: Apply poison as part of weapon attack (proficiency bonus times/long rest); poison lasts until end of turn; craft poison for 50 gp / 15 min

Potent Cantrip.prerequisite: The ability to cast at least one cantrip that deals damage

Shadow Touched.description: You have communed with the Shadowfell, and its darkness has left its mark on you. You gain the following benefits: Increase your Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma score by 1, to a maximum of 20. You learn the disguise self spell and one 1st-level spell of your choice from the illusion or necromancy school of magic. You can cast each of these spells without expending a spell slot once per long rest. Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma is your spellcasting ability for them (choose when you select this feat).

effects.other_mechanical: Learn Disguise Self + 1 illusion/necromancy 1st-level spell; cast each 1/long rest without spell slot; INT/WIS/CHA spellcasting

Skill Expert.description: You have honed your proficiency with particular skills, granting you the following benefits: Increase one ability score of your choice by 1, to a maximum of 20. You gain proficiency in one skill of your choice. Choose one skill in which you have proficiency. You gain expertise with that skill, which means your proficiency bonus is doubled for any ability check you make with it.

effects.other_mechanical: +1 any ability; 1 new skill proficiency; expertise in 1 proficient skill

Slasher.description: You've learned where to cut to have the greatest results, granting you the following benefits: Increase your Strength or Dexterity by 1, to a maximum of 20. Once per turn when you hit a creature with an attack that deals slashing damage, you can reduce the speed of that creature by 10 feet until the start of your next turn. When you score a critical hit that deals slashing damage to a creature, you grievously wound it. Until the start of your next turn, the target has disadvantage on all attack rolls.

effects.other_mechanical: Once per turn on slashing hit: reduce target speed by 10ft until start of next turn; crit with slashing: target has disadvantage on attack rolls until start of your next turn

Telekinetic.description: You learn to move things with your mind, granting you the following benefits: Increase your Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma score by 1, to a maximum of 20. You learn the mage hand cantrip. You can cast it without verbal or somatic components, and you can make the spectral hand invisible. If you already know this cantrip, you can use it as a bonus action and its range increases by 30 feet. As a bonus action, you can try to telekinetically shove a creature within 30 feet of you that you can see. The target must succeed on a Strength saving throw (DC 8 + your proficiency bonus + the ability modifier of the score increased by this feat) or be moved 5 feet toward or away from you. A creature can choose to fail this save.

Telepathic.description: You awaken the ability to mentally connect with others, granting you the following benefits: Increase your Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma score by 1, to a maximum of 20. You can speak telepathically to any creature you can see within 60 feet of you. Your telepathic utterances are in a language you know, and the creature understands you only if it knows that language. Your communication doesn't give the creature the ability to respond to you telepathically. You can cast the detect thoughts spell, requiring no spell slot or components, and you must finish a long rest before you can cast it this way again. Your spellcasting ability for this spell is the ability increased by this feat.

effects.other_mechanical: Learn Misty Step + 1 divination/enchantment 1st-level spell; cast each 1/long rest without spell slot; INT/WIS/CHA spellcasting

properties: (Recharge 5-6). Ranged Weapon Attack: +2 to hit, range 15/30 ft. one target.

weapon_properties.Ammunition: You can use a weapon that has the ammunition property to make a ranged attack only if you have ammunition to fire from the weapon. Each time you attack with the weapon, you expend one piece of ammunition. Drawing the ammunition from a quiver, case, or other container is part of the attack. At the end of the battle, you can recover half your expended ammunition by taking a minute to search the battlefield.
weapon_properties.Finesse: When making an attack with a finesse weapon, you use your choice of your Strength or Dexterity modifier for the attack and damage rolls. You must use the same modifier for both rolls.
weapon_properties.Heavy: Small creatures have disadvantage on attack rolls with heavy weapons. A heavy weapon's size and bulk make it too large for a Small creature to use effectively.
weapon_properties.Light: A light weapon is small and easy to handle, making it ideal for use when fighting with two weapons.
weapon_properties.Loading: Because of the time required to load this weapon, you can fire only one piece of ammunition from it when you use an action, bonus action, or reaction to fire it, regardless of the number of attacks you can normally make.
weapon_properties.Range: A weapon that can be used to make a ranged attack has a range shown in parentheses after the ammunition or thrown property. The range lists two numbers. The first is the weapon's normal range in feet, and the second indicates the weapon's long range. When attacking a target beyond normal range, you have disadvantage on the attack roll. You can't attack a target beyond the weapon's long range.
weapon_properties.Reach: This weapon adds 5 feet to your reach when you attack with it.
weapon_properties.Special: A weapon with the special property has unusual rules governing its use, explained in the weapon's description.
weapon_properties.Thrown: If a weapon has the thrown property, you can throw the weapon to make a ranged attack. If the weapon is a melee weapon, you use the same ability modifier for that attack roll and damage roll that you would use for a melee attack with the weapon.
weapon_properties.Two-Handed: This weapon requires two hands to use.
weapon_properties.Versatile: This weapon can be used with one or two hands. A damage value in parentheses appears with the property—the damage when the weapon is used with two hands.
weapon_properties.Explosive: The weapon deals damage in a radius. Each creature in the area must make a saving throw.
weapon_properties.Reload: A limited number of shots can be made with a weapon that has the reload property. You must then reload using an action or bonus action (your choice). The reload number indicates how many shots you can fire before reloading.

weapon_special_rules.Lance: You have disadvantage when you use a lance to attack a target within 5 feet of you. Also, a lance requires two hands to wield when you aren't mounted.
weapon_special_rules.Net: A Large or smaller creature hit by a net is restrained until it is freed. A net has no effect on creatures that are formless, or creatures that are Huge or larger. A creature can use its action to make a DC 10 Strength check, freeing itself or another creature within its reach on a success. Dealing 5 slashing damage to the net (AC 10) also frees the creature without harming it, ending the effect and destroying the net. When you use an action, bonus action, or reaction to attack with a net, you can make only one attack regardless of the number of attacks you can normally make.
weapon_special_rules.Bomb: As an action, a creature can light a bomb and throw it to a point up to 60 feet away. Each creature within 5 feet of that point must make a DC 12 Dexterity saving throw, taking 3d6 fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.
weapon_special_rules.Smokepowder Keg: A keg of smokepowder can be ignited with a fuse. When lit, it explodes: each creature within 20 feet must make a DC 12 Dexterity saving throw, taking 7d6 fire damage on a failed save, or half as much on a successful one.
weapon_special_rules.Smokepowder Horn: A horn of smokepowder can be ignited. Each creature within 5 feet must make a DC 12 Dexterity saving throw, taking 3d6 fire damage on a failed save, or half as much on a successful one.
